tei:titleStmt.tei:title: gsum gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni 'og gi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈/ /jo bo lha gcig bod du 'byon pa'i
gsum gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni 'og gi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈/ /jo bo lha gcig bod du 'byon pa'i

tei:div.tei:p: gsum gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni 'og gi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// ༈ //jo bo lha gcig bod du 'byon pa'i dus phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi zhal 'don dang bcas rdo rje'i gdan du bskor ba mdzad pa'i tshe rje btsun sgrol mas zhal mngon sum du bstan te bod du bzhud cig par lung bstan/ 'di la yi dam byas na bar chad mi 'byung zhes bstod pa sh+lau ka re dang las tshogs re sbyar nas gnang ba'i rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi rjes gnang la/ ngag dbang chos grags pa'i yig cha'i steng nas thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ dang po sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ de bzhin du gnyis pa nad gdon zhi ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ gsum pa tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba'i sgrol ma gser mdog bzhi pa tshe sgrub pa'i sgrol ma rnam par rgyal ma gser mdog can/ lnga pa bud med dbang du bya ba'i sgrol ma hūm̐ sgra sgrogs ma dmar ser ma/ drug pa 'byung po 'dul ba'i sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma dmar nag bdun pa gzhan gyi rig sngags bzlog pa'i sgrol ma gzhan 'joms ma nag mo/ brgyad pa sgrol ma bdud dang dgra 'joms ma dmar nag dgu pa 'jigs pa bsrung ba'i sgrol ma dkon mchog gsum mtshon ma ljang mo/ bcu pa sgrol ma bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma dmar mo/ bcu gcig pa sgrol ma 'gugs shing phongs sel ma gser btso ma lta bu/ bcu gnyis pa sgrol ma bkra shis thams cad 'byin ma gser mdog can/ bcu gsum pa sgrol ma me ltar 'bar ba dmar mo/ bcu bzhi pa sgrol ma khro gnyer can nag mo/ bco lnga pa sgrol ma zhi ba chen mo dkar mo/ bcu drug pa 'phags ma rig pa hūm̐ sgrol ma dmar mo/ bcu bdun pa sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum mgon ma dmar ser/ bco brgyad pa 'phags ma klu'i dug nad thams cad rab zhi ma dkar mo/

bcu dgu pa sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ nyi shu pa rims nad srung ba'i sgrol ma dmar ser/ nyer gcig pa phrin las yongs rdzogs kyi sgrol ma dkar mo rnams te sgrol ma nyer gcig dang*/ seng ldeng nags sgrol ljang mo dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ jo bo rje mar me mdzad bzang po/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ 'chad kha ba ye shes rdo rje/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa ba ye shes skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ ze'u grags pa shes rab/ ze'u grags pa brtson 'grus/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ kun mkhyen rong ston chen po shākya rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor/ gnubs sgom sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shar chen ye shes bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ shes bya bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun de nyid kyis bdag tshul khrims rin chen la dges bzhin du stsal to// phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sgrub thabs yig rnying*/ rjes gnang gi chings thub bstan yangs pa can gyi mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa rnams kyi steng nas mdzad cing de dag gi lung yang thos so// ༈ //jo bo rje la sgrol mas dngos su gnang ba'i rje btsun sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel phrin las kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad kha ba/ se spyil bu pa/

ram pha lha sdings pa/ sangs rgyas dbon/ slob dpon yon tan dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ 'gro mgon dpal ldan ye shes/ glang thang chos rje shes rab rdo rje/ byang chub dpal rgyal ba bzang po/ nam mkha' bzang po/ chos rje blo gros 'byung gnas/ rje btsun dkon mchog blo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'bum rab 'byams pa rgyal ba blo gros/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// ༈ //sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i bstod sgrub maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog gi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs bral kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //e waṃ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ gsol ba 'debs pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs bcas pa'i steng nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ slob dpon shākya 'od zer/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/
klu pa mkhan chen bsod nams dar/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas/

steng pa lo tsā ba/ sa skyong thams cad mkhyen pa/ tshes lnga rin chen rnams su'ang grags/ dpal ldan kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ rje btsun mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ bka' drin rmad byung rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal ldan chos skyong ba/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// de'i las tshogs kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni sa skya bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa dang gcig go/ ༈ //thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul gyi yi ge la brten nas rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa thob pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa la bka' babs dang po jo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa/ mgon po gser gling pa/ jo bo a ti sha/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ bshes gnyen bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od/ dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen/ zhang sum thog pa/ zhang bka' tshal ba/ bla ma lha/ slob dpon rin chen bzang po/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ dka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med dpal ldan tshul khrims/ mkhas pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen chos dpal ba/ chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho/ thugs rje can rin chen bzang po/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs 'dzin/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ rje dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/

mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ chos rje kun dga' 'chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na ngag gi dbang phyug dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri rin chen grags/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra'o// yang na ngag dbang grags pa/ grub chen ma ti/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen man 'dra/ yang na bka' bzhi pa/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bla ma man 'dra'o// ༈ //tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa dang*/ rjes gnang gi yi ge kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i steng nas rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma dkar mo spyan bdun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma'i 'od zer drug sbrags kyi rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo/ paṇa grub ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa/ rje btsun ba ri lo tsā ba/ grub chen sle nag pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgre pa/ mnyam med sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu/ dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po/ sgom chung shes rab byang chub/ mtshungs med dwags po 'dul 'dzin pa/ rje 'bri khung gling pa/ rje dam chos gling pa/ bla ma chos kyi tshul khrims/ mnyam med bla ma lha lung pa/ thog gnas pa chen po/ lo pa'i gsan yig na yon gnas pa zhes snang*/ bla ma chos kyi dbang phyug 'dren mchog byang chub bzang po/ kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ lo pa spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/

spang gshong ha ri kha pa dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ dwags po paṇa chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i paṇa chen bkras rnam pa'i dbon po yin/ lha/ 'bras yul skyed tshal gyi dge bshes gnyug la legs bshad gling gi bla mar bskos nas karma phrin las su grags/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bo dong mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang dbang chen po ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho nas/ mkhas btsun chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag shī la rat+na la'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ mkhan chen zhwa lu ba man 'dra/ yang na tshar chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ rje btsun bod mkhar pa/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ skyed tshal mkhan chen thar pa rgyal mtshan/ zhwa lu pa man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen brtse'i zhabs las/ mkhan chen bslab gsum pa/ dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje gsum gyis gsan/ yab sras bzhi ka las rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gsan no// yang yig cha de nyid kyi steng nas thun mong ba'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang bshad ma thag pa ltar ro// ༈ //rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bka' babs dgu dang ldan pa'i brgyud pa la bka' babs dang po jo bo lugs ni gong gi ngor lugs kyi skabs ltar yin la/ der slar yang brgyud pa'i rgyun mi 'dra ba rnams smos na/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal nas/ zhang ston bsod nams grags pa/

chos rje bla ma dam pa/ spos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba phyag na pa/ kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba rin chen rgyal mchog rdzong dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas rgya mtsho nas/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// yang na spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar nas/ bshes gnyen sgre pa/ sgam po bsod nams rin chen/ phag mo grub pa/ stag lung thang pa/ bla ma lam pa/ slob dpon tshal pa/ shākya gzhon nu/ don zhabs pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ rtsegs pa bsod nams rdo rje/ ma ti pha la/ gtsang pa blo bzang pa/ skad dod la bltas na blo gros bzang po 'dra/ rang grol lhun grub/ nam mkha' blo gros/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal man 'dra/ yang na sgam po ba nas/ lho la yag pa/ slob dpon brtan pa/ slob dpon tshal pa/ shākya gzhon nu man 'dra/ yang na shāka gzhon nas/ shangs pa grags seng*/ bla ma mgon rgyal ba/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ 'khrul zhig bsod nams 'bum/ bla ma rgyal mtshan/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa/ chag lo man 'dra/ yang na spyan snga ba nas/ bya yul ba/ sle nag pa/ sgre pa/ sgam po pa man 'dra/ yang na zla 'od gzhon nu nas/ karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa/ khams pa dbu se/ khams pa dbang phyug rdo rje/ dbang phyug seng ge khams pa bya bral ba shes rab gzhon nu/ spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po/ de gnyis ka las ri khrod pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ de nas ras chen gzhon nu dpal/ grub chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ de las sgo rum pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang*/ kun dga' rgya mtsho gnyis kyis gsan/

gnyis ka nas rje btsun kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas dpal/ sgo rum pa man 'dra/ yang na bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bo dong 'jigs bral/ stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa/ bo dong pa 'chi med dpal bzang*/ bo dong pa sangs rgyas lhun grub/ bo dong sngags rams yon tan rgya mtsho/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ paṇa chen chos rin dpal ba/ rje blo gros rgya mtsho/ rat+na bha dra/ kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs 'dzin/ mkhan chen dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub man 'dra/ yang na bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od nas/ 'chad kha pa/ skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ spang ston grub pa shes rab/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu chos grub/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs 'dzin man 'dra'o// bka' babs gnyis pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ paṇa grub wā gī shwa ra/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal blo gros rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/

rgyal ba brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man gong dang 'dra'o// bka' babs gsum pa kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ bar 'dir bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu byung*/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba man gong ltar ro// yang na kha che paṇ+ḍi ta nas/ dā na shī la/ gtsang thang pa bla ma ka pa ba/ rtogs ldan grags seng*/ g.ya' bzang pa bsod nams 'od/ bsod nams rdo rje/ gtsang pa blo bzang pa man 'dra'o// bka' babs bzhi pa a bha yā ka ra'i lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra/ shu bhaṃ ka ra gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ go taṃ shrī/ kīrti tsan+d+ra/ yar lung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen rin chen 'phel/ ye shes 'phel/ kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma byang sems ba/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/ shangs dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ skungs lung pa sangs rgyas 'od/ 'phags pa rin po che/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba man 'dra'o// bka' babs lnga pa gnyan lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ sa skya pa chen po man 'dra zhing*/ sa chen brgyud par bzhugs phyin de man chad kyi brgyud pa tshang ma ded chog go/ //bka' babs drug pa dpyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ rdo rje gdan pa niska laṃ ka dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ dpyal a mo gha/ mkhan chen gzhon nu dpal ye shes/

thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje btsun dpal chen bzang po/ rje ye shes dpal bzang*/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba rin chen rgyal mchog man 'dra zhing bu ston rin po che brgyud par bzhugs phyin de man gyi brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyang 'dir drangs chog go/ //bka' babs bdun pa rngog lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ rngog mdo sde/ rngog kun dga'/ rngog gzi brjid grags pa/ rngog rin chen bzang po/ rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gnag ra ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rngog byang chub dpal ba/ byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'i sde/ khrus khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba man 'dra'o// //bka' babs brgyad pa sgar lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje/ rje mkha' spyod dbang po/ karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa/ mkhas grub bsod nams 'bum/ bla ma rgyal mtshan/ zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba man 'dra'o// //bka' babs dgu pa nags rin lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ de dpon kun dga' grol mchog chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs 'dzin/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam dbyangs dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// yang na dpal ldan don grub nas/

shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o// yang na sangs rgyas rgya mtsho nas/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba gcig la/ 'phags pa rin po che yan gong ltar las/ de nas shākya 'od zer/ rgyal tsha chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klungs pa mkhas grub seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen klu pa bsod nams dar/ dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen/ gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal ba/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge e waṃ thar pa rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ khyab bdag zhwa lu ba man 'dra'o// ༈ //sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub skor dang las tshogs thor bu rnams/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtses phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i lung thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge des mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge chog khrigs ngag 'don bklag chog tu bkod pa tshe dang bsod nams kyi nyi ma bdun 'bar/ des mdzad pa'i tshe khrid skyabs yul zhing khams ma/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ bsham dum 'thor gyis song yang 'gal ba med gsungs pa'i mtha' can/ ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i sgrol dkar gyi sgo nas 'chi ba bslu ba'i rtog pa bsdus pa/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang lo tsā ba ba ris bsgyur ba/ yang sgrub thabs/ bum chog gtor chog sgom pa'i srung 'khor rnams chos tshan gcig tu byas pa/ byis pa'i srung 'khor gyi gdams pa yon tan dpag tu med pa/

bar chad zhi byed ltas ngan g.yang du len pa/ slob dpon pad+ma nag pos mdzad pa'i byad 'grol ba ri'i 'gyur/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i gnas dang chom rkun bsrung ba/ ce spyang sngon mo'i lam srung bcas pa'i lung legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ de nas mkhan chen bslab gsum rje/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zhwa lu pa chen po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang sbyin sreg khrid yig rjes gnang*/ 'chi bslu bcas pa'i brgyud lugs gcig la/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ mchod dpon drung pa dkon mchog rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs kyi brgyud lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab/ rje sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag zhwa lu pa man 'dra/ yang ltas ngan g.yang len gyi brgyud lugs gcig la/ rje dbang rab nas/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ khyab bdag zhwa lu ba man 'dra'o// ༈ //sgrol ma'i man ngag rmi lam brtag thabs shin tu zab pa lha mo shra ma ṇa'i sgrub thabs/ kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i lung dang dmigs khrid bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ dze tā ri'am dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ shar pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ shar pa kun dga' seng ge bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/

gar thig pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ grags pa rdo rje/ bla ma grags pa don grub/ grub chen ri khrod pa/ shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal/ yongs 'dzin bde legs bzang po/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang sangs rgyas rin chen/ bco brgyad pa mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //bzhi pa pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo ni rta mgrin te/ de'ang paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas jo bo chen po dī paṃ ka ras yol chos dbang la gnang ba'i rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa gshog pa can jo bo lugs su grags pa'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ dpal rta mgrin/ jo bo a ti sha yol grub thob chos dbang*/ mtha' bzhi grub thob rin po che smon lam pa/ rin po che lam pa/ lha ye shes 'od/ slob dpon legs pa shes rab/ zhang byang chub rin chen/ bla ma byang chub gzhon nu/ mkhan chen byams pa rin chen/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ de nas dpal ldan don grub yin nam/ de nas bla ma gnyis gsum tsam ma rnyed pas slar btsal/ khang gsar pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na lha mchog seng ge rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse pa man 'dra'o// thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i lung yang thob//

༈ //jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha 'phan yul lan pa'i spyil bur bzhugs pa'i tshe bran kha dpal yon gyis tho btsams pa na pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bor gtogs pa rta mgrin shwa na bzhis bskor gyi sgo nas btul ba sogs byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che bar grags pa'i rjes su gnang ba gzhan ma'i rgyas bkab ma yin pa'i yig rnying gi dgongs pa 'khrul med rgyal dbang lnga pas mdzad pa'i yid ches sum ldan gyi steng nas rdul tshon gyi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ me tog gdong g.yogs dbu rgyan sogs 'di kha'i lugs ltar phyag len shin tu gtsang bar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rta mgrin/ yum gsang ba ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma/ slob dpon sangs rgyas zhi ba/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku sa li che chung gnyis/ jo bo chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ yol grub thob chos dbang*/ mtha' bzhi grub thob/ rin po che smon lam pa/ rin po che lam pa/ bla ma ye shes 'od/ slob dpon legs pa shes rab/ bla ma byang chub rin chen/ slob dpon byang chub gzhon nu/ mkhan chen byams pa rin chen/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje bkra shis rnam rgyal/

'di la gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun du rnam rgyal bkra shis zhes snang*/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na dang po'i sangs rgyas/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ dge slong ma dpal gyi bzang mo/ slob dpon ye shes bzang po/ jo bo chen po man 'dra'o// yang na spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags yan gong ltar las/ de nas gzims 'og pa dpal ldan chos 'byor/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'khon ston 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa rgyas pa'i lang tsho'i sde/ des bdag skal ldan tshul khrims rin chen la'o// de'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang she'u lo tsā bas mdzad pa dang*/ bco brgyad mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang*/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang yid ches sum ldan bcas pa'i lung rnams thos// ༈ //ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje'i yi ge dang*/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge gnyis char gyi steng nas/ rjes ras pa badz+ra kīrti nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin dmar po pad dbyug can pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs su gtogs pa'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rta mgrin/ u rgyan rin po che/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ grub chen ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/

dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje/ sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu/ phag gru rdo rje rgyal po/ skyu ra rin chen dpal/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje/ thugs sras spyan snga rigs ldan/ zur phug pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ chos rje rin chen 'phel/ mkhan chen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'ba' rwa ba nas/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po/ sprul spu rdo rje rgyal po/ pha rgod bsod nams bzang po/ rdo ring pa chen po man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man 'dra'o// yi ge le tshan gnyis kyi lung yang thos// ༈ //rta mgrin 'di bya rgyud khro bor ma nges kyang rta mgrin rnams phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir 'dir bris/ dmar po skyer sgang lugs sam gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa rgyal mtshan/ rin chen sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/

byams pa bsod nams lhun grub/ 'di gnyis gang rung*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mtshungs med dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'jam dpal mgon po bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la lan grangs du ma'i bar ro// yang na bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag shī la rat+na la'o// yang na tshar chen nas/ mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos grags rgya mtsho/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ byams pa bsod nams lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ //paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang bya tshul gyi yi ge la brten nas byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan la zhal gzigs pa'i pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs sam nag po lcags ral can du grags pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ zhang skyi tsha 'od chen/ zhang dbu dkar ba/ zhang lo tsā ba/ zhang byang chub rin chen/ dpal rgyal ba grub pa/ chos rje 'dzin pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ chos rje spang khang pa grags pa dpal/ sgrub pa po bla ma rin chen brtson 'grus/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje brang ti pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje brang ti pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/

bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa las thob kyang de'i gsan yul gyi bla ma gang yin brtag rgyab brten lung la sgrub thabs/ nad pa gso ba/ steng gdon gzir ba/ lus bsrung ba/ ser pa bsrung ba/ phyir bzlog pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge rnying pa rnams dang*/ thar rtse pa'i yi ge'i lung bcas thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dkon mchog lhun grub yan gong ltar dang*/ de nas sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen man gong dang 'dra zhing*/ bdag gis thob yul dpal ldan chos skyong las so// ༈ //pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro mo ni/ thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar rigs kyi khro mo ri khrod lo ma gyon ma ser mo'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ brtse chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma rin chen ye shes/ bla chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma bsam gtan grub/ glo bo lo tsā ba shrī wan bo dhi/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ lha mchog seng ge bud+dha singha*/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas dbang dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhas btsun grub dbang dam pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na mus chen/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rat+na war+dha/ dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/

yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse pa man 'dra'o// 'di'i sgo nas yul phyogs kyi rims nad gcod pa'i gzungs chog ni/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gsung rab kyi lung brgyud ltar ro// ༈ //drug pa pad+ma'i rigs kyi pho nya ni/ khro bo spyi gtsug 'bar ba la sogs pa ni ma byung*/ rigs kyi pho nya mo ni/ 'jigs med dpal dang dbyangs can ma sogs te/ 'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba rnams phyi rol pa'i lha'i gzugs dang rtags dang mtshan mas 'dul bar dgongs nas lha thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dbang phyug sogs phyi rol pa'i lha rnams sku'i cha shas nas phyung ba'i skabs dbyangs can ma che ba las phyung bar bshad cing nges pa'i don du dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig ma yin la/ de yang rigs mang du yod pa'i nang nas shes rab bskyed pa'i lhag pa'i lha pad+ma'i rigs kyi pho nya mo ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes su gnang ba slob dpon dpe med rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ sum pa lo tsā ba'i bzhed srol thar rtse paṇ+ḍi ta nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang kha skong dang bcas pa'i yi ge'i steng nas dam pa'i phyag len 'khrul med bzhin legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma/ bram ze phur bu/ bram ze tsan+d+ra ka thar rtse pa dang shar pa'i gsan yig na gtum po bde chen zhes 'di gnyis gcig tu mdzad 'dug kyang ngor chen dang mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na so sor snang ngo*// bram ze bde chen/ bram ze mchod sdong thar rtse pa dang shar pa'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis gcig tu 'dug kyang ngor chen dang mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang ngo*// slob dpon seng ge nye ba'i seng ge ngor chen gyi gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung zhing 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na u pa singha zhes rgya skad sor bzhag bris 'dug

thar rtse dang shar pa sogs gsan yig mang por nyi ma seng ge zer ba 'dug pa yig skyon shor ram snyam/ dpe med 'tsho chen po/ ngor chen gyi gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung zhing mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na dpe med rgya mtsho chen po zhes snang ba don gcig pa 'dra/ thar rtse pa dang shar pa'i gsan yig na dpe med rgya mtsho chen po so sor phral 'dug pa yig nor byung ngam snyam/ sum pa lo tsā ba dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje/ kun dga' bla ma/ spyi bo lhas thar rtse pa dang shar pa'i gsan yig na byang chub bde zer ba 'dug kyang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan thor 'di bzhin snang ba lo rgyus sogs dang mthun/ pa byang chub 'od/ dam pa shes rab/ gru rdo rje seng ge bu ston seng ge 'od/ lha gzhon nu 'bum/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma rol pa'i rdo rje/ karma pa dang mi gcig mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī/ 'dir sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i gsan yig na tshul khrims rgyal mtshan zhes pa lhag po byung*/ rgyal dbang sogs kyi der ni med/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ dbu mdzad kun dga' dpal 'byor/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag shī la rat+na la bka' drin du stsal to// nye brgyud ni rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrīs thugs sras lo tsā ba la gnang ba'i rgya gar paṇa chen gyi phyag len 'khrul pa med pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ngag dbang dbyangs can ma/

des rjes su bzung ba'i rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī dz+nyā na bha dra mu nīn+d+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrī/ sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma rol pa'i rdo rje man gong dang 'dra/ yang sum pa lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang dang sgrub skor la/ sgrub thabs dngos/ zhar byung rmi ltas/ gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa/ thun mong ba'i gegs sel la phrin las 'chol ba/ grib sel ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyis 'dod chags sel ba/ smyo 'bog sel ba/ 'di las zab pa med pa'i gegs sel/ rtags med na spogs chog rdzas kyi chag gegs sel ba/ nor rgyun ma'i phrag dog sel ba rigs gsum/ lha mo dpal mo'i phrag dog sel ba rigs gsum dang bcas pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gegs sel la/ ting nge 'dzin la brten nas shes rab 'phel zhing mi 'grib pa/ phongs pa sel ba/ chags pa sel ba/ rnying rlung sel ba rnams dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rtsod pa las rgyal ba/ bsgrub bya dbang du bya ba/ byis pa blo rno bar byed pa/ ril bu'i sbyor ba/ dam tshig me long la brten pa'i zhal shes dang bcas pa bram ze phur bus mdzad pa'i yi ge sogs/ gzhung man ngag las 'jam dbyangs smon lam dpal ba dang paṇ+ḍi ta phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gsung bzhin bkod pa'i lung dang bcas legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal yan ring brgyud ltar la/ de nas bla ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ chos rje dpal ldan seng ge 'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'byor/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rje thub bstan pa/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang*/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/

rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa snang mdzad rdo rje/ zur 'jam dbyangs chos dbyings rang grol/ 'di nas bla ma gsum tsam btsal/ de nas mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs/ spogs chog rtags rtsod pa rgyal ba/ dbang sdud/ dug sel/ byis pa blo rno bar byed pa/ khams 'dus sel ba rnams man ngag tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa bo dong pa bi dza yas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshig lhug man ngag bying ba/ rgod pa/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ mi dga' ba/ sdug bsngal sogs gegs sel sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ des mdzad pa'i tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pa rgyan gyi phreng ba dang bcas pa'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od yan sngar ltar las/ de nas 'dzim pa mgon po zla ba'i 'od/ lho pa rin chen grags/ 'dzim mkhan chen bde gshegs/ 'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ kun spangs chos grags dpal/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ glang thang spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang zhwa lu pa chen po/ 'di nas kyang bla ma bzhi tsam btsal/ de nas mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na dbyangs can ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta shī la ā ka ra/ tsan+d+ra shrī/ gau taṃ shrī/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan man 'dra// ༈ //thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi kha skong dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud ni/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar la/ de nas paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/

'di gnyis dgos mi dgos brtag shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa ye shes bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// bram ze phur bus mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ngag gi 'od zer/ drang srong mngon shes can gyis mdzad pa'i las sbyor gyi rtsa ba 'di gnyis kyi lung ni mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ de las dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de las bdag gis mnos so// sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang las 'byung ba'i dbyangs can dkar mo'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/ dpal ldan bsam yas pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs gegs sel las sbyor dang bcas pa le'u bzhi pa 'od kyi drwa ba/ bstod pa gzhon nu rol dga' dang bcas pa rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ sum pa lo tsā ba yan gong ltar la/ de nas bla brang pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ sangs rgyas dbon po/ kun spangs sems can chen po/ bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rje yig pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rtse le bsod nams rnam rgyal/ rtse le o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ rig 'dzin mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ rje pad+ma dbang chen/ sdom brtson rin chen dar rgyas/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ sprul pa'i sku mchog gter bdag gling pa/ de sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ rdzogs chen pa theg mchog bstan 'dzin pa/ dbon rin po che pa'am nges legs bstan 'dzin pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa bo dong 'jigs bral gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs las tshogs bstod pa gnyis bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma/

paṇ+ḍi ta shī la ā ka ra/ tsan+d+ra shrī/ gau taṃ shrī/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bo dong paṇa chen dbyangs can dga' ba/ stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ glang thang spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ byams pa bsod nams mtha' yas/ thub bstan mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes/ des bdag la'o// yang na rmor chen nas/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ de las byams pa bsod nams mtha' yas/ yangs can mkhan po ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ de gnyis char las mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yi ge'i lung yang thos// ༈ //rgyud chen krī ya'i chu las skyes pa'i rigs// bde bar gshegs dang bdag po rgyal ba'i yum// khro bo khro mo mngag gzhug pho mor bcas// lhag pa lha yi sde tshan nyi shu bdun// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste brgyad pa'o// //gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs la/ dang por rigs kyi gtso bo ni mi bskyod pa la sogs pa ste 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dze tā ris cho ga'i yan lag rnams spyod rgyud ltar bkral ba'i lugs su/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog las sgrib rnam sbyong gi steng nas rdo rje'i rigs kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ dz+nyā na gar+bha/ dz+nyā na shān+ta/ bud+dha shān+ta/ ngor chen gong dkar ba mkhyen brtse gsum gyi gsan yig na 'dug rung thar rtse pa dang shar pa'i gsan yig tu mi snang ba chad pa 'dra/ bud+dha gu h+ya/ ku sa li che chung gnyis/ su war+ṇa ḍ+wi pa dharma kīrti/ dpal dī paṃ kā ra/ go mi sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyags ldom bu ba/ spug thams cad mkhyen pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na chos kyi tog zer ba 'dug pa tog gi skad dod ke tu rgyal mtshan la'ang 'jug par dgongs sam snyam/ bya rin chen bla ma bya nag chen po/ 'od/ mnga' ris glo bo pa yin/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po// rgyal tshab kun dbang*/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rat+nār+tha sid+dhiḥ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar chen ye shes bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bar 'dir bla ma zhig btsal dgos/ rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag la lhun grub steng gi chos grwar stsal to// yang shug rwa ba kun dga' dpal 'byor las lan cig thob kyang de pa'i gsan yul gyi bla ma gang yin ma nges/ yang na bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan nas/ rje lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra/ yang na dkon mchog 'phel nas/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse pa man gong bzhin no// yang na jo bo chen po nas/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun sa chen/ slob dpon rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/

snur ye shes rgyal mtshan/ snur chos 'phags/ gar thig pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ kha che ye shes rdo rje/ lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ sa skya pa chen po man 'dra'o// ༈ //gnyis pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag po ni rigs pa mchog dang glang po'i rna ba la sogs pa ste/ 'dir zhwa lu pa shar chen ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gsang ba nor bu'i gter mdzod kyi steng nas slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs kyi dpal gsang pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ 'di gnyis gang gi dbang thob pa yin yid la ma nges pas slar khang gsar ba'i gsan yig la brtag lha bcu bdun/ lha gcig rnams kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ dpal kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ bram ze sadz+dza na/ jo bo te dza de wa/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ g.yor po jo ston rdo rje rtse mo/ pur bsod gra dol gyi mtshams na bcur zer ba zhig 'dug pa de nas yin pa chog sgrigs dngos grub 'dod 'jor bshad/ nams rin chen/ 'byed phu ba karma bkra shis/ lha rje stag pa jo bzang*/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu ba bsod nams seng ge yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ chos rgyal nam mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ sku zhang rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug

rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang na mkhyen rab rje/ de las lcags sgog lung pa bkra shis dpal tshar chen gyi lam yig tu ku sa li'i bla ma dang lam du mjal gsungs pa de yin/ 'byor dang*/ 'brog khang don grub rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka nas 'jam dbyangs byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na kha che rin chen rdo rje nas/ kha che dgon pa ba dza ya ā nan+da/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ zhu ston sa skya pa/ jo btsun grags pa seng ge rgya ston sgrub pa po/ rgya ston grub mchog bla ma rdo rje dpal/ khro phu sems dpa' chen po man 'dra/ yang na khro phu ba nas/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ bu ston man 'dra/ yang na grub mchog pa nas/ dpal seng pa/ sprul sku rgyal tsha/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje dpal nas/ gzhon nu seng ge brag ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de sras kun mkhyen bu ston man 'dra'o// spyir/ chu yis dbang bskur cod paṇa dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags// zhes gsungs kyang dmigs kyis bsal ba bya rgyud kyi cho ga chung ba rgya gar nas 'gyur ba 'ga' dang 'di nyid kyi dkyil chog bzhir slob ma'i dbang lnga phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang dang bcas pa mdzad mod rnal 'byor rgyud dang 'khrul bar mi bya'o// ༈ //paṇa chen ngag dbang chos ngag chos dang byang gling pa gnyis kyis mdzad pa zhes rmor pa'i gsan yig tu byung*/ grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/

kha che rin chen rdo rje/ bram ze sadz+dza na/ jo bo te dza de ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ g.yor po jo ston/ pur bsod nams rin chen/ 'jad phu ba pad+ma bkra shis/ stag pa jo bzang*/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal bzang*/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu ba bsod nams seng ge yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po rin chen rnam rgyal/ grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ rdo ring kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ kun mkhyen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ thugs sras 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel/ ngag dbang tshul khrims bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang bsod nams dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ a wa dhū tī pa/ jo bo rje/ lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge rong pa 'gar dge 'jad gyang phu ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ rgyal tsha chos kyi dbang phyug rong pa shes rab seng ge bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ rje btsun sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ grub chen dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje sa chen man 'dra/ yang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/

mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong pas gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni 'og rnam sras kyi skabs ltar dang*/ yang mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub pas chos rje bstan pa rgyal mtshan pa'i ngor mdzad pa'i phyag rdor gos sngon can 'gro bzang lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas zur phyung mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub pa yan chad ni rnam thos sras dang sbags sgrub skabs kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par thos so// ༈ //thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ a bha yā ka ra/ shu bhaṃ ka ra/ pū dza ti/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ gau taṃ shrī/ kīrti paṇ+ḍi ta/ yar lung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan rin chen/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge bla ma mgon po 'bum pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ mtshungs med bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje lhun grub dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na lhun grub dpal ldan nas/ ldan ma mkhas btsun kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag la'o// yang na lhun grub dpal ldan nas/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na ngor chen/ 'jam dbyangs sher rgyam/ 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/

rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang 'di gnyis gang rung*/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas phun tshogs man 'dra'o// rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi lung yang thos so// 'di gur nas gsungs pa'i bla med du bzhed pa'ang yod de/ de'i brgyud pa ni 'og tu 'byung ngo*// ༈ //mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas so'i sngags 'chang snye mdo shākya dpal la gsang ba'i bdag pos dngos su gnang ba'i gur nas gsungs pa dang 'brel pa'i phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang me'i dbang dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba sems dpa' sum brtsegs mar grags pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ sngags 'chang shākya dpal ba/ bla chen chos dpal ba/ chos rje rin chen dpal bzang*/ mkhas pa lha dbang blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ khyab bdag mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ 'di phyin gyi brgyud pa ma rnyed pas slar bzo/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na bsod nams dpal ldan nas/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na lha dbang blo gros nas/ dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mchog legs rdo rje khu dbon man 'dra'o// ༈ //thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang byed tshul gyi yi ge la brten nas gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje u tsār+ya'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra go mi/ rgyal po dharmā pha la/ bla ma zangs gling pa/ khams pa a seng*/ jo sras gnyal pa rin chen 'od/

'di la gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun du bla ma bya nag pa yin 'dra zhes snang*/ bla ma dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ jo sras stag la me 'bar/ ston grags zho rwa ba/ bla ma don zhabs pa/ bla ma lha rje/ slob dpon chos grags/ e pa 'khon ston/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma rgyal 'od/ slob dpon smra ba'i seng ge chos rje byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chos rje bsod nams rab rgyas/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs bral bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de las bdag gis legs par mnos so// yang na ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na khams pa a seng nas/ zhang ston dkon mchog ru smon mkhar ba/ skyi ston ru zhang*/ dkon mchog blo gros/ slob dpon chos grags man 'dra/ yang na lo tsā ba mchog ldan nas/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ bya sder ba byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra'o// yang na mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rat+na war+dha/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ //phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'di gter ma'i lugs yin yang phyag rdor rnams phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir 'dir bris/

chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku phyag na rdo rje/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug sprul sku shākya seng ge sprul sku shākya 'bum/ rin chen byang chub rdo rje/ chos rje stag pa ba/ zur dben pa chos bzang bla ma/ mnyam med bde legs rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ mkhas mchog lha dbang blo gros/ rje btsun sangs rgyas seng ge byams pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen bsod nams dpal ldan/ kun mkhyen tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag la'o// yang na mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ mnga' bdag nyang ral nas brgyud de/ sngags 'chang rdo rje bzang po/ rdo ring kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog rdo ring pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos gter dkon mchog legs pa/ mkhan grub pa man 'dra'o// ༈ //rdo rje'i 'di 'ga' zhig tu spyod pa'i rgyud du 'jog pa'ang yod/ rigs kyi khro bo rnam par 'joms pa mthing nag lha bcu dgu dza ya warma'i lugs sam/ ma ṇi ka badz+ra'i lugs su grags pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil rin chen dbang rgyal gyi steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje/ ngor chen dang thar rtse ba'i gsan yig na mi gsal yang rje mkhyen brtse dang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi gsan yig na snang*/

rje btsun byams pa/ skal ldan gaṅgā dha ra/ bram ze slob dpon ma ti badz+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya warma/ paṇ+ḍi ta dz+nyā na shrī/ lo tsā ba cog gru rab zhi/ bla ma yon tan legs pa/ rje bsam gtan dbang phyug bla ma don grub ye shes/ rje chos kyi blo gros/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje dkon mchog rdo rje/ bla ma dkon mchog rdo rje/ bla ma shes rab 'bum/ rong pa chos kyi mgon po/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ pur bsod nams dbang phyug bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ bya sder ba byang chub gzhon nu/ bya sder ba byams pa rin chen/ bya sder ba byang chub/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// gu ge paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil gyi lung yang nos so// ༈ //'di de sngon ma thob kyang thob 'gyur gyi dbang gis bris/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje'i yi ge'i steng nas rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag po grub chen sa wa ri sa lugs kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dkar po lha bcu dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang ngam rigs gtad legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ grub chen sa wa ri pa/ dza wa ri pa/ de wa pūr+ṇa ma ti/ 'gar lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ gshen ston rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sgang ston shes rab bla ma/ sgang ston shes rab 'bum/

grags pa rdo rje/ go rwa ba dar ma byang chub/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhas pa bsod nams 'phel ba/ byang sems rin chen chos rgyal/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal po/ bla chen chos rig rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dpal 'byor/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba mang thos bsod nams dbang phyug chos kyi rje dpal ldan chos skyong ngam bla ma gang rung zhig de las thos par 'gyur ba tshul khams rin chen zhes bya'o// yang na yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge nas/ bla ma rgyal mtshan mgon/ dharmā kīrti/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rat+na war+dha/ lha mchog seng ge bud+dha singha*/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o// ༈ //thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ba ri lugs lha gcig bum gcig gi rjes su gnang ba/ bkru byab bsrung gsum dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bla ma rin chen dpal/

bla ma byang chub gzhon nu/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug rje dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'jam mgon tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang chen po bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na mtshungs bral bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de las bdag gis so// yang na paṇa chen/ dpal ldan don grub/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ dam chos bsam 'grub man 'dra'o// yang na mus chen/ dkon mchog blo gros/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya lo tsā ba man 'dra'o// ༈ //gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi yum ni mā ma kī dang rigs mchog la sogs te ma byung ngo*// bzhi pa rigs kyi khro bo bdud rtsi thab sbyor sogs dang*/ rigs kyi khro mo 'dod pa'i rdo rje ma sogs kyang ma byung ngo*// lnga pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi pho nya ni khro bo 'chol pa sogs te/ de'ang sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'jad byams pa bkra shis lhun grub pas cung zad bsrings pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas rdo rje'i rigs kyi pho nya khro bo dme ba brtsegs pa dud kha'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal/

paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ gsan yig phal cher du 'di med pa'ang byung*/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma grwa thang pa/ bla ma kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma blo gros dpal/ dge bshes seng ge mkhan po bsod nams shes rab/ mkhan po shes rab mgon/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ rje lha mchog seng ge 'dren mchog sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa bsod nams mtha' yas/ 'jad pa byams pa bkra shis lhun grub/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ nyag bre/ sa skya bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis lhun grub/ de las ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// yang na mkhan chen legs 'byung*/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ 'di nas brgyud pa de sngon ma thob kyang da thob rgyu'i dbang du bris/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas btsun kun dga' rgya mtsho/ de las bdag gis bkru byab bsrung gsum dang bcas pa thob bo// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge rje btsun sgo rum kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug

rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug rmor chen pa man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas rgyal tshab kun dbang*/ mkhan chen legs 'byung*/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na mkhas btsun dge ltag par khro bo'i rgyal po zhal dngos su gzigs pa'i zhal gzigs kyi brgyud pa ni/ mkhas btsun dge ltag pa/ de las rje btsun rin po che grags pas gsan/ de nas sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma grwa thang pa man 'dra/ yang na dge ltag pa nas/ dran bu rin chen grub/ mkhan chen shes rab gzhon nu/ slob dpon dkon mchog mkhar/ ri lung phug pa chos mgon/ lce blo ldan seng ge lce btsun bsod nams dpal/ sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje/ bka' bzhi mnga' ris pa/ pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang yon tan dpal/ bla ma blo bzang pa/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen zhwa lu sku zhang 'dis na len+d+ra'i mkhan po mdzad nas tshes bco brgyad la gshegs pas dus mchod 'dzin pa'i dbon brgyud la bco brgyad par grags/ rab chos rje rin chen mchog grub/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ kha'ur bzhugs/ rje btsun kun dga' legs pa/ jo nang gi mkhan po mdzad/ bo dong du gshegs/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ gnas gsar ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan/ ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis/ rje lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas so// yang na brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ ḍā ki ma seng ge'i gdong can/ gru spang rtse ba rdo rje seng ge chos rje brag nag pa/ byang sems chen po/

bla ma don grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dang*/ be bug pa bde legs rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos rgyal bsod nams bkra shis/ mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/ rje dkon mchog tshul khrims/ 'gos ston rdo rje seng ge mnga' ris ru thog pa nam mkha' gzi brjid/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs man 'dra/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i dme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs/ las tshogs smyo 'bog 'don pa/ ser ba bzlog pa/ rims gso ba/ phyugs kyi god kha gcod pa/ phyugs nad gso ba/ mi nad bsrung ba/ ra lug la spyang ki bsrung ba/ 'bras phol lhog pa gso ba/ nad pa'i sngas bsrung*/ zhing gi 'bu bsrung*/ sris rme ba/ 'gong po bsreg pa dang bcas pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mchog legs rdo rje brgyud par bzhugs pa dang 'dra'o// rje bsod nams lhun grub kyi rjes gnang bya tshul grib mdos dang bcas pa'i lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje bsod nams lhun grub/ de dbon ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ drin can mkhyen rab bla ma/ rmor chen pa kun dga' lhun grub/ chos rje kun dga' rnam rgyal/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas jo bo lugs kyi dme brtsegs ljang nag gi rjes su gnang ba bkru byab dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ jo bo a ti sha nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa brtson 'grus 'bar/ mkhan po chos dbang phyug mkhan po chos kyi byang chub/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shākya/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas/ dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/

spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ dam pa kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen 'jam dpal dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// yang na mkhan po chos kyi byang chub/ mkhas btsun tshul khrims rin chen/ bla ma dar ma bzang po/ rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan don grub/ rje gtsang pa rin rgyal/ bya btang bo dhi satwa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen grags pa/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho man 'dra/ yang na mkhan po chos dbang phyug nas/ mkhan po zur phu ba/ slob dpon dkon mchog seng ge bla ma dar ma bzang po/ chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bla ma don grub rgyal mtshan/ chos rje gtsang pa rin rgyal/ bya btang bo dhi satwa/ slob dpon 'jam dbyangs rin chen grags pa/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang man 'dra/ yang na bya 'dul 'dzin nas/ na bza' phred gsol ba chos kyi byang chub/ mkhan po chos kyi dbang phyug

bya 'dul gyi dbon po/ mkhan chen chos kyi brtson 'grus/ bla ma dar ma bzang po man 'dra/ 'di'i las tshogs grib bsrung ba/ ser ba bsrung ba/ rims nad bsrung ba/ phyugs nad bsrung ba/ mi lo nad can bsrung ba/ ra lug la spyang ki bsrung ba/ 'bras phol lhog pa gso ba/ nad pa'i sngas bsrung*/ zhing gi 'bu srin bsrung ba/ bang mdzod bsrung ba/ 'gong po bsreg pa/ dme grib bsrung thabs dang bcas pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho yan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ de nas mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ rgyal rtse ba ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ chos rje kun dga' rnam rgyal/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //lnga pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi pho nya mo ni blo gros rdo rje ma dang*/ rdo rje dril bu ma la sogs pa ste/ 'dir 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang dam pa'i phyag len la brten nas khro mo dme brtsegs kyi rjes su gnang ba lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ ḍā ki ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ gru spang rtse ba rdo rje seng ge chos rje brag nag pa/ byang sems chen po/ bla ma dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dar/ be phug pa bde legs rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ bla ma gnyis tsam btsal/ de nas mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ de las mus pa'i dge bshes tshul khrims kyis gsan nam snyam/ de nas drin chen rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la lan mang du stsal to// yang na mkhyen brtse'i zhabs nas/

'phags mchog byams pa skal ldan bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra'o// bya rgyud rdo rje'i rigs su mthun bsdebs pa'i// de bzhin gshegs dang rigs kyi bdag po yum// khro bo pho nya dga' ma'i zlos gar gyis// dngos grub la gor stsol ba bcu gsum mo// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste dgu pa'o// //bzhi pa nor can gyi rigs la 'phags pa nor bu bzang po la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi tshogs rnams te/ 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang byed tshul gyi yi ge la brten nas 'phags pa dzam bha la ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes su gnang ba yi ge de nyid kyi lung dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa a shwa ka shrī/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ brtse chen kun dga' snying po/ dpal ldan bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'di med pa'ang yod/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na yongs 'dzin nas/

thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o// thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas 'phags pa dzam bha la nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes su gnang ba yi ge'i lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang bshad ma thag pa ltar ro// ༈ //she'u lo tsā ba chen po byams pa kun dga' chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang byed tshul gyi yi ge la brten nas nor can gyi rigs jo bo lugs kyi dzam+bha la dkar po 'brug zhon can lha lnga'i rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo chen po a ti sha lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ bshes gnyen po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ spyan snga bsod nams 'phel/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge sribs ri ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ lha phug pa rin chen 'od zer/ bla ma dpal ldan grub pa/ gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun du sa skya'i gsan yig na mi gsal yang lo pa spyan snga'i gsan yig tu bar 'dir bla ma kha shas ma rnyed tshul 'dug ces snang*/ rin po che sangs rgyas 'od zer/ gtsang pa blo bzang pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya bzang po/ 'di gnyis rje bla ma'i gsan yig tu 'byung ba she'u lo tsā ba'i gsan yig nas kha bskang*/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa bud+dha lak+ṣ+mī'i gsan yig tu 'di'i tshab tu ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje byung*/ kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs/

bka' drin mnyam med rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis thob bo// yang na kun dga' bstan 'dzin nas/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ de las bdag gis legs par nos so// lung la phyi chu sbyin la brten nas bsgrub pa/ nang gtor ma la brten nas bsgrub pa/ gsang ba ga'u la brten nas bsgrub pa/ thugs rje chen pos spyan nas dzam+bha la sprul te jo bo la gnang ba'i lo rgyus rjes gnang gi yi ge bstod pa spyan ras gzigs dbang ma/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgom bzlas rjes gnang byed tshul bcas rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rmor chen pa yan gong dang 'dra la/ de nas ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis gsan nam brtag de nas rtse gdong sprul pa'i sku rin po che/ mnga' ris pa bsod nams blo gros/ chos rje ting 'dzin rdo rje/ des bdag la stsal to// ༈ //'dul ba lung las/ rgyal chen sde bzhi po mkha' lding sgra snyan dang sgra chung*/ klu dbugs dang dbugs chen du gyur pa na bzhi gas sangs rgyas 'od srungs la yon tan shes nas dad de bslab pa'i gzhi bzung nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la 'jig rten skyong bar smon lam btab pa'i mthu btsan pos bstan pa rin po che skyong ba la 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir yongs su grags shing mkhas grub mang pos chos skyong gi gtso bor mdzad pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam mang thos pa'i sras 'di nyid kyi gzi brjid ma bzod par lha min gyi dpung phyir log par brten/ lha rnams ngal bsos pas ngal bsos po dang*/ lha min gyis g.yul bshams pa'i tshe seng ge khros pa la zhon nas srungs pas gnas srung po dang*/ dug sprul chen por sprul nas lha min dbang po ra rgod kyi dmag rnams myos par byas pas lus ngan po zhes sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang por grags shing*/

mu stegs kyi sprang po nyi ma'i dngos grub sogs bsgral bar dka' ba mang po tshar bcad pas mthu rtsal che ba/ tshe dang dpal 'byor sogs 'dod dgu'i char chen po 'bad med du stsol ba'i lha mchog 'di nyid kyi chos skor bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gyi lo paṇa rnams las brgyud pa mtha' klas par bzhugs pa las/ thog mar thams cad mkhyen pa chen po ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gtor chog rjes gnang bya tshul gyi yi ge rnams kyi steng nas phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs dang rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sbags sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ te dza de wa/ kha chen dgon pa ba/ mtshan 'phags pa shes rab/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ gsang mtshan dpa' bo rdo rje/ g.yor po jo ston/ bcur byung*/ pur bsod nams rin chen/ 'byid phu ba pad+ma bkra shis/ lha rje jo bzang*/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu ba bsod nams seng ge bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ jo nang paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ rje btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan chos skyong*/

de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis lan gnyis kyi bar du mnos so// yang na khro phu ba bsod nams seng ge nas/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge kun mkhyen bu ston/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ yang na bu ston rin po che/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub dpal bzang*/ slob dpon rin chen dpal grub/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po/ sa skya lo tsā ba man 'dra'o// yang na phyag na rdo rje/ kā ma rū pa/ kah+ṇa pa/ 'gro bzang snying po/ rin chen rdo rje/ bram ze sadz+dza na/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ zhu ston sa skya pa/ grags pa seng ge rgya ston grub pa po/ dpal yin nam/ grub mchog rdo rje dpal/ khro phu ba bsod nams seng ge man 'dra'o// der ma zad rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi bka' srol zab cing rgya che ba'i gdams pa bzhugs pa rnams dus dbang gis chos par rlom pa phal cher mi chos kyi zhar la lha chos 'grub tu re ba'i le lo dang rnam par g.yeng ba'i dbang gis nub tu nye ba na/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rnam par thar pa bzhin rnam thos sras bka' mi 'dra ba bco lnga tsam gyi chos skor gsan zhing*/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i rgyun ma nyams pa rnams legs par thob pa la/ 'di nyid kyi gong gnon du phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang mdzad pa'i srol ltar mnos pa ni gong du smos zin cing*/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos rgyud dang man ngag la brten nas rgyal po ngal bsos po zhi ba nor du bsgrub pa dang drag byed mthu ru bsgrub pa'i cho ga sogs mdzad pa las thog mar zhi ba bde byed ser po lha dgu zangs dkar ba nas brgyud pa stod lugs smad lugs kyi brgyud pa chu bo gnyis 'dres las/ phyag len gyi rim pa smad lugs chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i bzhed srol gtso che bar mdzad la/
