der ma zad rjes gnang lnga phrag gsum gyi cho ga so so'i lugs srol nyams pa med pa rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi phyag len bzhin/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis chog khrigs su mdzad pa'i nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyan phreng gi steng nas legs par thos pa yin zhing*/ bsgrig rim thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gsan yig gi go rim ltar bkod pa la/ rnam sras kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa zhi ba bde byed ser po lha dgu'i rjes su gnang ba/ 1 'di dang 'brel bar shin tu gnyan pa slob ma dam ldan bsnyen song re re tsam las mang por mi gnang ba'i drag po'i rjes gnang shin tu gnyan cing bka' rgya dam pa/ zangs dkar ba'i gong khug sro ma can las byung ba'i gsang sgrub ljang ser be con can/ yum pad+ma gtsug phud ma ste/ yab yum gnyis kyi rjes gnang stod lugs las 'ongs pa/ 2 slob dpon klu sgrub kyis sprang po nyi ma'i dngos grub bsgral ba'i drag byed rta sngon bdud mo bzhis bskor lha lnga'i rjes gnang*/ rnam sras dmar po'i skor dang rnying ma bka' gter nas bshad pa rnams bla med du gtogs kyang 'dir sde tshan gyi dbang gis phyogs gcig tu bkod do// 3 de nyid la cung zad kha bsgyur cing rgyal chen bzhi bsnan pa'i nang ma mo ltar bsgrub pa lha dgu'i rjes gnang*/ 4 gnubs kyis bsgyur ba'i bai shra wa ṇa kha rag khram thogs nag po'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i drag po mthu ru bsgrub pa'i nang nas drag byed seng zhon klu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i rjes gnang*/ 5 de nyid la cung zad kha bsgyur ba bzhon pa med pa'i drag byed rkang thang lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na mi gsal yang*/ chog sgrigs gnyis ka na 'dug cing phyag len la'ang mdzad/ 6 gsang ba gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa mdung dmar can lha bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang*/

kha rag khram thogs kyi rgyud na mu stegs nyi ma sgrub pa dang bha ri ha'i grong khyer gzhom pa'i ched du slob dpon nā gārdzu na'i thugs nas rgyud bton par bshad pas sprang po nyi ma'i dngos grub bsgral ba'i chos skyong yang 'di yin nam snyam/ 7 bram ze su pa tos zhag gsum la mu stegs pa bco lnga bsgral ba'i yang gsang drag po srin po bzhis bskor gtso 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang*/ 8 shu raṃ ga warma'i lugs kyi rnam sras mthing kha zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum gyis 'khril ba gtso 'khor bco lnga pa'i rjes gnang*/ 9 rnam sras dmar ser las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor gnyis kyi rjes gnang*/ 10 gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud nas sras gar mkhan mchog gur kum gzhon 'di la rjes gnang med/ nu'i mdangs can zhal bzhi phyag bcu drug pa bstan pa'i shugs la slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po dang kha che rin chen rdo rje sogs kyis bkral ba'i gar mkhan mchog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang*/ 11 de la cung zad kha bsgyur ba gar mkhan mchog dmar smug zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa yum bcas kyi rjes gnang*/ 12 rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel lha dgu'i rjes gnang*/ 13 lha sras mu tig btsan po dang blon po zhang lha bzang klu dpal gnyis bha da hor gyi sgom gra bcom pa'i dmag la 'byon skabs dpal o ḍ+yān chen pos gnang ba'i rnam sras zhi drag gnyis las zhi ba ljang yul ma'am sprin gseb mar grags pa ser chen lha dgu'i rjes gnang*/ 14 drag po yang gsang mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa las mkhan dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor gnyis kyi rjes gnang*/ 15 rgyal ba stag lung pa nas brgyud pa'i rnam sras rigs chen brgyad du grags pa'i nang nas/ rnam sras dmar po gsung mchog lus ngan po snyan grags sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang*/ stang lung pa'i yi ge'i steng nas a pa ra tsi ta dkar po dpa' gcig gi rjes su gnang ba rnams legs par nos nas rgyab brten lung gi skor la/

gnod sbyin gyi sde dbon chen po gar mkhan mchog gi rtog pa/ (dbang )brtag pa gnyis dang le'u bcu drug pa kha che'i mkhas pa chen po dha na gup+ta dang rab zhi lo tsā bas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang mtho gling 'dzam gling rgyan du bsgyur ba/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las sna tshogs sgrub pa le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi rgyud rin chen 'byung ba le'u bcu dgu pa rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta kha che dgon pa ba dang lo tsā ba mnga' ris pa ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ sna tshogs dag pa'i rgyud le'u sum cu pa slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa zangs dkar lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ 'di gleng gzhi'i skabs slob dpon gang gis mdzad na 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad ces dang rgyud kyi rdzogs mtshams su mdzad pa po bshad pa mthun par byung yang skye rgyud kyi le'u'i skabs slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la zhus par bshad pa cung zad 'gal ba ltar snang yang gsung ba po phyag na rdo rje dang 'gro bzang snying pos de'i bka' bsdus par mdzad pa'i sgra bshad pa 'dra'o/

rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis kyi bar du sna tshogs dag pa'i rgyud le'ur nyer dgu pa dang 'gro bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gser 'od 'bar ba gnyis 'dug kyang dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/ 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa'i zhi ba bde byed lha dgu'i sgrub thabs gser 'od 'bar ba'i ṭī ka sems can dbul ba rnams kyi don du zhi ba nor sgrub las sbyor dang bcas pa bshad zin to'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras drag byed seng zhon khros pa'i phrin las sgrub tshul bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig gi mtha' can/ 'khor klu brgyad kyis ma bskor bar sgrol byed nag po/ khyab 'jug lha mo dpal tshul gnod sbyin gyi dmag dpung dang bcas pa snang ngo*/ des mdzad pa'i rnam thos sras bde byed kyi rtog pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can paṇ+ḍi ta te dza de wa dang lo tsā ba dge slong 'phags pa shes rab kyis zhus shing bsgyur ba/ rnam sras ser chen phyag mtshan rin po che'i be con dang ne'u le 'dzin pa zhig snang*/ 'gor bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas zhes yod pa shu raṃ ka warmas mdzad pa'i zhi ba bde byed ser po lha dgu'i man ngag yid bzhin (dbang )nor bu'i sgrub thabs zhes pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ de'i ṭī ka slob dpon shu raṃ ka warmas mdzad pa'i sgrub yig 'di la gnyis te zhes pa 'gor yod pa la zab mo yin pas gsang bar zhu'i mtha' can/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di gnyis kyi bar du bde byed kyi cho ga sna tshogs pa'i mdzod dang dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs thar lo'i 'gyur gnyis 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/ shog dril drug pa zhes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgrub thabs la nang gses kyi sku gdung (kong )rgyal mtshan gyi sgrub thabs te bsnyen pa'i cho ga

gsung chos kyi dung sgrub (kong )pa'i cho ga tsit+ta rin po che thugs (kong )sgrub pa'i cho ga 'chi med yon tan (kong )sgrub pa'i cho ga spu gris bsad (kong )pa phrin las sgrub pa'i cho ga bum pa bzang po'i dngos grub mthar thug bang mdzod sgrub (kong )pa'i cho ga rnams rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta te dza de was mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ de'i gsal byed zangs dkar lo tsā bas mdzad pa la sku gzugs kyi rgyal mtshan (kong )la brten nas rgyal po zhal dngos su blta ba'i shog dril/ gsung dbyangs chos kyi dung la brten (kong )nas snyan grags kyi rgyun sgrub pa'i shog dril/ tsit+ta rin po che thugs kyi sgrub pa la brten nas (kong )rgyal po dang tshangs pa'i bu mo'ang 'gugs pa'i shog dril/ yon tan shel gyi bum par brten nas 'chi med (kong )kyi tshe sgrub pa'i shog dril/ phrin las drag po gnam lcags kyi spu gri la brten nas (kong )dgra srog myur du gcod pa'i shog dril/ mthar thug gter gyi bum pa la brten nas dgos (kong )'dod kun 'byung nam mkha' mdzod bsgrub pa'i shog dril/ mjug tu gang las brgyud (kong )kyi lo rgyus nyung ngu dang 'khor lo bri tshul gyi yig chung dang bcas pa/ 'di gnyis kyi bar du khro los kong bu ri pa la zhus pa'i shog dril drug gi yi ge zur pa zhig rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig tu thebs kyang dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/ bsnyen pa'i gnad snying du dril ba/ sgrub pa'i gnad snying du dril ba/ srog gnad la dbab pa ste don gsum gyi man ngag rnam sras snying dril lam snying dang 'dra ba'i gnad kyi yi ge khra rgya gar du gtsigs po cher byas te rin po che sna lnga'i khu bas bris pas khra bo zhes pa'i ming thogs skad/ bo/ 'di gnyis kyi bar na rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na gnod sbyin brel phongs kyi mnan thabs gur ga de was mdzad pa 'dug kyang dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/

zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i mgul khug mgul khug sro ma can gyi kha gsal ma byung yang dpe dang gsan yig zhus dag pher bas yid ches su byas so/ /sro ma can la rnam sras gser chen gyi gsang sgrub rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa zhes bya ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ rnam sras ljang ser be con ma'i thugs (dbang )sgrub gsang sgrub rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi gsang ba'i man ngag ces par nang gses kyi dngos grub kyi gzhi bzung ba/ rten gzugs pa/ gsham bu bdun gyis dngos grub bsdu ba/ tshe sgrub pa/ bse rag kha 'ching ba dang bcas pa 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa yin gyi mtha' can/ sna tshogs dag pa'i rgyud las gang la dmigs pa'i liṅga yi zhes sogs mnan pa/ rmi ltas/ 'khor lo'i kha chings/ sngags kyi kha chings dang bcas pa'i bse rag 'ching ba shin tu rgyas pa 'gro bzang snying po de skad gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ rgyun du 'grogs par 'dod na rten gsum gzugs pa'i man ngag thams cad 'grub par the tshom med do'i mtha' can/ rten gsum gzugs pa'i man ngag 'khor lo 'dri tshul khyi dmar po'i snying la brten pa'i man ngag gsham bu'i tshul du bzlas so'i mtha' can/ mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na tshar gnyis ma byung yang phyi ma 'di gsal byed du 'dug pas kha phral nas bris pa yin/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rtags ma byung na spogs pa'i cho ga sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtha' can/ spyir gces pa'i man ngag gsum/ bye brag tu gces pa'i man ngag dgu/ sgos su gces pa'i man ngag gcig rnams ston pa zhal gdams rin po che'i phreng ba/ 'gor bsam pa bzhin du bsgrub pa srid pas nyer blangs na zhes yod pa'i rnam sras ser chen gsang sgrub ces pa rten bca' ba/ sgrub thabs bsnyen pa rtags dang bcas ston pa kha che dgon pa ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zab mo yin no'i mtha' can/

'gor gnod sbyin dbang po'i tshe sgrub ni zhes yod pa'i rnam sras dkar po'i tshe sgrub shin tu zab pa i thi'i mtha' can/ rnam thos sras kyi srog 'khor dgos 'dod kun 'byung ngam man ngag dgos 'dod kun 'byung du grags pa la gzhi sgrub rten/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na nang gses rnams gsal kha mi 'dug kyang chos sde'i ming dang gsan yig mthun pas the tshom ma dgos pas zhib par bkod do// gsham bu bdun pa/ tshe sgrub/ bse rag kha chings rnams gong ma dang zhus dag cung zad mi pher ba'i 'dra min gcig rnam thos sras kyi bsad gso gnyis las gnad kyi man ngag shin tu gab pa ma grub na gnad la dbab pa dngos grub ci 'dod ster ro rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rtags med na spogs chog gong dang 'dra min cung zad rgyas pa gsang ba rgya ru/ lcags mkhyid gang pa gyim shang 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ byi ba lo pa/ zangs mkhyid gang pa/ gser gyi bye ba/ sha bo rwa bcu/ rgya ru stod sngon smad dmar/ rkun ma'i lag pa/ rgya'i pags pa rnams la brten nas nor sgrub pa/ phyi gri rgod kyi lag pa/ nang gser gyi byi ba/ gsang ba rgya ru/ yang gsang bse'i ga'u la brten nas nor sgrub pa/ sku 'khar ba/ gsung gtor ma/ thugs tsit+ta/ yon tan rin chen/ phrin las phur pa la brten nas nor sgrub pa/ rnam sras sre thod ma zhar byung spogs chog dang bcas pa/ ri dwags rgya'i pags pa/ rkun ma byi ba 'dra ba'i lag pa/ rgya lcags la brten nas sgrub pa/ gzhan gyi nor 'gugs pa'i man ngag rnams lha sa nas zangs dkar lo tsā bas spyan drangs pa/ ma hā rā dza'i phyag mtshan gnyis kyis phrin las sgrub pa'i dang po rgyal mtshan la (dbang )brten nas rgyal po'i 'khor gyi ma rungs pa rnams kyi bar gcod dang 'khu ldog sel ba/ snyigs dus skye bo dbul zhing phongs pa'i don du ne'u le la brten nas (dbang )nor tshul bzhin du sgrub pa gnyis kha che paṇa chen gyi man ngag

rgyal po'i rjes su 'brang ba'i gtor ma'i man ngag sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bsod nams bskyed pa'i thabs jo bo rjes zangs dkar lo tsā bar gnang ba the tshom med do'i mtha' can/ 'gor lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i shes pa dkar po'i srog 'khor mnan thabs bar gcod med par myur du 'grub bo'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin bse gdong can mnan thabs srog dang 'dra bas shin tu zab kyi mtha' can/ 'gor rgyab 'dre bkar ba'i thabs bstan pa zhes yod pa'i gnod sbyin shes pa dkar po mnan thabs gal che gsung ngo'i mtha' can/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na dam sri kha chings dang brel phongs mnan pa gnyis 'dug sngar song zin pa de las zur pa ma rnyed pas lung ma thob/ gsung rten bca' zhing dkyil 'khor 'dri ba/ rdzas bsag pa/ lha bsgom sngags bzla/ dngos grub blang ba/ gnad la bor ba ste don lnga'i sgo nas bstan pa'i gsang sgrub ljang gu be con can pa'i yi ge zangs dkar lo tsā bas mdzad pa mgul khug sro chung ma/ 'di rnam sras rang gis tshur gsungs pa'i gdams pa thugs zin snying gi bu la'ang gser srang phyed kyi 'bul ba med par mi sbyin pa/ rnam sras ljang nag spu gri dang tsit+ta 'dzin pa seng ge la chibs pa rgyal po 'di'i las mkhan dmar po zhub can bse mdung dang spu gri 'dzin pa bya khra la chibs pa zhes snang ngo*// rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na de'i yig chung zangs dkar lugs/ chen po nang lugs su sgrub pa zhes bya ba zangs dkar gyi thugs dam ma/ bstod pa 'jig rten dbang phyug ma/ dngos grub kyi rdzas nyi shu rtsa bdun 'bul ba tshigs bcad ma khro los mdzad pa/ bram ze nag pos mdzad pa'i bstod pa thugs rje'i ba 'jo ma bzhi dpe ma 'byor bas lung ma byung*/ 'gor sangs rgyas stong gi gsang ba'i mdzod ces yod pa'i gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa kun mkhyen bu'i gsung rgyun/

des blo gros seng ge'i don du mdzad (dbang )pa'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ des mdzad pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi bstod pa rgyal po thugs mnyes par byed pa zhes bya ba/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i zhal shes bshes gnyen (dbang )'brom ston bkra shis seng ge'i ngor thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i srog 'khor gyi zhal shes tshar lugs kyi khyad chos 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i phyag bris las bshus pa/ 'di la phyag len dmar 'khrid kyi brgyud pa las lung rgyun med do// thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i zhi ba bde byed ser po'i bstod pa/ (dbang )yi ge ma mo la spel ba rnam dag chos dbyings ma/ des mdzad pa'i drag byed nag po la bstod pa/ (dbang )yi ge ma mo la spel ba gang thugs gnyis med ma/ spos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i chos (ra)skyong rnam thos sras kyi sngon byung lo rgyus/ des mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga chen (ra)mo/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang gsham du mtshan ma smos par rgyal po chen po'i gtor chen 'di/ bdag gis legs par sbyar ba yi// dge bas sems can thams cad la// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog ces yod pa/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig tu 'di gnyis kyi bar na phyag rdor gsang ba'i mtshan brgyad kyi bstod pa zhes pa 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor pas ma thob/ des mdzad pa'i man ngag gi skor la gsang (ra)rten ga'u la brten nas chos skyong khyi ltar 'khrid pa'i man ngag khang bzang dang sku la brten nas (ra)zhi ba nor du bsgrub pa/ srog gi (ra)'khor lo'i bri yig phyag mtshan ne'u le'i las sbyor (ra)thun mong ma yin pa/ btsun mo me tog gtsug phud (ra)kyi las sbyor/ skyes dar ma'i rus pa/ bud med kyi phang lo/ skyer phur/ kham phor rnams la (ra)brten nas dbang du bsdu ba/ ltas ngan sna tshogs gtong ba/

gdan seng ge'i las (ra)tshogs zab mo/ chos skyong gi phyir (ra)'brang shes pa dkar po bkar ba rnams/ des mdzad pa'i rang ngam 'khor la mi (ra)ma yin gyi gnod pa bsrung ba'i man ngag 'brom sde nyi ma'i lugs kyi rnam sras skor gyi nor sgrub la/ rgyal po chen po ser chen lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa/ 'bring*/ bsdus pa/ shin tu bsdus pa rnams gcig tu bsdoms pa gnod sbyin ('brom)nor gnas kyi sgrub thabs rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ rdza'i ga'u la brten nas rnam sras chig sgrub man ('brom)ngag nor gnas kyi sgrub par grags pa/ rdza'i ga'u la brten nas rgyal po chen ('brom)po rnam sras gser chen gnod sbyin brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sgrub thabs g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa dang mchan khung na be con bsnams pa zhig 'dug lag pa la brten nas bsgrub pa ('brom)lag sgrub srin po'i nor len/ rkyal pa la brten nas bsgrub ('brom)pa ne'u le rdzas kyi nor bu/ snying la brten nas bsgrub pa snying sgrub ('brom)rig pa'i nor len rnams/ sri'u gso ba'i skor la/ dang po ma chags pa chags par byed ('brom)pa'i srid pa skye gnas kyi srog shing*/ lte ba bur bsgyur cing dgos pa ('brom)srid bsgyur gyi man ngag mo 'dre 'dul ba bsen mo ('brom)'dre 'dul gyi gdams pa/ log 'dren 'dul ba rgyal 'gong ('brom)'dul byed kyi gdams pa rnams/ dbang du bsdu ba la/ pho mo gnyis ka dbang du ('brom)bya ba nor sgrub gsang ba'i man ngag chings dang gsan yig la 'di ltar snang yang man ngag la pho dbang du bya ba zur du mi 'dug pho rigs mo rigs so sor dbang*/ ('brom)du bya ba/ skyes pa dang 'bral ('brom) 'di gsum gsan yig na zur du mi gsal yang man ngag gi dkyus su snang*/ mi phod par byed pa/ mo gsham la bu skye ba/ bu dang ('brom)sha ma 'byin pa rnams/

zhi byed kyi skor la/ ma zhu ba/ mgo nad/ mig nad/ rgyu nad/ lhog pa'i nad ('brom)rnams zhi bar byed pa/ yan lag bcu drug pa/ yan lag drug pa/ yan lag bzhi pa/ yan lag brgyad pa/ yan lag sum cu rtsa bzhi pa rnams kyi dud pa la ('brom)brten nas bgegs thams cad bsrung zhing bgegs las rgyal bar byed pa rnams/ drag po mthu'i skor la/ chos sde gcig la don rnam pa lnga ('brom)bstan pa'i khyi dkar thod pa la brten pa'i srog mthu gnod sbyin lag ring*/ bya pha waṃ gi mgo la brten ('brom)pa'i ltas ngan pho nya bya mgo sha g.yag gtsod kyi rwa la brten pa'i ('brom)bzlog pa lha 'dre'i kha chings/ mdzo'i rwa co dang mdzo'i lag pa sogs la brten ('brom)pa'i khang sel rwa bzhi lag bzhi/ phag thod la brten ('brom)pa'i gtad 'phung byed kyi skor dang bcas pa/ de dag spyi la 'jug pa'i las byang don brgyad ma rnams slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ('brom)bas mdzad pa/ yid ches pa brgyud pa'i lo rgyus man ('brom)ngag gi chings dang bcas pa/ 'di skor gyi man ngag mang por bud+dha gup+tas mdzad zer ba 'dug pa sangs rgyas gsang ba'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs las slob dpon gzhan du yid 'khrul bar mi bya'o// gsang sgrub kyi man ngag gong khug sro ma can du gtogs pa gnod sbyin rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi gsang (be)sgrub don drug gis bstan pa le'u gsum pa zhar byung rgyal po'i man ngag dang bcas pa thugs sgrub gsang ba ma nor ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rnam thos sras srog gi sgrub pa zhes pa dkyil 'khor (be)dang rdzas bsham pa sgrub pa dngos dang bcas pa rin chen gser 'dra'i nor sgrub tu grags pa zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i gser chos bslabs na lan tshwa chu shor 'dra'i mtha' can/ gsang sgrub kyi phyag len bum (be)pa longs spyod kyis gang ba'i steng du lha sgom pa'i mtha' can/

rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na mgul khug sro ma can zhes pa las chos tshan gyi ming dang gsal kha mi 'jug kyang gsum po 'di gong khug ma yin nges dang gzhan ma ma rnyed cing kha che dgon pa ba'i be bug bse khab ma zer ba dpe ma 'byor pas lung ma thob/ bai shra ma ṇa kha rag khram thogs nag po'i rgyud le'u (klu)sum cu so lnga pa 'phung byed shān+tiṃ gar+bha dang bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs sangs rgyas rin po ches bsgyur ba/ rgyal po lus ngan po srog gi gshed ma 'di la spyi don drug gis bstan pa (klu)slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bdud mo bzhis bskor gyi gdams pa/ mgon po gar mkhan mchog dmar smug zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa'i sgrub (kha)thabs slob dpon chen po kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa zangs dkar gyi 'gyur/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na bar 'dir 'grel pa 'dug pa dpe ma byung bas lung ma thob/ de'i ngag 'don 'gor skad shan sbyar gyis gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po'i sgrub (kha)thabs zhes pa yod pa'i rin chen char pa rgyun chad med 'bab shog gi mtha' can/ spyan 'dren dad pa dam tshig (kha)ma/ sgrub thabs dang mthun par rtags (kha)kyi bstod pa/ sgrub thabs dang mthun pa'i (kha)bskul sngon gyi bskal pa ma dang bcas pa/ rnam sras dkar po lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga (shā)dang bcas pa paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa/ au ḍ+yān chen pos lha sras dang zhang gnyis la gnang ba'i rnam sras srin gseb mar grags pa'i skor la/ lo rgyus ldan ma rtse mang (ljang )gis yi ger btab pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rjes gnang gi cho ga dam tshig rnams bsrung ba (ljang )la brtson par gyis shig gi mtha' can/ klong yangs rin chen gter gyi rgyud las bstan pa'i sgrub (ljang )thabs las kyi dngos grub stsal tu gsol gyi mtha' can/ rdo rje srid rgyal gyi sgo nas (ljang )nyams grib nad dang bar chad thams cad sel ba'i cho ga

'joms byed khyi mgo can gyi sgo nas srid (ljang )pa gsum gyi mtshon kha 'ching ba'i mtshon bsrung*/ klu mo pad+ma 'dzin gyi (ljang )sgo nas nor sgrub pa/ kun tu rgyu nor (ljang )'dzin gyi sgo nas zas nor longs spyod sgrub pa/ rdo rje drag po rtsal (ljang )gyi sgo nas dgra bsad pa/ mche chug dred mgo can gyi sgo (ljang )nas mnan pa bya ba/ 'phrog byed sprel mgo can (ljang )gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ gar dbang khyung mgo can (ljang )gyi sgo nas gnod sbyin 'dul ba/ theg chen spang dred (ljang )mgo'i sgo nas ser ba dbab pa/ dpa' bo rgyal 'ug pa'i (ljang )mgo can gyi sgo nas bskrad pa/ de dag gi dam tshig bstan (ljang )pa dang bcas pa/ 'di'i mjug na rnam sras sprin gseb ma gter ma rdzogs so zer ba 'dug kyang deng sang 'di rnying ma bka' mar ngos 'dzin mdzad pa yin/ mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i skor la gnod sbyin (bzhi)dbyug to can gyi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ 'di la slob dpon pad+ma'i rgya dpe las gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ras bsgyur ba/ li yul du slob dpon bi ma la mi tra dang lo tsā ba bai ro tsa nas bsgyur ba dang*/ rgya nag tshe spong klu bza' dang rgyal mo g.yu sgras bsgyur ba sogs 'gyur mang*/ de'i le'u mtha' ma'i tshe sgrub (bzhi)kyi gsal byed slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis khro phu lo tsā bas bya rgod gshongs nas gter nas spyan drangs pa yin/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras dmar po'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod kun 'byung (bzhi)mthar thug 'dzad med mdzod la spyod par shog gi mtha' can/ gsang yum ma trag bzhi'i zhal gdams la nang gses kyi 'gor don grub (bzhi)thugs sras rgyal po rnam thos sras zhes yod pa'i yi ge rnam sras srog len gyi yig sna las sbyor dmar po'i zhal (bzhi)gdams su grags pa/ yang rnam thos sras dmar po srog len gyi yig sna (bzhi)snying la sbos shig gi mtha' can/

gsang yum bzhi'i zhal (bzhi)gdams snying gar zangs kyi rtsibs bzhi zhes yod pa/ mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na gsang yum gyi zhal gdams zhes pa las so so'i gsal kha mi 'dug mdung dmar can gyi sgrub thabs (bzhi)mkhan chen chos 'phags bzang pos rol 'bum gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba/ 'gor rnam thos sras dmar po snang ba mtha' yas bzhi gsung gi sprul pa zhes yod pa'i tshe sgrub/ rnam thos sras srog rtsa yid bzhin nor bu'i (bzhi)sgrub thabs yig chung*/ gnad la dbab pa 'gor ma trag bzhi'i yig sna las zhes yod pa'i (bzhi)zhal shes bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo'i mtha' can/ mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig tu 'di gnyis kyi bar na sngags kyi thems yig 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/ bsgrub bya'i rtsa gsum 'dus (bzhi)pa zhes yod pa'i gnad yig gsang ba/ 'gor rnam sras dmar po'i srog sgrub ces yod pa'i rten (bzhi)gtor ri rab ma bca' ba'i zhal gdams dngos grub blang ba dang bcas pa/ bar 'dir gsan yig na zas nor sgrub pa zhig 'dug pa dpe ma rnyed pas lung ma byung*/ sgab 'dre shes pa dkar po bse byang (bzhi)la brten nas mnan thabs/ gsan yig na stag mda'i sgrub thabs dang nor rten 'dzugs pa 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/ ma 'grub na ha ya grī wa'i sgo nas (bzhi)dbang du bsdus te gnad la dbab pa/ ma 'chun na 'jun (bzhi)pa'i man ngag gud na gso (bzhi)bar byed pa/ gsan yig na 'di gsum so sor mi gsal 'dug kyang don du sde tshan gcig 'gor rnam thos sras snying gi ze'u 'bru zhes yod pa'i bsnyen pa (bzhi)dang las sbyor gyi zhal gdams nam grags pas mdzad pa/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad (bo)pa'i gtor chog dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ des mdzad (bo)pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rgyal chen mdung dmar can gyi las tshogs 'khor lo'i bri yig la/

gri snying (bzhi)'khor lo/ snang ba dbang sdud kyi (bzhi)tsakra mu khyud drug pa/ gtor ma rin chen spungs (bzhi)pa'i 'khor lo/ bla rdo'i (bzhi)'khor lo/ ga'u'i (bzhi)'khor lo/ bse rag 'gong po (bzhi)mnan 'khor/ bse rag gi ltas dang (bzhi)mnon thabs sngar song ba de dang 'dra min zhig snang yang chos sde 'di kha'i dkyus su 'dug kha (bzhi)chings/ bse rag kha chings (bzhi)kyi man ngag lhan thabs/ srog 'khor dang dbang sdud/ (bzhi)'khor lo 'dri tshul bsdus pa/ snang ba dbang sdud (bzhi)kyi tsakra mu khyud lnga dang bcas pa/ mdung dmar can gyi sgrub yig (bzhi)nag po 'gro shes 'phags dbon gzhung lugs rab 'byams pas mdzad pa/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ba'i rgyud (gnubs)le'u bcu gnyis pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po kun skyong gis gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gtad pa/ rgyud de la brten nas phyi dkar (gnubs)po ging du bsgrub pa/ nang nag po bdud (gnubs)du bsgrub pa/ gsang ba yid bzhin nor bur bsgrub (gnubs)pa rnams mkhan po kun skyong gis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub (gnubs)thabs gsum gyi rtags yig des mdzad pa'i las byang (gnubs)ri rgyal lhun po ma rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rnam thos sras seng ge bu bdun du grags pa'i skor la/ 'gor rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi man ngag 'di la don rnam pa bdun las zhes yod pa'i drag po spyi sgrub drag sngags kyi sgrub rgyud/ seng ge bu bdun dregs pa'i spyi sgrub kyi bskul ri rgyal lhun po ma/ rnam sras seng ge bu bdun gyi las byang gcig tu dril ba sgos bskul shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ dregs pa yongs dril gyi man ngag don rnam pa gsum gyis bstan pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ ngan sngags drag po yongs dril gyi ngan sngags la brten nas dgra bsad pa/ de'i bskul mi mngon dbyings bzhugs ma rnams gnod sbyin shing rta'i rgyud la brten nas slob dpon spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/

'khor gyi las tshogs la yang dag shes la brten nas/ (dbang )mngon shes dang dbang phyug bsgrub pa/ gang ba bzang po la brten nas (dbang )dmag bzlog pa/ nor bu bzang po la brten nas (dbang )zas nor bsgrub pa/ ku be ra la brten nas (dbang )chom rkun 'ching ba/ lngas rtsen la brten nas (dbang )tshe sgrub pa/ dzam+bha la'i dzam bhi ra la brten nas (dbang )skya bo dbang du byed pa/ ne'u le la brten nas (dbang )zas nor bsgrub pa/ ba dan la brten nas (dbang )dmag drang ba dang bzlog pa/ 'brog gnas la brten nas (dbang )dgra bsad pa/ 'jam po 'khyil pa la brten nas (dbang )ser pa bsrung ba rnams khro phu lo tsā ba'i zhal gyi gdams pa/ ku be ra'i byin rlabs la brten nas rta'i god kha bsrung ba/ gnod sbyin stag mda' gdong dang de'i khol mo lha mo nor dpal ma ming sring gi sgrub thabs paṇa chen shākya shrīs mdzad pa bsod nams la rku bas 'di gal che'o'i mtha' can/ 'gor gnod sbyin stag mda'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i gdams pa/ gnod sbyin stag mda' gdong gi sgrub thabs zhes pa bla rdo dmigs pa sngags gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa shākya shrī la mi bskyod rdo rjes zhus pa/ yang de dang stod 'dra ba la smad cung zad nyung ba 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa i thi'i mtha' can/ yang de dang cung zad 'dra min rgyas pa 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na stag mda'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba bzhi zer ba las kha ma phral ba 'dug 'gor de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo zhes yod pa'i gnod sbyin giṅga ra la brten nas mi nor zas gsum bsgrub pa zang zang g.yur rtse'i gter ma zangs dkar gyi khyad chos/ byang phyogs rgyal po'i bka' nyan a pa ra dzi ta rin chen bzang po'am nor bu bzang po zhes dred zhon gyi sgrub thabs in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/

des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs chung ba lag len gyi rim pa rin chen bzang po'i nang du sgrub pa yin gyi mtha' can/ 'gor phyag na rdo rje'i sku la 'dud ces yod pa'i nor bu bzang po a pa ra dkar po dred zhon gyi sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma gsang sgrub gnad kyi zhal gdams rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ las tshogs bcu gsum zhes pa rang don du gzhan las rgyal ba/ bsam pa 'grub pa/ stobs rgyas pa/ mnan gtad/ bcings pa dgrol ba/ dbang du bya ba/ bzlums pa/ gzhan don du pham pa/ 'phung ba/ mnan pa/ bcings pa/ bskrad pa/ dbye ba/ bsad pa rnams/ a pa ra dzi ta'i dngos grub bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gnod sbyin lag spun mnan pa/ mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di'i rjes su 'khor lo sogs kyi zhal gdams/ a pa ra gsum gyi dbye ba/ sgrub thabs mtshal min ngag dbang dgyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa gsum 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor pas lung ma thob/ cho ga phyag len gyi skor la/ 'gor bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes yod pa'i zhi drag spel ba'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrīs mdzad pa mjug tu thugs sras lo tsā ba'i ka bstod le tshan gnyis btags pa/ 'di rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na gsham gyi bstod pa'i mdzad byang la brten nas thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad gsung ba 'dug kyang 'di tsan+d+ra shrīs mdzad nges yin pa khyab bdag zhwa lu pa gsung*/ rnam sras zhi drag sbrel ba'i cho ka bklag chog (dbang )mkhyen rab rje'i phyag len ltar chos rje bco brgyad pa 'jam dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rnam sras rigs mi gcig pa lnga'i sgrub thabs (dbang )gsal bar bstan pa'i dgos pa kun tshang gnyags dbon rin po ches mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i rnam sras zhi drag rnams mchod (dbang )pa'i cho ga rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba/ rnam sras zhi drag rnams kyi mchod chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa skyor mo lung pa mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang gi mchod g.yog nam mkha' seng ges mdzad pa

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na nam mkha' grags zhes snang ba yig skyon shor ram snyam/ rnam sras ser chen gyi gtor chog mchod phreng bstod pa dang bcas pa stag tshang lo chen shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ 'gor dngos grub chen po sgrub pa'i dus zhes yod pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi gsang mdos kha che dgon pa bas mdzad pa/ rnam thos sras kyi gsang mdos rgyas pa kha che'i rigs kyi mkhan po gzi brjid lha dang paṇ+ḍi ta te tsa de wa dang bod kyi lo tsā ba zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyis kha che khri brtan du bsgyur ba/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na bar 'dir gsang mdos chung ba zhig 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/ au ḍ+yān chen po pad+mas khram thogs nag po'i rgyud dang yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi gsang mdos sam stong mdos rgyal po'i dpung bzlog chen mo bal po ba su dha ra la gnang*/ des gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang ba nyug gi rdo rje sgrom bu la gter du sbas pa/ phyogs bzhir drag po'i g.yal bzlog dmag dpon gyi mdos rnams/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di'i rjes su lus ngan po'i bzlog mdos au ḍ+yān chen pos mdzad pa dang dge slong dkon mchog ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i mdos rgyas pa zer ba 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor pas ma thob/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bkra shis khyab bdag rdor 'dzin ma/ sa skya khri chen kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i zhi ba'i sgrub thabs gtso bor ston pa'i be bum dkar chag zab don nor bu'i me long*/ des mdzad pa'i rnam sras dbang drag gi yi ge'i skor gtso bor ston pa'i dkar chag snyan brgyud gser gyi za ma tog mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i dpal chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnam thos sras rigs mi 'dra ba lnga phrag gsum gyi rjes gnang gi cho ga nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyan phreng*/

mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa'i rnam sras lnga phrag gsum gyi rjes gnang gi chog khrigs dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ stag lung pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thos sras rigs chen brgyad kyi rjes gnang gi chog khrigs bstod pa dang bcas pa/ des mdzad pa'i a pa ra dzi ta'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang bcas pa rnams legs par nos pa las/ zangs dkar lo tsā bas stod kyi phyogs su thog mar gnang zhing gtum ston blo gros grags nas brgyud pa'i rnam sras stod lugs sam bya sder lugs su grags pa'i zhi ba bde byed ser chen lha dgu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ gtum mgon po yon tan/ lung khu dgon pa/ mkhan po lung ston/ slob dpon legs pa'i shes rab/ bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ bya sder ba byang chub gzhon nu/ mang mkhar ba blo bzang dkar mo/ mang mkhar ba blo bzang grags pa/ bzang ldan mkhan chen shākya blo gros/ 'bul dpon rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen mkhas grub kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po nas/ rin po che bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga rin po che mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/

rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra'o// ༈ //zangs dkar lo tsā bas smad kyi char g.yor po jo ston la gnang bas smad lugs su grags pa'i rgyal po chen po ngal gsos po zhi ba bde byed ser chen lha dgu dang drag byed bzhon pa med pa klu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i rjes gnang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag len ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba yan gong ltar la/ de nas g.yor po jo ston/ bcur bsod nams rin chen/

rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na mi 'dug pas chad pa 'dra/ 'byed phu ba pad+ma bkra shis/ stag pa lha rje jo bzang*/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ gnubs byams pa'i dpal/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub dpal bzang*/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ sku zhang rin po che mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub dpal bzang*/ de las rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po dang chos rje bkra shis dpal 'byor gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ de nas brgyud tshul le tshan rnams gong dang 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rin po che nas/ sku zhang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling chos rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na byang gling rje nas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ yang na sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje nas/ bco brgyad pa 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ gnas brtan bstan pa bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje man 'dra/ yang na thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal nas/ mkhas grub rin chen bsod nams 'phel/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ rje btsun yab chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang man 'dra/ yang na khro phu lo tsā ba nas/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon kā ma ru pa/ slob dpon kah+na pa/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang la rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyi gsan yig dang chog khrigs dngos grub 'dod 'jo na karna zhes pa 'dug

slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che sadz+dza na/ kha che te dza de wa/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ zhu sa skya pa/ jo btsun grags pa seng ge rgya ston grub pa po/ sngags rams pa'i gsan yig na rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus zhes snang rgyal dbang gsung*/ rgya ston grub mchog bla ma rdo rje dpal/ khro phu sems dpa' chen po man 'dra/ yang skyor mo lung pa'i phyag len ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po nas/ grub chen bh+riṃ ga ra wa ti/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ g.yor po jo ston rdo rje rtse mo/ sbas ti dgra bcom pa sems dpa' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab seng ge bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyug se ba can pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa/ dga' ldan phug pa blo bzang grags pa/ de gnyis ka las mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de nas paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ brag dmar ba kun dga' tshe 'phel/ spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ rnam sras kyi rjes gnang lnga phrag gsum pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo ma gtogs pa'i rtags med pa'i lung yongs rdzogs dang dbang gi rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yan gong du smos pa'i smad lugs kyi brgyud pa'i rnam grangs ltar la/ de nas mkhan btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ bstan pa'i srog shing spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dpal rdo rje kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun chen po bsod nams dbang phyug

rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// dbang gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ khyab bdag zhwa lu pa man 'dra'o// kong gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ kha che te dza de wa nas/ kaṃ po dzi/ su ma ti kīrti/ kong bu ri pa/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal man 'dra/ ra'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros yan gong ltar la/ de nas paṇa chen bsod nams blo gros/ sham+bhar rin po che kun dga' sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ 'brom gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ lo tsā ba dbas mañju shrī/ la gsum rgyal ba byang chub/ de las paṇ+ḍi ta kha che dkar pos bod du zhus/ de nas zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ mchims yul smad kyi 'brom sde nyi ma/ dge bshes lo tsā ba/ sle'u mtshur ston/ sle'u ston pa/ dge bshes dbu gru ston smon lam/ phrin las jo sras nas rim par brgyud de/ sham+bhar rin po che kun dga' sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ zhi ba bde byed ser po 'di dang 'brel pa'i drag po'i rjes gnang shin tu bka' gnyan pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhyen rab chos rje nas/ sku zhang rin chen mchog grub/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ 'di thob pa'i gang zag des rnam sras la mchod gtor mi bcag cing rjes gnang zhu dus ting nge 'dzin gsal ba dang mjug tu rnam sras kyi tshe sgrub nyams su len dgos tshul snang ngo*// yang drag po dang ma 'brel ba'i rnam sras ser chen smad lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros yan gong ltar la/ de nas mkhan chen ngag dbang lhun grub bkra shis/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ chos lung mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun grub rgyal mtshan/

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na mkhyen rab rje nas/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po man 'dra/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i gong khug sro ma can gyi zab chos gsang sgrub ljang ser be con can gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal yan rnam sras ser chen ltar la/ de nas mkhan chen gtsang pa dbang phyug grags/ mkhas pa byang chub seng ge mkhan chen dad ma pa brtson 'grus byang chub/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma rin chen rgya mtsho/ bla ma rin chen dpal/ bla ma rin po che chos grags pa/ bla ma shākya ye shes/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ chos rje kun dga' tshe 'phel/ glang thang spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ de las rje mkhyen brtse dang rin po che bod mkhar bas gsan pa'i lugs gnyis ka ser chen ltar la/ rje dbang rab nas/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man 'dra'o// be'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ spyan snga chos kyi rgya mtsho nas/ rje dbang rab/ mkhan ngag chos pa man gong gi lung brgyud bzhin no// klu sgrub kyi rgyal chen rta sngon bdud mo bzhis bskor dang nang ma mo ltar sgrub pa lha dgu drag byed seng zhon klu brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gsang ba gshin rje ltar sgrub pa mdung dmar can lha bcu gsum/ yang gsang srin po bzhis bskor/ shu raṃ ga warma lugs kyi rnam sras mthing kha lha bco lnga/ rnam sras dmar ser las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa/

gar mkhan mchog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa/ dmar smug zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa/ rnam sras dkar po lha dgu'i tshe dbang dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ dpal kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ grub chen bh+riṃ ga ra wa ti/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ g.yor po jo ston rdo rje rtse mo/ 'di gsan yig na mi gsal yang chog khrigs gnyis ka na byung zhing sbas tis zangs dkar ba la cung ma thug pa 'dra'o// sbas ti dgra bcom pa sems dpa' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dad ma ba brtson 'grus dbang phyug mkhan ngag dbang chos grags dang rje bka' 'gyur ba gnyis kyi yig char mi 'dug kyang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'dug pas chad pa 'dra'o// mkhan chen zhig pa shes rab seng ge bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyug se ba can pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chog khrigs gnyis ka na 'di las mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa dang dga' ldan phug pa blo bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gsan zer ba 'dug kyang*/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig sor gnas byas pa yin/ slar yang brtag go /bla ma blo gros bzang po/ bla ma chos skyong bzang po/ dga' ldan phug pa blo bzang grags pa/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ brag dmar ba kun dga' tshe 'phel/ spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu pa/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug bka' drin mnyam med khyab bdag dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na tshar chen nas/ rin po che bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/

spyan snga rin po che chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab man 'dra/ rnam sras dmar ser las mkhan mdung dmar can dang*/ rnam sras dkar po gnyis kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni rdo rje 'chang dbang rab las 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan gyis gsan pa man 'dra/ klu kha shā gsum gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ spyan snga chos kyi rgya mtsho yan bshad ma thag pa'i rjes gnang rnams kyi brgyud pa ltar la/ de nas rje dbang rab/ mkhan ngag chos pa man lung brgyud spyi 'gro bzhin no// yang shā'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rab nas/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa man 'dra'o// rnam sras sprin gseb ma ser chen lha dgur grags pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ dpal au ḍ+yān chen po/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ lha sras mu tig btsan po/ zhang lha bzang klu dpal nas rim par/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ sham+bhar rin po che kun dga' sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug bla ma des bdag la'o// yang na tshar chen nas/ rin po che mai tri/ spyan snga chos rgyam/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ ljang gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ spyan snga rin po che yan sprin gseb ma'i rjes gnang ltar la/ de nas rje dbang rab/ mkhan ngag chos pa man lung brgyud spyi ltar ro// yang gsang mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ mkhas pa bai ro tsa na/ rgyal po g.yu sgra snying po/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/

zhang lha bzang klu dpal/ gter ston gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi ma/ dbus pa dmar ston/ slob dpon bcur ston/ 'od zer bla ma/ dz+nyā na lak+ṣa/ slob dpon thabs kyi blo gros/ mkhan po dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon nam mkha' grags pa/ bla ma bsod nams rin chen/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ gnyags phu ba mkhas grub bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen pad+ma bzang po/ mkhan chen chos kyi dbang phyug mkhan chen chos grub seng ge thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rje byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ skyor mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na tshar chen nas/ rin po che bod mkhar ba/ spyan snga chos rgyam/ khyab bdag dbang rab man 'dra/ yang na gnyags phu ba nas/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ mkhan chen rab 'byor seng ge mkhan chen chos kyi dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang bka' ma'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ mi pham skra'i lwa ba can/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ thugs sras mang ston/ sog byang chub yon tan/ dpal rgwa lo/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ gnyags phu ba bsod nams bzang po man gong bzhin no/ sprin gseb ma dang phyag mtshan bzhi pa gnyis snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi thob yig tu lam tsam yod kyang 'dir tshar lugs rjes gnang bka' bco lnga zhes grags pa'i rjes su 'brangs te bris pa yin no/ /bzhi'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ spyan snga chos kyi rgya mtsho yan phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ltar la/ de nas rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags man sngar bzhin no// bo'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/

mkhan chen bslab gsum pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra/ gnubs kyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ rgyal po kun skyong*/ bal po ba su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs rdo rje 'bar/ gnubs byang chub snying po/ gnubs spyi bo dang ring*/ gnubs gtsug tor 'gying ba/ gnubs bya pho brtsegs pa/ gnubs 'jol po dbang phyug gnubs ser po dpal sras/ gnubs klus 'byin/ gnubs ra thung*/ gnubs gtso bo lha pa/ gnubs dkon mchog grags/ gnubs nag po jo phan/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal nas rim par brgyud de/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rje btsun dbang phyug rab brtan/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags man lung brgyud spyi 'gro bzhin no// yang rnam sras lnga phrag gsum pa'i rjes gnang yongs su rdzogs pa chog sgrig nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyan phreng gi lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po yan gong du smos pa'i smad lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa'i rnam grangs ltar las/ de nas rje btsun bod mkhar ba chen po mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ snyan brgyud srog shing spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang chen po dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ lha khang mkhan chen don grub legs bzang*/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na a pa ra tsit+ta'i rjes gnang lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po in+t+ra bhū ti/ jo bo nā ro pa chen po/

slob dpon dza wa ri pa/ slob dpon pra wa hasti/ bal po ba su dha ra/ jo bo rje a ti sha/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ pu rang pa dge slong puṇ+ye dha ri/ rgya lcags ri gong kha pa/ chos rgyal zla 'od gzhon nu/ phag gru rdo rje rgyal po/ rgyal ba stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba/ rje sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/ u rgyan mgon po/ rat+na a ka ra/ grags pa'i mtshan can/ rje mi g.yo mgon po/ kun spangs grags pa/ 'jig rten mgon po/ pad+ma rgyal po/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje stag lung pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'dren mchog ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// nor chen rigs la nor bu bzang la sogs// 'dzad med dbyig gi rgyun du byin brlabs pas// sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i lha// rmugs 'dzin gnod sbyin zhi drag rnam pa mang*// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ nor can gyi rigs kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bcu pa'o// //lnga pa rgyas pa'i rigs sam glang po che'i rigs sam ban glang gi rigs ni/ lngas rtsen dang 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa dang*/ srin mo chen mo bzhi la sogs pa rnams ni ma byung ngo*// drug pa 'jig rten pa'i rigs ni/ lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa rnams te/ de rnams kyang 'dir thos pa med do// rgyas pa'i rigs la bu tsha 'phen pa dang*// longs spyod 'phel ba lngas rtsen la sogs dang*// 'jig rten lha dang lha min srog snying phul// ston pas byin brlabs bklags pas dngos grub ster// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim rnams song nas/

rgyud sde gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim la/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa las bstan pa'i lha rigs ni 'dir ma byung la/ rigs kyi bdag po ni 'jam dpal la sogs pa ste/ 'dir paṇa chen thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil dang mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi brjed tho bklag chog yid kyi mun sel gyi steng nas/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta rab 'byor bskyangs/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon shes rab bskyangs/ slob dpon zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ mkhas pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ gan pa rin rgyal/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dol po kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge de las thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*/ mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' chos 'phel/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i rtser son kun dga' bstan 'dzin/

bka' drin mtshungs med de nyid las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis mnos so// yang na mkhan chen bsod nams dpal ldan pa'i gsan yul gyi bla ma gang yin brtag bsod nams dpal ldan nas/ thar rtse mkhan chen nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rat+na war+dha/ lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge man 'dra/ yang na lo chen rin chen bzang po nas/ dbus pa dge ser/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ dga' ldan slob dpon mi pham pa/ khams chen rgan mo lhas pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ bla ma byang chub seng ge shar chen man 'dra'o// rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil dang*/ thar rtse pa dang mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa gsum char gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i lung yang thos// ༈ //paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas 'jam dbyangs dmar ser a pa ra tsa na'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs/ slob dpon chen po dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ rje btsun rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras a

gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu a kā ra sid+dhi zhes snang ngo*// kā ra skye med grub pa/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba nas/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub dang shar khang pa gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis char las brang ti pa paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ khri chen bsod nams brtan 'dzin dbang po/ chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ rje bla ma dam pa kun dga' rin chen/ mkhas grub dam pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la lan gsum gyi bar du stsal to// yang na mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ de las bdag gis mnos so// yang na mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub nas/ sa lo tsā ba/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ de sras sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag la'o// yang na sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis nas/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis nas/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas/ gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/

dkon mchog dpal ldan/ khri chen pa man 'dra/ yang na rat+na war+dha nas/ lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇ+ḍi ta nas/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen kun bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mtshungs med ri khrod pa kun dga' mchog ldan/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pa man 'dra/ yang na 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen man 'dra'o// 'di'i sgrub thabs sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa dang*/ rjes gnang bya tshul rje btsun sangs rin gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rjes su gnang ba'ang mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong las bdag gis tshar gcig mnos so// lus ngag spyod dang rtse gcig ting nge 'dzin// cha mnyam spyod pa la dga'i gdul bya'i ngor// legs par gsungs pa ma rig mun sel lha// 'gro ba smin byed dbang dang rjes gnang gnyis// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bcu gcig pa'o// //rgyud sde gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la de nyid 'dus pa dang dpal mchog la sogs pa nas bstan pa'i yi dam gyi lha mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa dang pos dngos bstan/ bstan bya'i gtso bo rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun kun dga' bzang po pas mdzad pa'i gzhan phan mtha' yas dang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor blo gsal kun dga'i steng nas kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa la/ ā di bhū mi nā ya s+ya pa ram+pa raḥ/ bha ga wāṃ bai ro tsa naḥ/ gu h+ya pa ti badz+ra pā ṇiḥ/

rā dzā pra kā sha tsan+d+raḥ/ ā tsār+ya pra bhū ti pā li taḥ/ ma hā sid+dho nan+da gar+bhaḥ/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta pradz+nyā pā li taḥ/ ā tsār+ya shan+ti gar+bhaḥ/ ka l+yā ṇa ni mit+ta mi traḥ/ ā tsār+ya su kha s+ya badz+raḥ/ thog mar sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs/ grub chen kun dga' snying po/ mkhas pa chen po shes rab bskyangs/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ slob dpon bde ba'i rdo rje/ ār+ya shrad+dhā ka ra warmaḥ/ lo ka s+ya tsak+ṣu rat+na bha draḥ/ she lo pa ri gu ṇa shī laḥ/ lo tsā ba ma ti kīrtiḥ/ shrī ma hā bhū mi paṇ+ḍa rā nan+da gar+bhaḥ/ bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka rat+na kīrti dh+wa dzaḥ/ bhū mī paṇ+ḍa ra paṇ+ḍi tā nan+da dh+wa dzaḥ/ sam+bha ra bhā ba kā nan+da shrīḥ/ ma hā shru taṃ pu ṇ+ya s+thi raḥ/ jo bo dad byed go cha/ 'jig rten gyi mig rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ ti sh+r+yā nan+da ma tiḥ/ saṅgu ru puṇ+ya dh+wa dzaḥ/ swā mya tri gu ha ka ma tis+thi raḥ/ gu ru shrī wāñcatshī laḥ/ dharmā swā mī dz+nyā na dh+wa dzaḥ/ ma hā badz+ra dha rā nan+da bha draḥ/ ma hā sa twa rat+na dh+wa dzaḥ/ puṇ+ya siṃ ha/ to bha ya bud+dha rat+naḥ/ swā mā bud+dha singhaḥ/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ga ga na shrī bha draḥ/ ti shrī kun rmor chen pa'i gsan yig tu 'di ma byung*/ dga' blo gros/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams seng ge de gnyis ka las sangs rgyas rin chen/

rje sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ swā myā kā sha bud+dhaḥ/ ma hā se na khaṃ shrī bha dra wā/ sad+dharma saṃ kalpa sid+dhaḥ/ to bha yo pa dh+yā ya bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīḥ/ ma hā pūrba shā sa na dha raḥ/ badz+ra satwa maṅga laṃ ni rā bho gaḥ/ te na nash+shī la rat+na ma wo tsa traḥ/ wā bud+dha lak+ṣ+m+yāt+ma hā pūrba bud+dha shā sa na dha ra sh+tsa shā sa na dha ra ni rā bho ga dwā yā shū taṃ/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ se chen nam mkha' dpal bzang ngam/ dam chos bsam 'grub/ gnyis kas mkhan sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ shar chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/ rdo rje sems dpa' bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ shar chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin dang bstan 'dzin lhun grub gnyis kyis gsan/ pash+tsi ma sh+tsa maṅga la ni rā bho ga dwā bh+yaṃ/ ma ho pa dh+yā ya bud+dha shrī bha dre ṇa shū taṃ/ ta to mā shru taṃ/ wā bud+dha lak+ṣ+m+yā ta/ ā nan+da shā sa na dha raḥ/ bud+dha shrī bha draḥ/ ta to mā/ wā bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka bud+dha rat+nā ta/ mañju gho ṣa bud+dha singhaḥ/ ma hā pa ṭu ga ga na shrī bha draḥ/ phyi ma dang bkra shis lhun grub gnyis ka las/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas gsan/ de las bdag gis so// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ de las bdag gis so/ yang na rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ma hā pūrba mai t+yā nan+da maṅga laṃ/ pūrba pradz+nyā saṃ bha wa/ pa ṭu bha dan+tā nan+da pā dhuḥ/ paṇ+ḍi ta sid+dho bud+dha lak+ṣ+mī pash+tsi ma pārba tsa sa mā naḥ/ wā ma hā ngor badz+ra dhā rā nan+da bha drā ta/ ā nan+de shwa raḥ/ nā ya kot+ti ma rat+na war+dha/ swa mi de wot+ta ma singhaḥ/ bud+dha singha pash+tsi ma sā ma naḥ/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhas btsun kun dga' legs pa/

mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs man sngar dang 'dra'o// yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rje lha mchog seng ge bud+dha singha man 'dra'o// pu naḥkaṣ+mi ra ne ta s+ya tan+t+ra ni/ badz+ra satwaḥ/ a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta/ rat+nā ka ra shān+taḥ/ a bha ya/ badz+rā sa naṃ/ bi khyā ta de baḥ/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+raḥ/ tsa ma ra se nā lo tsā puṇ+ya singhaḥ/ rat+na shrī/ she la gu ha puṇ+ya shrī/ sha ba ra ma tis+thi raḥ/ yang kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ dpe med bsrungs pa/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba/ 'jigs rgyal dbang gsan yig tu bhaskar de bzhes byung ngo*// med rdo rje gdan pa/ rnam par bshad pa'i lha/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī/ rab 'byor zla ba/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams seng ge dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ gu ru shrī wañcatshī laḥ/ dharmā s+ya swā mi dz+nyā na dh+wa dzaḥ/ badz+ra dha rā nan+da bha dra pash+tsi ma pūrba sa mānaḥ/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos kyi rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man sngar dang 'dra'o// chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ rdo rje gdan pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ niṣ+ka laṃ ka rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ ra wen+d+ra/ chag lo tsā ba chos kyi dpal/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams seng ge paṇ+ḍi ta rdor she/ zhang dkon mchog dpal man sngar dang 'dra'o// yang na g.yag sde lo tsā ba nas/ lo mchog bag ston/ tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man 'dra'o// stod lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/ phyag na rdo rje/

rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ pradz+nyā pa lī ta/ pradz+nyā bo dhi/ muk+ti ko ṣa/ dharma pa la/ dī paṃ ka ra/ shrī dz+nyā na/ do pa sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi 'od/ de'i sras snur badz+ra singha*/ snur byang chub 'od/ snur nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ rin chen shes rab/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge phyar bu ba zhwa ser rtse ring*/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man sngar dang 'dra'o// yang na snur nyi 'od nas/ gshen rdor seng*/ glan chos 'byung*/ gtum ston shākya 'bum/ bla ma 'dzim pa rin chen shes rab/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge man 'dra'o// yang na pradz+nyā pā li ta nas/ go mi dge bsnyen/ shākya dz+nyā na/ jo bo rje man 'dra/ yang na pradz+nyā pā li ta nas/ dharma pā la/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ jo bo rje man gong ltar ro// yang na snur nyi 'od nas/ rtsa skya ston grags/ slob dpon ston 'bum/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ dge sdings pa chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ ye shes rdo rje/ kun dga' snying po man gong dang 'dra/ yang na rnam par snang mdzad/ dze tā ri pa/ kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ nā ya ka pa/ mai tri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ niṣ+ka laṃ ka de wen+d+ra/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams seng ge lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston man 'dra'o// smad lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po yan gong ltar las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warmā/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ sum ston ye 'bar/ gnyal ston tshul 'bar/

thod pa dben tsha grags/ thod pa 'od zer/ ri lung phug pa chos mgon/ bla ma blo ldan seng ge bla ma 'phags 'od/ bod btsun dbu se/ bu ston man sngar dang 'dra'o// ༈ //phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ grub chen kun dga' snying po/ pradz+nyā pā li ta/ pradz+nyā bo dhi/ muk+ti ko ṣa/ dharma pā la/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ go mi 'di la do pa sgom chen zer ba'ang byung*/ sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyal pa nyi/ snur chen nyam 'od/ sras badz+ra singha*/ snur byang chub 'od/ snur nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ snur ye rgyal/ snur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan grags/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen bud+dha rat+na/ sangs rgyas seng ge ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ga ga na shrī bha dra/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ de las bla ma lhun grub bkra shis/ mnga' ris glo bo pa/ de las mkhas btsun kun dga' legs pa/ chu 'dus pa/ mkhas grub bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīṃ/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag tshul rin la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ chos rje kun dga' chos 'phel gyis gsan nam snyam/ de las mkhas btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na ngor chen/ kun dbang*/ 'dren mchog rje lha mchog seng ge bud+dha singha man 'dra'o// ༈ //thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i steng nas ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/

1 shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ 2 tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ 3 phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ 4 me ltar 'bar ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ 5 'khor los sgyur ba phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug 6 phyag na rdo rje la rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 7 de la phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 8 de la gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 9 de la klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 10 de la 'jigs byed dgus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 11 de la lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor te 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug bcas 12 bcu gnyis kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dam pa'i phyag len ltar dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ dzi na mi tra/ swasti pha la/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ pradz+nyā pā li ta/ kha che ye shes rdo rje/ pa ra hi ta/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ kha che dharma pā la dz+nyā na shrī/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi ma 'od zer/ gshen rdo rje seng ge rgya gsar ba/ 'brom dzi ti ba/ snye mdo bsod nams dpal/ gnyal pa chos grags/ bya ston rin chen 'od/ 'dzim pa blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bla ma mgon po dbang phyug gnyan lo grags pa blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mtshungs med nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen bsod nams dpal ldan nam/

sangs rgyas bstan pa gang yin blta/ de nas thar rtse mkhan chen nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ de nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// smras pa/ dam tshig sems dpa'i lha dang ye shes pa// zung 'jug mnyam sbyor ji srid phyag rgya bkrol// gang tshe ye shes 'byin pa rgyud sde yis// nges bstan lhag pa'i lha mchog bcu bzhi'o// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //lnga pa bya ba'i rgyud shas che ba dang rgyud sde rin po che gong 'og ci rigs pa rnams nas lha dpa' bo gcig pa sogs sgrub thabs mang po gsungs pa rnams/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis mtshon pa'i paṇa grub du mas sgrub thabs chung ngu mang du mdzad pa thor bu rnams paṇa grub tshad ldan gyis phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa sgrub thabs bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ rgyas bsdus kyis bsdus pa min yang bya ba mang po phyogs gcig bsdus nas bsdebs pas de ltar grags shing*/ bla ma bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta dang dha byang chub sems dpa' sogs las ba ri lo tsā bas sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba stong rtsa gsan pa'i nang nas zab cing thugs gtsigs che ba dgu bcu go drug phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i sgrub thabs kun las btus sam brgya rtsa zhes pa bod 'dir 'gyur ba'i bsdus pa dang*/ pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs phyed dang nyis brgya pa 'bring po/ rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo dhi las gnang ba thob cing rdo rje rnal 'byor mas lung bstan pa la brten nas paṇa chen 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bkas bskul nas yar klungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis bzhugs pa rgyas pa'am rgya mtshor grags pa rnams las/
phyi ma ni thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul 'dod dgu'i

rmor chen pa'i gsan yig tu mus pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rin chen sgron me gnyis char gyi steng nas gsan zhes 'byung*/ ljon shing rin po che'i snye ma'i steng nas rjes gnang dang rgya gzhung gi lung bcas tshang bar thos pa ni/ 'dir chos sde'i go rim rgya gzhung sor bzhag dang*/ lag len gyi dus go rim 'khrugs bsdebs byas chog pa'i rjes gnang yod med dang bla med gang yin mchan bus bkrol te bkod pa la/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub 1 thabs paṇ+ḍi ta ku mu ta 'byung ba'i blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis la lha sngags mi gsal ba 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas kha bskangs pa'i rjes gnang mdzad srol byung 'dug kyang deng sang lung las rjes gnang med do/ /de'i sgrub 2 thabs rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rje btsun rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub 3 thabs man ngag gi cho ga 'di gsum bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig yang de'i sgru 4 ba thab 5 sa mi 'dra ba gnyis/ 'phags pa yi ge dru 6 ga pa rig pa chen po dkar po phyag bzhi pa gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs dpal ldan lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ rjes gnang yod/ za ma tog bkod pa'i man 7 ngag gis mdzad pa'i dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po 8 dkar po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ mgo mjug gnyis na yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs zer ba dang mngon rtogs kyi 'gor dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon zhes pa snang rjes gnang yang yod/ dpal ldan 'jig 9 rten mgon po dkar po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten mgon po pad+ma dbang byed kyang zer rjes gnang yod/ 'phags pa 10 yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen po rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug gi man ngag rgya chen brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga zhes pa yi ge drug pa phyag bzhi pa dkar po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs/

rjes gnang yod/ rnam snang 11 mngon byang nas bshad pa'i 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug kha sar+pā ṇi dkar po phyag gnyis pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rnyog pa med pas mdzad pa/ 'di nas a nu pa ma rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i bar gyi bzhi po rjes gnang gcig po ta la ke kha 12 sar+pā ṇi lha lnga'i sgrub thabs pad+ma 'byung gnas blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ slob dpon dge byed kyis 13 mdzad pa'i kha sar+pā ṇi lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ gsan yig gzhan tshor bde byed zer ba 'dug rgya gzhung dang gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na dkyus ltar byung ngo*/ /dpal ldan mkha' spyod 'jig rten dbang phyug 14 lha lnga'i sgrub thabs a nu pa ma rak+ṣi tas cung zad rgyas par mdzad pa/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod kha sar+pā ṇi dkar 15 po phyag gnyis pa lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub 16 thabs 'di dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs gsum ste bzhi bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig paṇ+ḍi ta a wa dhū tī dpal ldan gnyis med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gsan yig phal cher na 'jigs med rdo rje zhes 'dug kyang rgya zhung*/ bklags pas don grub/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig bcas par dkyus ltar snang ngo*/ /'jig rten mgon po 17 dkar po phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rin chen sgron mer 'jig rten dbang phyug zer/ sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 18 dkar po phyag gnyis gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub 19 thabs/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i sgrub 20 thabs/ dpal ldan 21 seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 22 ha la ha la dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa gtso 'khor gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'di gnyis thun mong du rjes gnang gcig yang rin chen sgron mer phyi ma gtso rkyang gi dbang du byas te kha phral nas so sor rjes gnang 'dug

de'i sgrub 23 thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje chos dkar po 24 zhal gsum phyag drug pa yab yum gnyis kyi sgrub thabs cho ga bsdus pa rjes gnang yod/ 'jig rten mgon po/ pad+ma 25 gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po phyag gnyis pa lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ rjes gnang yod/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 26 dmar po phyag bco brgyad pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ ha ri ha ri la zhon par 27 gyur pa dkar po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'di gnyis bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig yang de'i sgrub 28 thabs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ au ḍi yā na'i 29 rim pa'i 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig de'i sgrub 30 thabs au ḍi yā na nas byung zhing sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis gdan drangs pa/ 'jig rten dbang 31 phyug dmar po phyag bzhi pa lha gsum pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'jig rten dbang 32 phyug gis lhag par dbang du bya ba'i spyan ras gzigs dmar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mgrin pa sngon po can ser po phyag 33 gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rim pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 34 dbang phyug nag po zhal lnga phyag bcu gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ shes rab bskyed pa 35 pad+ma'i phyag gi gzungs/ 'di gnyis la lung las rjes gnang med/ nye bar spyod pa dang bcas pa sran 36 ma ma ṣa'i zhal gyi gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs 37 dbang phyug don yod zhags pa dkar po phyag drug pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/

rjes gnang yod/ 'jig rten/ ngor gong dkar ba mkhyen brtse thar rtse shar pa lnga'i gsan yig mkhyen brtse'i bklags pas don grub/ rgya gzhung rnams mthun par bar 'dir sgrub thabs gzhan mi 'dug kyang thar rtse pas mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga rin po che sgron mer don zhags phyag bcu pa/ drug pa/ bzhi pa rnams gong gi sgrub thabs kyi tshig gis zin 'dug pas spel ba 'dra yang rjes gnang zur du dgos mi dgos dpyad do/ /gsum po dbang 38 du byed pa 'phags pa bhug+ma dmar mo phyag gnyis pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs slob dpon shū n+ya tā sa ma dhi badz+ra pā da'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang yod/ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po'am 'jig rten 39 dbang phyug gi sgrub rjes gnang yod/ thabs/ 'khor med pa ma gtogs zhal phyag bhug ma dang 'dra/ rin po che sgron mer rjes gnang gong gis 'thus pa las zur du med/ 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i 'khor 40 lo ser po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bha wa skan+dhas mdzad pa 'di gnyis la rjes gnang gcig de'i sgrub 41 thabs tshig lhug ma/ 'jam dpal 42 seng ge'i sgra ser po phyag gnyis pa lha bcu gcig gi sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'jam 43 dbyangs ngag gi rgyal po dmar ser phyag gnyis kyi sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pas mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i yi ge gcig ma'i rab tu sbyor ba la rjes gnang gcig yang de'i sgrub 44 thabs rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsungs pa/ seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs 45 pa'i ngag gi rgyal po zhes bya ba dmar ser phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'di gnyis bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig mdzad la rin chen sgron mer 'di gnyis so sor phral ba'i phyi ma 'di ngag gi rgyal po gong ma gnyis kyi steng du bsnan nas mdzad 'dug pa don gyi rjes gnang la mang nyung ma byung yang sngags wā gī shwa ra dang wār+ṇa saṃ gyi khyad 'dug pas bklags pas don grub lugs 'thad par snang*/

yang ngag gi rgyal po 46 seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal 47 ngag gi rgyal po gser zhun phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ ngag gi rgyal po ser po phyag gnyis pa 48 lha gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ shes rab 'phel 49 ba'i gter ngag gi rgyal po lha gsum ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta 'phrog byed 'joms pas mdzad pa/ rjes gnang yod/ yid bzhin nor bu sbyin dang zhal phyag mthun/ bcom ldan 'das kyi cho ga 'di mkhas pas spyod lam gtsang ma phun sum tshogs pas 'bum phrag bdun bzla bar gsungs pa'i ngag gi rgyal po 50 gser btso ma'i mdog can phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ a ra pa tsa na dkar po 51 phyag gnyis pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig yang de'i sgrub 52 thabs tshig lhug pa/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal 53 sgom pa'i man ngag ces pa a ra pa tsa na dmar po phyag gnyis pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i a ra pa tsa 54 na dkar po phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'jam dpal dkar po lha lnga'i sgrub 55 thabs tshigs bcad ma/ 'di la lung las rjes gnang med/ gsan yig phal cher na 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zhes snang la gong dkar ba'i gsan yig dang rjes gnang gi yig cha gnyis na mi gsal lo// gur nas gsungs pa'i yan lag 56 med pa'i rdo rje ser po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'di gnyis bsdoms pas rjes gnang gcig yang 'jam dpal yan lag 57 med pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ chos dbyings ngag gi 58 dbang phyug dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ chos kyi dbyings ngag gi 59 dbang phyug dmar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi dbang du bya ba'i cho ga

rin chen sgron mer phyag brgyad ma las gzhan gsal kha med/ rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa'i tsun+dha 119 dkar mo phyag 120 bzhi ma'i 121 sgrub thabs gsum/ gsum ga bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig rtog pa las gsungs 122 pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo zhal lnga phyag bcu ma gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 'di dang 'og gi dkar mo phyag bcu ma bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can 123 ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di dang 'og gi mya ngan med pa'i ser mo phyag gnyis bcas par rjes gnang gcig rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can ser mo zhal gsum phyag 124 brgyad ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 'di dang 'og gi phyag brgyad ma dang lha lnga ma gnyis bsdoms pa'i gsum la rjes gnang gcig rin chen sgron mer lha lnga ma le tshan bzhi byung yang rgya gzhung na mi gsal bas nor ram dpyad/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo 125 zhal lnga phyag bcu ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma 'od zer can 126 dmar mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma gtso 'khor gnyis kyi sgrub thabs/ 'di dang 'og gi 'od zer can dmar mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig 'od zer can 127 ser mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ au ḍi yā na'i 'od zer can 128 dmar mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di gnyis dang rang byin gyis brlab pa'i 'od zer can the ba'i gsum la rjes gnang gcig mdzad/ rin chen sgron mer gsum ga gong gi rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i 'od zer can gyi sdebs su bgrangs 'dug yang de'i sgrub 129 thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ yang au ḍi yā na'i rang byin gyis brlab 130 pa'i rim pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can

131 ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can 132 ser mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma lha lnga ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon snying po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'od zer can dmar po 133 zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ gong gi rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i 'od zer can gyi rjes gnang gis 'thus/ 'od zer can 134 pi tsu ga zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs/ thar rtse dang shar pa'i gsan yig na pi tsu ma zhes byung yang gzhan rnams mthun par dkyus bzhin snang*/ rjes gnang yod/ khro mo chen mo 'od zer can 135 ser mo zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis pa gtso 'khor gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya gzhung na sku mdog 'di ltar 'dug kyang bklags pas don grub dang rin chen sgron mer dmar mo zhes byung ba brtag rjes gnang yod/ 'od zer can 136 gyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ 'di gnyis la rjes gnang zur pa mi dgos/ de'i gzungs 137 bklag pa'i man ngag ri khrod lo ma gyon ma 138 ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ lo ma gyon ma ljang 139 gu zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma can 140 gyi gzungs/ 'di la lung las rjes gnang med/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dkar mo 141 phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di dang gsham gyi sher phyin dkar mo gnyis te gsum bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 142 ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya gzhung dang gsan yig rnams mthun par gsum byung bas bklags pas don grub tu gnyis zer ba yig nor byung 'dra/ gang ltar gsum po bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig gis chog rin chen sgron mer phyag mtshan sogs cung zad mi 'dra ba phye ba'i drug byung*/ de'i sgrub
