143 thabs mdor bsdus pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dkar mo 144 zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dge 'dun byin gyi bus mdzad pa/ yang de'i sgrub 145 thabs paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan pad+ma 'phel gyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ yang gser 146 mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di dang 'og gi gser mdog can gnyis te gsum bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig rin chen sgron mer gnyis las mi 'dug pa gcig gong gi sher phyin ser mo'i zlar drangs pa 'dra/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 147 ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di gong gi sher phyin ser mo'i rjes gnang gis 'thus/ gser mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 148 phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang de'i sgrub 149 thabs slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ dgra nag nas gsungs pa'i 'phags ma 150 rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ 'di dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma dang gshin rje nag po'i rgyud nas byung ba ste gsum bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig dbyangs can ma chen mo dkar mo phyag gnyis ma gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub 151 thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje dbyangs can 152 ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma 153 dkar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs dge slong yid kyi shing rta sbyong bas mdzad pa/ 'di dang pi waṃ ma'i 'og gi phyag gnyis ma bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig rdo rje pi waṃ dbyangs can 154 ma dkar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje dbyangs can 155 ma dkar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje nag po'i rgyud las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyangs can

156 ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbyangs can 157 ma dkar mo phyag gnyis ma rdo rje bzhi'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ khro gnyer can ser mo phyag 158 bzhi ma'i sgrub 159 thabs gnyis/ gnyis ka thun mong du rjes gnang gcig mdzad/ sgrol ma'i rtog pa las byung 160 ba'i ku ru kul+le dmar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di dang gsham gyi bzhi bcas pa'i lnga la rjes gnang gcig mdzad/ rin chen sgron mer 'og nas 'byung ba'i rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le yang bsnan pa'i drug la rjes gnang gcig mdzad 'dug yang sgrol ma'i rtog pa las byung ba'i tshig lhug 161 pa'i rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ yang ku ru 162 kul+le'i dbang du byed pa'i man ngag yang rigs byed ma'i 163 sgrub thabs/ yang dpal ldan 'phags ma 164 rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ o rgyan nas 165 byung ba'i rigs byed ma phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di nas snyan ngag mkhan chen po brtse ba can gyis mdzad pa'i bar gyi bzhi bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig yang kye rdo rje'i rgyud las rang byin gyis brlab 166 pa'i rim pa'i rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ yang kye rdo rje'i rim pa las 167 ku ru kul+le rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang ku ru kul+le'i sgrub 168 thabs kye rdo rje'i rgyud las byung ba snyan ngag mkhan chen po brtse ba can zhes pas tshigs su bcad de bsdebs pa/ rje btsun ku ru kul+le phyag 169 drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di gnyis la rjes gnang gcig rig byed ma 170 phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru kul+le phyag brgyad 171 ma lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs in+d+ra bhū ti'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang yod/ sngags pa dang bud med dbang du 172 byed pa ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs/

'di gnyis la lung las rjes gnang zur ba med/ rigs byed ma'i man ngag 173 gi rim pa/ ku ru kul+le dkar mo phyag 174 gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 175 chen po stong phrag bcu drug pa las byung ba'i ku ru kul+le dkar mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang yod/ ku ru kul+le dmar mo/ 'dir rjes gnang mdzad rin chen sgron mer mi gsal/ phyag bzhi ma ri'i phug 176 na bzhugs pa'i sgrub thabs/ mkhyen brtse thar rtse shar pa rnams kyi gsan yig na 'di gnyis mi 'dug pa chad pa 'dra/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le phyag 177 bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di gnyis las rjes gnang zur du med/ ku ru kul+le'i las 178 rab tu rkyang pa'i sbyor ba/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 179 gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa 180 gdugs dkar mo can zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje tsartsi ka dmar mo phyag 181 drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las gsungs pa'i so so 'brang ma 182 chen mo ser mo zhal 183 bzhi phyag brgyad 184 ma'i sgrub thabs le tshan gsum/ 'di gsum thun mong du rjes gnang gcig rma bya chen mo'i sgrub 185 thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ mkhyen brtse thar rtse shar pa gsum gyi gsan yig na grwa lnga'i go rim dkyus dang mi mthun tsam 'dug 'phags ma stong chen mo rab tu 186 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'phags ma gsang 187 sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'phags ma bsil ba'i 188 tshal zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ lha mo lnga'i sgrub 189 thabs mdor bstan pa/ rjes gnang zur du dgos kyang rgyun chad/

rin chen sgron mer 'di dang ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma lha lnga so sor rjes gnang yod tshul 'dug kyang rgya gzhung dang gsan yig bklags pas don grub rnams mthun par ma byung bas brtag phyir bzlog pa chen mo nag mo phyag 190 drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung 191 rgyan nag mo zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma 192 ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje gan+dha ri nag mo zhal 193 drug phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub 194 thabs le tshan gnyis/ gnyis ka thun mong du rjes gnang gcig bsrung ba 195 lnga'i cho ga rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma zhal 196 gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma zhal 197 gsum phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'di gnyis la rjes gnang gcig yang de'i sgrub 198 thabs kyi cho ga rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung 199 rgyan/ rjes gnang yod/ ser mo zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa/

gsan yig phal cher dang bklags pas don grub na sgrub thabs gcig las mi gsal yang rgya gzhung dang gong dkar ba'i gsan yig rin chen sgron me rnams na gnyis ka snang zhing rjes gnang gcig gis 'thus pa mdzad/ 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par 200 rgyal ma lha dgu'i sgrub thabs tshigs 201 bcad lhug gnyis/ nor 202 rgyun ma ser mo phyag gnyis ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ gur nas gsungs pa'i nor rgyun ma 203 gtso rkyang gi sgrub 204 thabs gnyis/ gnyis ka la rjes gnang gcig de'i gzungs kyi man 205 ngag lung las rjes gnang med/ rdo rje phag mo lha lnga'i sgrub 206 thabs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a wa dhū tī pa dpal ldan gnyis med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang yod/ bla med du gtogs/ bklags pas don grub tu mai tri pas mdzad ces snang*/ phag dkar shes rab snang 207 ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon koṅka sbyin gyis mdzad pa/ bla med du gtogs rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje phag mo dbang du 208 bya ba'i cho ga lung las rjes gnang med la bla med du gtogs/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtog pa don thams cad 209 'grub pa dang*/ bla med du gtogs/ gnyis ka thun mong du rjes gnang gcig mdzad cing*/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig dang bklags pas don grub tu lha mo sgyu ma chen mo'i dur khrod ces pa yan rtog pa dang*/ de man sgrub thabs su dbye ba yin 'dug gong dkar ba sogs gsan yig phal cher du so sor ma dbye bar gcig tu bris 'dug go /de'i phag dmar 210 phyag bzhi ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ rnam snang sgyu dra nas gsungs pa'i rje btsun byams pa 211 zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub 212 thabs gnyis/ gnyis ka thun mong du rjes gnang gcig dzam+bha la nag po zhal gcig phyag 213 gnyis pa u tsuṣ+ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/

rjes gnang yod/ dzam ser gnod sbyin 214 pho dgu mo dgu yab yum gcig tu bsdoms pa lha dgu'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ nor rgyun ma gtso 'khor la yab 215 rnams lus dkyil gyi tshul du bkod pa'i dzam ser lha mang gi sgrub thabs/ 'di dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gcig ste gnyis bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig dzam ser zhal gsum 216 phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ dzam ser zhal gcig 217 phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis la rjes gnang gcig yang dzam+bha la'i sgrub 218 thabs mdor bsdus pa/ nor rgyun ma gtso 'khor la yab rnams 219 lus dkyil gyi tshul du bkod pa'i dzam ser lha mang gi sgrub thabs/ dzam+bha la la chu 220 rgyun 'bul ba'i man 221 ngag nang gses su 222 le tshan gsum yod pa/ lung las rjes gnang med/ rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum 223 phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs/ tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang yod/ rtog pa bdun pa las 224 gsungs pa'i rta mgrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ rgyud kyi snying po phyi ma'i rta mgrin zhal 225 gsum phyag brgyad lha lnga pa'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta shrad+dhā ka ras mdzad pa/ rjes gnang yod/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal zhal bzhi phyag 226 brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba mthing kha zhal bzhi 227 phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje rta mchog dmar po zhal bzhi phyag 228 brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'phags pa gshin rje gshed dmar po zhal gcig phyag 229 gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ bla med yin rjes gnang yod/ gshin rje gshed nag po phyag 230 gnyis pa'i sgrub 231 thabs gnyis/ bla med yin la gnyis ka bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i

232 sgrub thabs/ 'di gnyis la rjes gnag cig mdzad bla med yin/ gshin rje mthar byed zhal 233 gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje mthar 234 byed gdong drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ bla med yin rjes gnang yod/ ngor chen dang gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na gdong drug ces pa'i gsal kha mi 'dug kyang rjes gnang gi yig cha gnyis dang rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na gsal lo/ /bgegs mthar byed 235 nag po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ hūm̐ mdzad nag po 236 phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ stobs po che dmar po 237 phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub ngor gong dkar mkhyen brtse thar rtse shar pa lnga'i gsan yig dang bklags pas don grub na 'di min pa'i shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i stobs po che'i sgrub thabs shig yod tshul byung yang rgya gzhung dang rin chen sgron me gnyis na mi snang*/ thabs/ rjes gnang yod/ he ru ka sngon po phyag gnyis pa 238 dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs/ bla med yin rjes gnang yod/ dgyes rdor sngon po phyag gnyis pa 239 yum bcas kyi sgrub thabs tā ra shrīs mdzad pa/ bla med yin rjes gnang yod/ bdag med ma 240 rkyang pa'i sgrub 241 thabs le tshan gnyis/ bla med yin gnyis ka la rjes gnang gcig mdzad/ dpal ldan 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub 242 thabs mdor bsdus pa/ 'di gnyis ka bla med du gtogs shing rjes gnang gcig de'i sgrub 243 thabs dam pa thams cad 'dren pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ nag po gur gyi mgon po'i sgrub 244 thabs/ bla med du gtogs rjes gnang yod/ rgya gzhung rin chen sgron mer gsan yig rnams mthun par sgrub thabs gnyis kyi gsal kha ma byung bas bklags pas don grub tu gnyis byung ba yi ge nor ba 'dra/ dpal ldan 245 nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/

bla med du gtogs/ rjes gnang yod/ 'di rnams la ris mthun rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas rjes gnang brgya dang sum cu rtsa brgyad 'byung ba dang lung bcas legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra gup+ta/ shu bhā wa ka ra gup+ta/ pū dza ti gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ gau taṃ shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta kīrti tsan+d+ra/ yar klungs lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan rin chen/ gar thig pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge bla ma mgon po 'bum/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen go rams pa bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ de dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ mtshungs med bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med shes bya bzang po'am/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bstan 'dzin lhun grub gang yin brtag de nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ bzhi sde chos rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ de dbon rdo rje 'chang shes rab 'byung gnas/ de dbon 'jam mgon ye shes bzang po/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan man 'dra/ yang na mus chen nas/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog 'phel man gong ltar ro// yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel man 'dra'o//

༈ //sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i ba ri brgya rtsa'am/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa'i rjes gnang gi rim pa la rdzong chung ba sogs rgya mtsho thob na rgyun yod phyir de dang mngon rtogs mthun pa'i lha rnams kyi rjes gnang zur du mi dgos par gcig go gcig gis chod par bzhed kyang rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang gi chings sku gsung thugs dang*/ 'dir lung gsum gyi chings yin pas phyag len mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis so sor ma 'dres pa dngos gtsang ba nas ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i tho yig mun sel sgron ma'i steng nas phyag len 'phyugs med dang*/ rgya gzhung gi lung yang go rim sor bzhag la gsal byed kyi mchan bu dang bcas bkod pa la/ dpal rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag gi cho ga 1 khams pa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs dmar 'di gsum bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig ser phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub tha 2 bas brtan pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po bī r+ya bha dra dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub tha 3 bas slob dpon skan+das mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ 'di gsum bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thab 4 sa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa na dkar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 5 sa slob dpon pad+ma rgya gar gyi slob dpon gzhan zhig gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pa 'dra/ 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ 'di gnyis dang 'og tu 'byung ba'i 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs gsum la rjes gnang gcig a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thab 6 sa slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la kuṃ ta dang lo tsā ba rin bzang gi 'gyur/

rnam dag 'jam dpal lam 'jam dpal rdo rje ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thab 7 sa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rdo rje dmar po phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thab 8 sa sgyur byed gong 'dra/ rjes gnang yod/ 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po ser po phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 9 sa ba ri ba rat+na kīrtī'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ 'jam dpal rgyal po rol pa dmar ser phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 10 sa 'gyur gong 'dra/ rjes gnang yod/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub 'di gsum bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig cing tho yig na ye shes sbyor ba zhes pa 'di kha las zur pa ma rnyed/ thab 11 sa 'gyur gong 'dra/ 'di gsum bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig cing tho yig na ye shes sbyor ba zhes pa 'di kha las zur pa ma rnyed/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las bsdus pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 12 sa don yod rdo rje dang ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi shes ra 13 ba sbyor ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ 'di gsum bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig cing tho yig na ye shes sbyor ba zhes pa 'di kha las zur pa ma rnyed/ gur nas gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal yan lag med pa'i rdo rje ser po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thab 14 sa don yod rdo rje dang rat+na kīrti'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thab 15 sa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thab 16 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ 'jam dpal rdo rje dkar po dpa' bo gcig pa phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 17 sa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/

'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo dkar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 18 sa 'gyur gong 'dra/ rjes gnang yod/ 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i 'jam dpal dkar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 19 sa 'gyur gong 'dra/ rjes gnang gong gi a ra pa tsa na gnyis las logs su med/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po gdong drug pa'i sgrub thab 20 sa 'gyur gong 'dra/ rjes gnang yod/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 21 sa 'gyur gong 'dra/ rjes gnang yod/ gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thab 22 sa 'gyur gong 'dra/ rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje chos ban+du ka'i me tog mdangs can phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 23 sa slob dpon dza na pa tras mdzad pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ rjes gnang yod/ seng ge sgra dkar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 24 sa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa don yod rdo rje dang ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ ha la ha la dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thab 25 sa slob dpon lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa don yod rdo rje dang ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ 'di dang 'og gi ha la ha la gnyis la rjes gnang gcig kha sar pā ṇi dkar po phyag gnyis pa lha lnga pa'i sgrub thab 26 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ yi ge drug pa dkar po phyag bzhi pa gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thab 27 sa dpal ldan lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa'i spyan ras gzigs dkar po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thab 28 sa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ ha la ha la zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thab 29 sa lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ 'di dang gong gi ha la ha la gnyis la rjes gnang gcig las med/ pad+ma gar dbang dmar po phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor dgu pa'i sgrub thab

30 sa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rim pa'i spyan ras gzigs nag po dbu lnga phyag bcu gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 31 sa slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ dbang du byed pa sgrol ma ljang gu phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 32 sa slob dpon rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thab 33 sa slob dpon yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal pos mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ seng ldeng nags sgrol ljang gu phyag gnyis ma gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thab 34 sa rjes gnang yod/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba'ang snang*/ sgrol dkar tshe 'dzin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 35 sa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i slob ma thu bos mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/

rjes gnang yod/ au ḍi yā na'i 'od zer can ma dmar mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis gtso 'khor gnyis ma'i sgrub thab 36 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ 'di dang 'og gi 'od zer can gnyis la rjes gnang gcig rgya gzhung gi mchan na gsum zer ba 'dug pa brtag rtog pa nas gsungs pa'i 'od zer can ser mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thab 37 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ tho yig na 'og na 'byung ba zhes mngon rtogs shig yod khul 'dug kyang rgya dper mi gsal bas dpyad/ rjes gnang yod/ rtog pa nas gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo zhal lnga phyag bcu gtso 'khor bzhi pa'i sgrub thab 38 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can ser mo phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 39 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ o ḍ+yān gyi 'od zer can dmar mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma lha gnyis ma'i sgrub thab 40 sa slob dpon lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ 'di'i rjes gnang gong gi o ḍ+yān dang gcig o ḍ+yāna'i rim pa'i 'od zer can ma dmar mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thab 41 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ tsun+da dkar mo phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thab 42 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ shrī dzam+bha la yang zer/ dpal gnod gnas ser po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 43 sa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ u tsuṣ+ma dzam+bha la nag po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 44 sa rnal 'byor pa dga' ba sbyin gyis mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ nor rgyun ma ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thab 45 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ khro gnyer can ser mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab

46 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ rnam snang sgyu dra nas gsungs pa'i byams pa dmar ser zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thab 47 sa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ gur nas gsungs pa'i sher phyin dkar mo phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 48 sa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ gdan bzhi dang sam+pu ṭa nas gsungs pa'i sher phyin dkar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thab 49 sa slob dpon dge 'dun byin gyis sras kyis mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ sher phyin ser mo phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 50 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra/ 'di dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i mdor bsdus pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis la rjes gnang gcig kyang 'di sngags ring zhing 'og ma la shu bhaṃ man las med rung sngags ring ba'i rjes zlos byas pas thung ba shugs kyis 'byung bar dgongs sam snyam/ sher phyin ser mo phyag gnyis 51 ma lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ phyag mtshan 'dzin lugs dang sngags gong dang mi mthun zhing 'og nas 'byung ba'i gser mdog can dang bsdoms par rjes gnang gcig mi g.yo ba sngon po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 52 sa slob dpon pra bha ā ka ra kīrtis mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis la rjes gnang gcig las med cing dkon mchog lhun grub kyi tho yig na gsum yod zer ba brtag gtum po sngon po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 53 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad nag po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 54 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ ri khrod ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thab 55 sa/ rjes gnang yod/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i gzung 56 sa/ rjes gnang med/ dgra nag nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thab

57 sa slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ bgegs dgra sngon po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 58 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ ral gcig ma nag mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 59 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ dug sel ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thab 60 sa/ rjes gnang yod/ dug sel ma'i gzung 61 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rig byed ma dkar dmar phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 62 sa ba ri'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i rigs byed ma dmar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 63 sa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ sgrol ma sngon byung nas 'byung ba'i rigs byed ma dmar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 64 sa lo 'di dang gong gi rigs byed ma gnyis phyag mtshan cung zad mi mthun rjes gnang yod/ paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ au ḍ+yān nas 'byung ba'i rigs byed ma dmar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 65 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ 'di dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i rigs byed ma gnyis la rjes gnang gcig khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs dmar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 66 sa sa ra has mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ gang ba bzang po'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i nor rgyun ma gtso bor gyur pa'i dpal gnod gnas lha nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi sgrub thab 67 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ rgya nag rim pa'i sgrol ma nag mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 68 sa slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gong gi ral gcig ma dang gcig par snang yang rjes gnang zur du yod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje sgrol ma ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma lha bcu gcig gi sgrub thab 69 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/

rjes gnang yod/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 70 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ rnam snang sgyu drwa nas gsungs pa rig tso rkyang rnams las so sor 'brang ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thab 71 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gtso rkyang gi sgrub thab 72 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal grwa lnga'i khrod du bsres pa mi 'os kyang rgya gzhung na 'di bzhin 'dug rjes gnang yod/ rma bya chen mo ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thab 73 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ stong chen rab 'joms dkar mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thab 74 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin mthing nag phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 75 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ bsil ba'i tshal dmar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 76 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ phyir bzlog ma chen mo nag mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thab 77 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan nag mo zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 78 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ rnam par rgyal ma ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thab 79 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod cing 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma yang zer/ rdo rje gan+dha ri nag mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thab 80 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgrub thab 81 sa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thab 82 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/

rjes gnang yod/ stobs po che dmar po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thab 83 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gdugs dkar po can zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thab 84 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thab 85 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ kye rdo rje he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thab 86 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ bdag med ma nag mo phyag gnyis ma gcig pu'i sgrub thab 87 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ yang bdag med ma'i sgrub thab 88 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ rjes gnang yod/ gser mdog can gyi sher phyin ma phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub tha 89 bas lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ gong gi sher phyin ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i rjes gnang las logs su med/ mdor bsdus pa'i rdo rje phag mo dmar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thab 90 sa lo paṇa gong rjes gnang yod cing rgya dpe rnying pa zhig na 'di'i gong du he ru ka'i mngon rtogs 'dug cing sa skya ngor gyi dpe rgyun na 'dir 'dzud ces pa'i ka brda zhig brgyab 'dug pas slar dpyad do/ /'dra'i 'gyur/ rigs byed ma dmar mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thab 91 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur/ o rgyan nas 'byung ba'i rig byed ma las logs su rjes gnang med/ sgrol ma dkar mo nye bar ston pa'i sgrol ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thab 92 sa lo paṇa gong 'dra'i 'gyur rnams te/ de ltar sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas bshad pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub thabs dgu bcu go gnyis la rigs mthun bsdebs pa'i rjes gnang don dgu dang bcas pa'i tho yig mun sel sgron me zhes bya ba 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa ste rjes gnang rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ dzai tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan 'di gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la med/ pa che ba mya ngan med/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ mkhas grub gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ mkhan chen dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen shes bya bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na ngor chen nas/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge dkon mchog 'phel man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ dkon mchog 'phel man 'dra/ bod gzhung tho yig mun sel sgron me'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ tho yig mun sel sgron mer rjes gnang bdun cu don dgu yod gsung yang don du don brgyad las ma byung zhing thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gsan yig tu yang don brgyad las mi 'dug pas sgo mthun/ yang he ru ka'i sgrub thabs zhig yod med the tshom gyi gzhir byung bas de'i rjes gnang yod na don dgu 'grig rung de'i rgyun yod med som nyir snang bas slar yang dpyad do// ༈ //'phags pa'i yul gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta kun gyi gtsug tor lta bu gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che gsal bar byed pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa chen po dpal jo bo chen po a ti sha nas nye bar brgyud pa'i yi dam gyi lha'i mngon par rtogs pa dang rjes su gnang ba man ngag thor bu rnams dpal snar thang gi mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par brten snar thang brgya rtsar grags pa'i chos skor nos pa'i rjes gnang gang yod mchan bus bkrol te bkod pa la/

bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs/ 1 rjes gnang yod/ rten 'brel gyi gzungs chung 2 lung las rjes gnang med/ mnyam pa med pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin chen sgang ba'i zhal nas byung ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 3 lung las rjes gnang med/ rang khams ma bde ba'i dus bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa skyer sgang pa las brgyud pa'i man ngag 4 bla ma'i 'das mchod bya thabs lung las rjes gnang med/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa/ 5 des bsdebs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nyan thos kyi tshul bzung nas byang chub sems dpa'i phrin las mdzad pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la gsol ba 'debs pa/ 6 rjes gnang yod/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyi mngon rtogs bla ma zhang ston pa'i zhal nas byon pa ltar bkod pa/ 7 rjes gnang yod/ thugs rje chen po yi ge drug pa phyag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsdebs pa/ 8 rjes gnang yod/ rje btsun seng ge sgra'i mngon rtogs mchims nas mchims la brgyud pa'i man ngag bla ma'i gsung las byung ba ltar bsdebs pa/ 9 rjes gnang yod/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gtso rkyang gi bzlas lung mngon rtogs zhang ma'i zhal las byung ba ltar dge slong nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa/ 10 rjes gnang yod/ des bsdebs pa'i seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma ljang gu gtso rkyang gi mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i gsungs las byung ba/ 11 rjes gnang yod/ des bsdebs pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i bar gcod thabs kyis bsrung ba jo mo la gsol ba gdab pa bla ma'i gsung las byon pa/ 12 sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig 'don pa'i man ngag yin/ lung las rjes gnang med/ des bsdebs pa'i sgrol ma dkar mos tshe bsring ba'i man ngag

13 rjes gnang yod/ des bsdebs pa'i rje btsun ri khrod lo ma gyon ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 14 rjes gnang yod/ des bsdebs pa'i lha mo 'od zer can ma phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ 15 rjes gnang yod/ zhar byung chom rkun 'ching ba dang bcas pa/ 16 lung las rjes gnang med/ dgra nag nas gsungs pa'i lha mo dbyangs can ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 17 rjes gnang yod/ zhar byung bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dang bcas pa paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kīrti nas brgyud pa/ 18 lung las rjes gnang med/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge dmar ser phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ 19 rjes gnang yod/ zhar byung 'jam dbyangs dang dbyangs can ma yab yum la brten pa'i ril bu'i las sbyor/

20 lung las rjes gnang med/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dkar po'i sgrub thabs/ 21 rjes gnang yod/ zhar byung ma sha'i las sbyor/ 22 lung las rjes gnang zur du med/ dpal dzam+bha la ser po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ 23 rjes gnang yod/ bgegs mthar byed mthing ga phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ 24 rjes gnang yod/ khro bo stobs po che dmar po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ 25 dpal 'byung po 'dul byed phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ 26 rjes gnang yod/ dme ba brtsegs pa dud kha zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 27 rjes gnang yod/ khro bo gtum po chen po mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ 28 rjes gnang yod/ jo bo mi g.yo ba sngon po'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsdebs pa/ 29 rjes gnang yod/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i dmigs pa skor gsum sgom pa'i man ngag 30 lung las rjes gnang med/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen phyag gnyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i rjes gnang yod/ gsung las byon pa ltar bsdebs pa/ 31 sku gsung thugs kyi rten la sku khrus gsol ba dge bshes 'chad ka ba'i lung lung las rjes gnang med/ skyer sgang pa las byung ba/ 32 gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgo nas rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa dang bar gcod zhi ba'i gdams pa/ 33 lung las rjes gnang med/ bzang po spyod pa'i sgo nas 'chi ba bslu ba'i cho ga skyer sgang pa'i man ngag 34 bdag nyid nam 'chi ba dang gar skye ba sogs brtag pa dpal a ti sha'i gdams pa/ 35 lung las rjes gnang med/ jo bo lugs kyi sāts+tsha dgu ma bya thabs jo bo rjes gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gnang ba/ 36 lung las rjes gnang med/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa jo bo rje dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos sgyur ba/

37 lung las rjes gnang med/ jo mo gdugs dkar mo can zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 38 rjes gnang yod/ zhar byung nad pa la phan gdags pa/ 39 rjes gnang zur du med/ phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs sngon po phyag gnyis dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs/ 40 rjes gnang yod/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor ma cha lnga pa/ 41 lung las rjes gnang med/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen jo bo chen po lha gcig nas brgyud pa/ 42 klu la gtor ma btang ste 'byor pa sgrub pa'i man ngag 43 lung las rjes gnang med/ klu sman dang bcas pa'i klu gtor gyis gnod pa zhi ba'i man ngag 44 lung las rjes gnang med/ rgyal po lung las rjes gnang med/ chen po sde bzhi'i gtor ma paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang lo tsā ba dge bshes ston pas bsgyur ba/ 45 rjen gtor gyi man ngag bla ma'i zhal las byung ba dge slong chos kyi bla mas yi ger bris pa/ 46 lung las rjes gnang med/ spyan snga pa lugs kyi gtor ma brgya rtsa'i man ngag 47 'jur gegs kyi chu sbyin bya thabs/ 48 lung las rjes gnang med/ thugs rje chen po kha sar pā ṇi'i sgrub thabs/ 49 rjes gnang yod/ de'i sgo nas chu sbyin bya thabs/ 50 lung las rjes gnang med/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ 51 rjes gnang yod/ so 'brang ser mo zhal gsum phyag bcu ma gtso bor gyur pa'i lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 52 rjes gnang yod/ lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ 53 rjes gnang yod/ de'i gzungs kyi man ngag 54 lung las rjes gnang med/ rdo rje phag lung las rjes gnang med/ mo dbang du bya ba'i cho ga 55 gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi sde dang lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba/

56 rjes gnang yod/ byams pa ser po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ 57 sher phyin dkar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grags kyis bsgyur ba/ 58 rjes gnang yod/ nor rgyun ma ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri rin chen grags kyis bsgyur ba/ 59 rjes gnang yod/ khro gnyer can ma ser mo phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen rjes gnang yod/ grags kyis bsgyur ba/ 60 rnam sras ljang gu be con can phyag gnyis pa rjes gnang yod/ bla ma kha che dgon pa ba'i man ngag gsang ba'i yang snying la sgrub thabs gnad la dbab pa/ lung las rjes gnang med/ bla rdo lung las rjes gnang med/ bcang ba gsum gyis bstan pa/ 61 dpal mgon po gri gug mthing nag phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ 62 rjes gnang yod/ de'i rgyun gtor/ lung las rjes gnang med/ 'dzin gtor/ lung las rjes gnang med/ mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa srin gzugs ma dang bcas pa/ 63 lung las rjes gnang med/ nag po chen po'i bstod pa a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa/ 64 lung las rjes gnang med/ mgon po'i rtags kyi le'u/ 65 lung las rjes gnang med/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'dag par byed pa'i cho ga dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/ 66 lung las rjes gnang med/ gong du bshad pa'i lha rnams kyi rjes gnang gi cho ga ste/ 67 rjes gnang sgrub thabs man ngag rnams bsdoms pa'i brgya tham pa legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rje btsun byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ kun mkhyen blo gros brtan pa/

paṇa chen shān+ti pa/ slob dpon pā ra he ta/ jo bo chen po dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rngog lo tsā ba legs pa'i shes rab/ rngog lo blo ldan shes rab/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge gtsang nag thugs rje seng ge gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ 'di phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs mkhan/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ rgyang ro paṇa chen/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dbang ston grub pa shes rab/ khu ston bsod nams mchog grub/ chos rje dpal 'bar ba dpal ldan don grub/ rtses thang las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ thel brag lcog thams cad mkhyen pa/ thon pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ shangs ri bo dge 'phel ba rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ thugs sras gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rab 'byams chos rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ gnas lnga rig pa ngag dbang skal ldan 'dren pa rgya mtsho 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i 'bangs/ skyor mda' ba mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin dbang chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin du stsal to// yang gong gsal 'ga' zhig la sgos kyi brgyud pa 'dug pa ltar na/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo rje nas/ dgon pa pa/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ dgyer sgom chen po/ sangs rgyas dbon/ dpal ldan gro/ mchims nam mkha' grags man sngar dang 'dra/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi rjes gnang phyag mchod bcas kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo rje nas/ sems tsam rnam bden gyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/

po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ lha spyil bu ba/ rgan mo lhas pa chen po/ gro mo che/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ yang mi 'khrugs pa'i nye brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ jo bo rje/ rnal 'byor pa chen po/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ bya yul ba/ mu sman pa tshar chen/ gro bdud rtsi grags/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ yang mchims nas/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa brtson 'grus/ mchims blo bzang grags pa man 'dra/ yi ge drug pa'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni bya yul ba yan mi 'khrugs pa ltar la/ de nas gnubs ye shes seng ge sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa brtson 'grus/ mchims blo bzang grags pa man 'dra/ seng ge sgra'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ bya yul ba nas/ bar 'dir bla ma gzhan yod med brtag mchims brtson seng*/ mchims don rgyal/ mchims blo gros brtan pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo rje nas dgon pa ba/ kā ma pa shes rab 'od/ lum pa ba ye shes byang chub/ chu mig pa shes rab grags pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims man sngar bzhin no// seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma dang 'od zer can ma'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal bzhin no// dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma kīrti/ mar do chos kyi dbang phyug mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags yan spyi brgyud ltar la/ de nas zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims man 'dra/ dzam+bha la ser po'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañju gho ṣa/ shī la tsan+d+ra/ bla ma grags rgyal ba/

rgyang ro paṇa chen/ mchims blo bzang grags pa man sngar dang 'dra'o// bgegs mthar byed/ stobs po che/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngon rnams kyi brgyud pa brgyud pa 'di mchims blo bzang grags pa nas spyi brgyud dang 'brel ba ma gtogs/ mchims nam mkha' grags nas min no gsung*/ lugs gcig ni 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal dang 'dra/ mi g.yo ba'i dmigs pa skor gsum gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ chu mig pa nas/ rma shākya gzhon nu/ bar 'dir bla ma gzhan yod med brtag dpal ldan gro/ sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ 'di gro ston nas brgyud pa 'dren pa las mchims nam mkha' grags kyi brgyud pa ni min no/ gdugs dkar gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ a bha yā ka ra/ kīrtī tsan+d+ra/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma gzhon nu bka' bcu pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor ma cha lnga'i lung gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo rje nas/ 'brom ston pa/ po to ba/ ram sdings pa/ ldan shes rab grags/ slob dpon chu nag pa rin chen seng ge ra za ba dar ma rgyal mtshan/ gnyis ka las mchims nam mkha' grags pa ste man sngar dang 'dra/ rjen gtor gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo rje nas/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ dge bshes phyag sor ba/ zhu ldan pa/ dpal ldan gro/ zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ nor rgyun ma'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni dzam+bha la dang 'dra/ sher phyin ma dkar mo dang khro gnyer can ser mo'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal dang 'dra/ rnam thos sras kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/

zangs dkar bar 'dir bla ma gzhan yod med brtag lo tsā ba/ chu mig pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims man 'dra/ mgon po gri gug gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ dzi na mi tra/ shān+ti pa/ jo bo rje/ dge bshes 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ mu sman pa char chen/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston man 'dra/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo mar do dang dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur gyi mi g.yo ba sogs mchims kyis gsan pas brgyud pa so sor byung ba ma gtogs brgyud pa de min pa jo bo nas brgyud pa med dam snyam pa'i 'khrul gzhi gzung bar mi bya'o// ༈ //gnas lnga rig pa yongs su rdzogs pa mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug a bha yā ka ra gup+ta zhes 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas par grags pa de nyid in+d+ra u la'i gtsug lag khang du thos bsam sgom gsum gyis brtan pa spel ba'i tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma bud med ba glang sha ba'i rigs su sprul nas sha chang byin pa phyir slog pa'i rten 'brel gyis sku tshe de la mchog gi dngos grub ma thob kyang 'gyod bshags kyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshe sgrib sbyong du sngags kyi man ngag du ma dang khyad par sam+pu ṭa'i 'grel pa rgyas pa gcig gdul bya rnams kyi 'jug sgo rgyud sde bzhi'i cho ga rgyas pa dang de'i lha'i tshogs rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga lo rgyus gcig la ma hā bo dhis lung bstan yang zer/ rtsoms shig par lung bstan zhing dbugs phyung ba la brten nas rgyud sde spyi'i dgongs 'grel du 'gyur ba'i phreng ba skor gsum gyi yig cha mdzad cing*/ 'di la gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbang du byas na dkyil 'khor lnga stong brgyad brgya bcu bdun/ rtsa ba'i lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbye ba nyis stong dang drug brgya nga bdun/

de rnams gtso bo'i rigs so so'i dbang du byas pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad/ de las spros pa zhe gnyis/ de las spros pa nga lnga rnams tshad thub kyi mkhas pa yongs la grags shing*/ de'i steng du sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen yan la rdo rje phreng ba las ma dar na'ang paṇ+ḍi ta dar+pan ā tsār+ya zhes 'gro ba'i me long du grags pa de la lī ta badz+ra sogs mkhas grub mang po la brten nas gsang sngags kyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su byin gyis brlabs/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ tshems lan nyi shu brjes shing dgung lo stong dang nyis brgya bzhugs pa des phreng ba skor gsum du gsal ba de don sor bzhag thog bde legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi tshad/ mtshan dpe'i ngos 'dzin sogs lhag kha yar dang bcas pa bsnan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba'i cho ga kri yā sa muts+tsha zhes sgrub dkyil yan lag dang bcas pa don tshan drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sgo nas ston pa'i bstan bcos chen po zhig mdzad pa 'phags pa'i yul du dar rgyas shin tu che zhing*/ bod 'dir thog mar rgya dpe zhig bal po'i tshong pa'i lag nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gcen 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan gyi phyag tu byung*/ de la brten nas kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang gis bdag rkyen mdzad nas bi ka mā la shī la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mañju shrī dang sa bzang lo tsā ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur kyang chos kyi rgyun med pa la/ mnga' ris pa rdo rje dpal gyis bal yul ye rang du kri yā sa muts+tsha'i dbang zhus pa'i gtam thos pa'i rkyen gyis sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros kyis paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā bo dhi las dbang lung rdzogs par gsan/ de nas phreng ba dang kri yā gnyis dbang gi chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa lnga ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rdo rje phreng ba'i sgrub dkyil sbrags pa rdor phreng mdzes rgyan gyi steng sta gon gsum sgrub mchod sogs dam pa'i phyag len 'khrul med dang dbang gi skabs kyang dkyil 'khor mang mar phreng ba'i steng du kri yā'i sgos chos kha yar bsnan pa'i phyag len rgyas pa/

dus 'khor lha grangs mangs pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod yun ring bar brten phreng rkyang gi phyag len bsdus shos 'khor lo bsgyur drug la kri yā'i sgos chos phra mo rnams kyang bsnan pa'i phyag len shin tu rgyas par thob pa la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i mi bskyod pa'i rigs gsang 'dus 'ja

1 ma dpal rdo rje lha bcu dgu/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha 2 so gnyis/ rnam snang sgyu drwa'i rgyud slob dpon kun snying dang bi shwa mi tras rnam snang sgyu drwa gsang 'dus kyi rgyud phyi ma'i phyi mar bshad/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang don gyis gsang 'dus dang phyogs mthun par bzhed/ la brten pa'i 'jam dpal rdo rje lha 3 zhe gsum/ rtsa ba'i rgyud gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud la brten pa'i rnam snang gi rigs 'jam 4 dpal gshin rje gshed lha bcu gsum ste pha rgyud bzhi/ brtag pa gnyis pa nas gsungs pa'i he ru ka'i rigs kyi dpal dgyes pa 5 rdo rje thod pa can zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa lha dgu/ thugs rdo rje zhal gsum 6 phyag drug pa lha dgu/ gsung rdo rje zhal 7 gcig phyag bzhi pa lha dgu/ sku rdo rje zhal 8 gcig phyag gnyis pa lha dgu/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga rigs 9 bsdus pa lha lnga bcu rtsa gsum/ sam+pu ṭa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bdag 10 med lha mo nyer gsum/ brtag gnyis nas gsungs pa'i bdag 11 med lha mo bco lnga/ yang rgyud de nyid las gsungs pa'i ku ru 12 kul+le lha bco lnga/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur nas bshad pa'i rdo rje sgrol ma 13 lha bcu gsum/ sam+pu ṭa nas gsungs pa'i snying po kye rdo rje mtshon cha 14 can zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa lha bcu bdun/ thugs 15 rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa lha bcu bdun/ gsung rdo rje zhal 16 gcig phyag bzhi pa lha dgu/ sku rdo rje zhal 17 gcig phyag gnyis pa lha bcu bdun rnams gnyis med kyi rgyud/ sam+pu ṭa nas gsungs pa'i bde mchog rdo rje sems dpa' 18 lha so bdun/ bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa 19 zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ bde 20 mchog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/

bde 21 mchog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ phag mo dmar 22 mo lha sum cu rtsa bdun/ phag 23 mo sngon mo lha so bdun/ phag 24 mo ser mo lha so bdun/ a bhi dha na las gsungs pa'i hūm̐ mdzad 25 khro bo bcu gcig 'di bde mchog khro bo rdor sems su a bha yā bzhed do// yang rgyud de nyid las gsungs pa'i bde mchog 'khor lo sgyur drug 26 lha bdun bcu rtsa gnyis/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud la brten nas rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs kyi rdo rje bdud 27 rtsi lha nyer gcig bdud rtsi hūm̐ mdzad 28 lha nyer dgu/ bdud 29 rtsi khro bo lha nyer gcig bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 30 lha bcu gsum/ he ru ka'i rigs sangs 31 rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga/ sangs 32 rgyas thod pa lha dgu/ ma hā mā yā'i rgyud chung la brten pa'i ma hā 33 mā yā lha lnga/ gdan bzhi'am rgyud gser gyi char pa nas bshad pa'i rnam snang gi rigs rnal 'byor nam mkha' 34 lha lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ de'i yum bka' ye shes mkha' 35 'gro lha bcu gsum rnams bde mchog gi phyogs su gtogs pa'am rnal 'byor ma rgyud/ sngon byung drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta sogs drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi 'dul pa'i don du gsungs pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud la brten nas sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa 36 lha drug brgya sum cu rtsa bzhi/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na stong dang bzhi brgya/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su phye na dgyes rdor nas 'di'i bar ma rgyud du bsdus kyang 'thad do// de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i thabs gtso bor ston pa rdo rje dbying 37 sa lha lnga bcu rtsa gsum/ ngan song sbyong rgyud dang brtag pa phyogs gcig la brten pa'i gtsug dgu 38 lha sum cu rtsa bdun/ sgyu drwa'i rgyud dang 'jam dpal grags pa'i mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa la brten nas shes rab gtso bor ston pa chos

3 dbyings gsung 39 dbang lha nyis brgya nyer gcig ste rnal 'byor rgyud/ rtsa bshad 'phros pa cha mthun pa yan lag gi rgyud lnga'i nang nas yan lag gi rgyud dam rdor dbyings dang cha mthun pa'i rgyud du bshad cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su ngos 'dzin par snang ngo*/ /'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud la brten pa'i rdo rje'i rigs gsang ba'i bdag 1 po 'byung po 'dul 40 byed lha so gsum pa spyod rgyud/ rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na bya rgyud gsum/ yo ga gsum zhes 'dug pas bya rgyud du bzhed pa 'dra'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum 1 'od zer can 41 ma lha nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga 42 lha 2 bcu gsum/ 'di yan gyis phreng rkyang gi dkyil 'khor zhe gnyis tshang*/ kri yā nas gsungs pa'i bde legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum zhes pa nor rgyun ma'i rtog chung la brten pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gnas gtsang ma'i lha nor rgyun 43 ma lha 3 bcu dgu/ gza' yum gyi rtog pa las gsungs pa'i rigs byed ma nub byang gi grwar bzhugs pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor 4 byas pa'i gza' 44 yum lha zhe drug gam lnga bcu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtsug tor rnam 45 rgyal ma lha 5 sum cu rtsa gsum ste/ bya rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor lnga dang bcas pa rnams kyi dbang legs par thob pa'i rdo rje phreng ba dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha badz+ra dha raḥdz+nyā na ḍā ki nī/ a tsār+ya a bha yā ka ra gup+taḥ/ paṇ+ḍi tā nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bi bak+ṣa ta de waḥ/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha draḥ/ alpa nap+ti ka bhū mi dhā ra ṣ+ya shrīḥ/ ta s+ya pu tra bi ma la shrī bha draḥ/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa/ mkhas pa dpe med bsrungs pa/

mkhas pa chen po mkhyen brtse thar rtse sgrub khang gsum gyi gsan yig na bi k+ṣa ta de wa dang*/ shar pa'i gsan yig na rnam grangs lha zer ba 'dug cing sngags rams pa'i gsan yig na bidz+dza de wa ste rnam bshad lha zhes snang ba sogs mi mthun tsam kha yar byung ba slar yang brtag go /rnam bshad lha/ mkhas pa chen po shākya dpal bzang po/ dpon chung sa gzhi'i dpal/ de'i sras dri med dpal bzang*/ maṅkhar lo ka tsak+ṣu bo dhi singhaḥ/ skyi shāsta kīrti dh+wa dzaḥ/ dolpo sarba dz+nyā pradz+nyā dh+wa dzaḥ/ su bhū mi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti dh+wa dzaḥ/ su bhū myār+ya ku mā ra ma tiḥ/ badz+ra dha rā nan+da bha draḥ/ bo dhi satwa ma ti rat+naḥ/ mañju gho ṣa bud+dha rat+naḥ/ dzi na su rot+ta ma singha ཿ/ mang mkhar 'jig rten/ mig byang chub seng ge skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dol po kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang paṇa chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge mṛ du swa ra rat+na ni rā bho gaḥ/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub/ mok+ṣā gra pa ṭu sid+dha ga ga na shrī bha draḥ/ thar rtse pa mkhas grub nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ bhū mi paṇ+ḍ+ra ka mañju gho ṣā nan+da puṇ+ya ni rā bho ga maṃ ga la kīrti dh+wa dzaḥ/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan/ ta to gu ru dwi tri mā tra a lab+dhe ṇa pu narnish+tsi ta lab+dha sh+tsa ban+dhaḥ/ tata shrī bhū mī paṇ+ḍa ka wā gin+d+rā nan+da maṅga laṃ/ ma ho pra dh+yā ya mai tri shī la shrī bha draḥ/ mok+ṣā gra ma ho pā dh+yā ya ga ga na saṃ kalpa sid+dhaḥ/ ma hā pra sā da sarba dz+nyā bud+dha shrī bha draḥ/ de nas bla ma gnyis gsum tsam ma rnyed pas slar nges par rnyed pa dang sbrel/ de nas dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/

mkhan chen byams pa tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ thar rtse mkhan chen nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ drin chen thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ te nāt+ma dwan+de shī la rat+naṃ pra da dāta/ bā rat+na ni rā bho gā ta/ pūrba gṛ ha pradz+nyā dh+wa dzaḥ/ mok+ṣā gra pash+tsi ma pūrba bta/ tsa pa ra ma de wa singhā ta/ pūrba gṛ ha pash+tsi ma sa mā naḥ/ bā rat+na ni rā bho gāta/ swā mi bud+dhi singhaḥ/ mok+ṣā gra pash+tsi ma sa mā naḥ/ des bdag btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse pa man sngar bzhin no// yang na lha mchog seng ge nas/ shar khang pa man 'dra/ yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ rjes sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse pa man 'dra/ bi bhā ṣa a bha yā ka rāta/ su tsā rā ka ra gup+taḥ/ shu bha ka ra gup+taḥ/ rat+na rak+ṣī ta/ ma tu la lo tsā sid+dha shrīḥ/ mkhas pa shākya badz+raḥ/ ma dh+ya bud+dha lak+ṣaḥ/ lo ka tsak+ṣu rut+ta ma bāṃ/ skyi shāsta pash+tsi ma pūrba bta/ wā a bha yā ka rāta/ nā ya kaḥ/ yang na 'jigs med 'byung gnas nas/ legs spyod 'byung gnas sbas pa/ dge byed sbas pa/ rin chen bsrung ba/ zhang 'jig rten du sgrog pa gru pa dpal/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ 'jig rten mig mchog ldan/ skyi ston man snga ma bzhin no/ yang na 'jigs med 'byung gnas nas/ da 'dren pa stobs bcu'i dpal/ sha pa la shrīḥ/ bi bhak+ṣa ta de wa pash+tsi mot+ta ma pa ta/ bā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī yāḥ/ glan go dan+taḥ/ gnyags badz+ra dha raḥ/ khams shāsta lho tshad pa rat+na rat+na/ lo ka tsak+ṣu ut+ta māṃ nish+tsa sa ma naḥ/ pu naḥpañca maṇ+ḍa la pañca mkha' 'gro lnga 'khor lo sgyur drug bsrung ba lnga rnams so sor phye bas te lnga/ da shi ka bhe da mā le/ a bha yā ka raḥ/ rnam bshad lha man gong ltar ro/ yang na mkhas pa shākya dpal nas/ glan ba so ba/ gnyags rdo rje 'dzin pa/ khams ston lho tshad pa dkon mchog rin chen/

'jig rten mig mchog ldan pa man 'dra/ yang dkyil 'khor lnga bcu rtsa lngar dbye ba'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas/ shākya rak+ṣi taḥ/ gau taṃ gu ruḥ/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+raḥ/ go de wa shrīḥ/ k+ṣan+ti shrīḥ/ paṇ+ḍi ta bud+dha shrīḥ/ paṇ+ḍi ta nā thaḥ/ skyi shasta ni sh+tsa sa mā naḥ/ bā maṇ+ḍa lāṣ+ṭa biṃ shat+sa yang na dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad du bsdus pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ma hā ra ṣ+ya kye rdor lha dgu ma bzhi dang bcu bdun ma bzhi bdag med ma gnyis bde mchog gsum phag mo gsum bdud rtsi bzhi rnams re re bsdus so// mā le/ shākya bsrungs pa/ gau taṃ bla ma/ grags 'byor zla ba/ sa lha'i dpal/ bzod pa dpal/ mkhas pa sangs rgyas dpal/ mkhas pa mgon po/ skyi ston man 'dra/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī yaḥ/ dak+ṣi ṇa sarba dz+nyāḥ/ de wa gṛ ha shukla/ yar klungs pa bha ga wān khaṅga s+ya/ alpaḥpradz+nyā pra ṇi dhiḥ/ gu ru bo dhi singha nish+tsa sa mā naḥ/ ga bi mā la shrī yaḥ/ lo ka tsak+ṣu ma ti s+thi raḥ/ bo dhi singha nish+tsa sa mā naḥ/ mkhas pa shākya dpal nas/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ lha khang dkar ru ba/ yar klungs pa bcom ldan ral gri/ gcung po shes rab smon lam/ bla ma byang chub seng ge man 'dra/ yang na dri med dpal nas// 'jig rten gyi mig blo gros brtan pa/ byang chub seng ge man 'dra/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dar+pan ā tsār+ya s+ya ne ma ta kri yā sa muts+tshā nāṃ maṇ+ḍal pañca ma tsa tu riṃ sha dāṃ mā la/ badz+ra dha raḥ/ dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī/ paṇ+ḍi ta dar+paṇa ā tsār+yaḥ/ sa man+ta bha draḥ/ dz+nyā na dz+yo tiḥ/ shrī hā nu man+taḥ thar rtse pa'i gsan yig na dpal yid kyi 'gram pa zhes bsgyur snang*/ shrī mañju bha draḥ/ shrī bha draḥ/ dharma dz+yo ti bha draḥ/ mkhas pa chen po slob dpon 'gro ba'i me long lugs kyi bya ba yang dag par bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon mkhas pa 'gro ba'i me long*/

kun tu bzang po/ ye shes kyi glog dpal myur ba'i mtha'am/ 'jam dpal bzang po/ dpal bzang po/ chos kyi klog bzang po/ ma na dzī wa bha draḥ/ go taṃ shrī bha draḥ/ shrī bi dza ya bha draḥ/ shrī ma da na bha dra pā daḥ/ shrī lak+ṣ+mī bha dra pā daḥ/ ga ga na bha draḥ/ u da ka dzī wa bha draḥ/ shrī har+ṣa bha dra pā daḥ/ bha ga war+bha draḥ/ dza ga ta ā nan+da dzī wa bha draḥ/ yid 'tsho ba bzang po/ ngag gi dpal bzang po/ dpal rnam rgyal bzang po/ dpal myos byed bzang po'i zhabs/ dpal phun tshogs bzang po'i zhabs/ nam mkha' bzang po/ chu'i 'tsho ba bzang po/ dpal 'phrog byed bzang po'i zhabs/ skal ldan bzang po/ skye dgu kun dga'i 'tsho ba bzang po/ ta s+yai pu tra ma hā bo dhi/ de'i sras byang chub chen po/ sa bzang ār+ya ku mā ra ma ti nish+tsa sa mā naḥ/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros man 'dra'o// ༈ //mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor gyis rgya gsum bal lan bzhi ste du lan bdun byon te/ spyir yongs grags kyi bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhi/ 'gran gyi do med ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma rnam pa gnyis dang*/ grub thob kyi bla ma bcu gsum po rnams las smin grol gyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan pa rnams bshad sgrub gnyis su 'dus/ de dag gi brgyud 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ snga bu bzhi'am lnga/ phyi bu gcig rnams kyis bstan pa bzung ba las/ snga bu zhang sgom chos kyi seng ge dang*/ phyi bu mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus gnyis kyis bstan pa bzung ba'i sgrub brgyud kyi gdams pa mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma dang su ka sid+dhi gnyis kyi gdams pa zab cing rgya che bar bzhugs pa las/ dang po mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i gdams pa thob pa'i skor la/ smin byed dbang dang byin rlabs kyi skor/ grol byed zab mo khrid kyi skor/ rgyab brten lung gi skor/ bka' srung ye shes kyi mgon po'i skor dang bzhi las/

dang po smin byed la/ chos drug spyi'i dbang khog phub/ rgyud sde lnga'i gtso bsdus kyi dbang ngam sgyu lus dbang mo che zhes bya ba ngo bo gcig la ming gi rnam grangs bzhi dang ldan pa'i dbang bskur gdams pa dang 'brel pa/ gdams ngag dbang bskur dang 'brel pas mtha' brgyan pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog tsog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mtshan ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ brgyud 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dpal ldan dar po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas/ mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel/ grub thob sangs rgyas bstan pa/ thugs sras sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// 'di yan la rtsa ba'i brgyud pa zhes bya'o// khrid gzhung dang 'brel bar nyon mongs pa'i rtsa mdud 'grol bar byed pa gtum mo'i dbang*/ nyin par gyi 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i phyir sgyu lus kyi dbang*/ gnyid kyi 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i phyir rmi lam gyi dbang*/ gti mug gi mun pa bsang ba'i phyir 'od gsal bde chen gyi dbang*/ btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir 'pho ba'i dbang*/ srid pa bar do dag pa'i phyir bar do'i dbang ste

'di yan sgos bka' drug go /gzhung shing chen mo dang 'brel ba'i bde mchog dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs kyang khog phub kyi grangs su bgrang*/ bka' brgyad/ phyag chen ga'u ma'i dbang*/ bla ma lam khyer gyi dbang*/ yi dam lam khyer gyi dbang*/ sgyu ma lam khyer gyi dbang*/ lus sems 'chi med kyi dbang ste phyag rgya chen po'i bka' lnga rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston yan gong bzhin las/ de nas mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ 'jags chen byams pa dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros dpal bzang*/ 'jags chen kun dga' dpal bzang*/ kun mkhyen chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ rdo ring kun spangs chen po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags man sngar dang 'dra'o// yang na mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston yan 'dra ba las/ de nas mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ de gnyis ka las mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor ram nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ bla ma chos rgyal bkra shis/ 'khrul zhig byams pa sher bzang*/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs skal ldan bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man sngar 'jags ma lugs dang 'dra'o// khog phub kyi nang tshan bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs kyi byin rlabs/ bde mchog lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi dbang*/ bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi dbang*/ rnam 'joms gsang sgrub phyag rdor gsang sgrub sogs gsang sgrub skor lnga bzhugs pa'i gsang sgrub dang po gsum po dang dbang bzhi gnyis te bka' lnga po 'di rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ngag dbang chos grags yan bshad ma thag pa'i 'jags ma lugs ltar las/

de nas byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel/ rong po sangs rgyas bstan pa man 'dra'o// mkha' spyod ma dkar mo'i dbang*/ mkha' spyod ma dmar mo'i dbang*/ mkha' spyod gsum phrugs kyi dbang ste bka' gsum thob pa'i brgyud pa ni ngag dbang chos grags yan bshad ma thag pa'i 'jags chen lugs ltar las/ de nas ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba lhun grub/ spro lung pa bsod nams chos 'phel man 'dra'o// mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ su kha sid+dhi/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog cog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyen ston pa/ chos rje ston pa ste brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun dang*/ de nas lung bstan thob pa lnga ni/ gtsang ma shangs ston pa/ rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ byams pa dpal/ blo gros dpal/ kun dga' dpal bzang ba ste/ de las bka' drin can bsod nams bzang po/ des mkhas grub chos kyi nyi ma/ des rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' chos grags/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ rje byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' don grub/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba lhun grub/ spro lung pa bsod nams chos 'phel man sngar dang 'dra'o// spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug grub chen rā hu la gup+ta/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag song ba/ ba yu ba shes rab tshul khrims/ lce sgom shes rab rdo rje/ skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbon ston brtson seng*/ 'gro mgon tshul khrims 'bum/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug mtshan ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/

kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po nas ngag dbang chos grags kyi bar gong gi 'jags ma lugs kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra/ yang na ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas man 'dra/ yang na mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ paṇa chen nam dbang*/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' bsod nams/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshul khrims bzang po/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku khro rgyal rta mchog sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gter ston snye mo zhu yas/ de gnyis char las skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge de nas gnyen ston chos kyi shes rab/ sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa dpal bzang*/ drin chen sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags man ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba'i brgyud pa dang 'dra/ yang na ngag dbang chos grags nas/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal dbang lhun grub/ spro lung pa bsod nams chos 'phel man 'dra'o// gnyis pa grol byed khrid kyi skor la/ mkhas grub rgyal mtshan 'bum gyi khrid yig dang*/ grub chen rin po che thang stong rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gnad yig snying po kun 'dus kyi steng nas rtsa ba ni gu chos drug gi khrid/

yal ga lam khyer rnam gsum/ 'bras bu lus sems 'chi med/ sdong po phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid rnams brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes dri ma med pas brgyan nas legs par thob pa'i snga ma gsum gyi brgyud pa'ang*/ gong gi rtsa ba'i brgyud pa dang mthun no// gdams pa de rnams 'chad thabs kyi yi ge la/ ni gu chos drug gi dbang chog 'jug sgo yon tan kun 'byung kun mkhyen gangs khrod pas mdzad pa dang*/ chos drug gi sgos bka' so so'i phyag len ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ lam khyer gsum gyi yi ge rgya gzhung*/ phyag chen ga'u ma'i dbang chog ngag chos pas mdzad pa/ chos drug khrid yig grub chen rin po che thang stong rgyal pos mdzad pa dang*/ rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis mdzad pa/ chos drug gdan thog gcig ma ngag chos pas mdzad pa/ lam khyer gsum gyi khrid yig 'bras bu lus sems 'chi med kyi khrid yig ga'u ma'i khrid yig rnams grub chen rin po ches mdzad pa/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar phrugs gsum gyi yi ge gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi byin rlabs chos tshan gcig ma tshang ba rnams ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs bya tshul/ lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi byin rlabs dang nyams su len tshul/ mkha' 'gro ma su ka sid+dhi'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge rnams ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gnas sbyar ma khyung pos mdzad pa kha skong dang bcas pa/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa/ 'gyur med bde chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi dam lam khyer gyi dbang gi brgyud 'debs zung 'jug rgyal srid ma kha skong dang bcas pa/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs sku gsum bdun ldan ma/ yang sku gsum bdun ldan chung ba rnams kyi steng nas dbang dang byin rlabs khrid stsal ba mdzad cing*/

de rnams kyi lung yang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gong gi dbang byin rlabs khrid so so'i brgyud pa'i skabs ltar rtsa ba'i brgyud pa chen po dang 'dra'o// gsum pa rgyab brten lung gi skor la gdams pa 'di brgyud pa gang las byung ba'i 'byung khungs bstan pa'i sgo nas yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir brgyud pa'i rnam thar skor dang*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos kyi lung nos pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar rmog cog pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i rnam thar/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyi rnam thar rmog cog pa sogs bzhis bsdebs pa/ de'i lhan thabs dang gsang ba'i rnam thar/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus kyi rnam thar rje rang gis mdzad pa dang*/ skyer sgang pas mdzad pa gnyis/ skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge'i rnam thar rje rang gis mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas gnyen ston gyi rnam thar dge slong gzhon nu seng ge la gnang ba/ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa'i rnam thar brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi don du bkod pa/ shangs ston tshul khrims mgon po'i rnam thar rje rang gis mdzad pa/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal gyi rnam thar dge bshes smon lam pas mdzad pa/ mkhas grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnam thar gsol 'debs chos kyi seng ges mdzad pa/ mtshan ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam thar dge slong rin chen dar gyis mdzad pa/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar 'khor ba dong sprugs thugs sras rin po ches mdzad pa rnams so// gnyis pa ni ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas mdzad pa'i chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'gor skad gnyis shan sbyar dang bcas pa'i rjes su/ gang zhig brjod bral lhun grub 'dus ma byas// zhes yod pa lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba la slar yang rin chen bzang pos gtan la phab pa/ khyung pos mdzad pa'i thems yig tshigs bcad ma/

des mdzad pa'i thabs lam/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ 'pho ba bar do dang bcas pa'i sgos skabs kyi yi ge 'phyugs med bar do gsum gyi gdams pa khyung po'i nyams myong ma/ 'od gsal la 'char sgo ngos 'dzin don dam mngon gyur gzhan don lhun grub shog gi mtha' can/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gnad drug go drug sogs bstan pa phyag chen rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'gor skad gnyis shan sbyar dang*/ bde chen lhun grub 'dus ma byas zhes dang*/ tha mal shes pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i mtha' can sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen gyis mdzad pa glan dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ phyag chen gyi dbang gi yi ge dbang bzhi'i zin bris yin no'i mtha' can/ lam khyer rnam gsum gyi rgya gzhung 'gor skad gnyis shan sbyar dang*/ gang gi bla ma mchog bsten dbang thob pas zhes yod pa/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mas mdzad pa glan dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'gor bde chen rgyal po lhun grub 'dus ma byas// tshad med thugs rjes sems can smin grol mdzad// ces yod pa'i khyad 'phags lam khyer rnam gsum gyi gdams pa rtsa ba'i sa bcad bzhis bstan pa/ mjug tu/ e ma bka' brgyud rtsod med 'di// zhes sogs yod pa/ 'gor rgyal ba longs sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// zhes yod pa'i rgyud sde lnga'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa lo gsum gyis mi 'grub pa mi srid ces yod pa/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs btud nas// bcom ldan bde mchog lha lnga yi// zhes yod pa'i bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtog khyung pos mdzad pa/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs mchod byed par 'dod pas zhes yod pa'i bde mchog gi mchod phreng tshogs mchod dang 'brel ba tshul khrims mgon pos bkod pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gsang sgrub nyams su len tshul ni gu ma'i khyad par gdams pa/ rnam 'joms bka' rgya ma zhes pa rang lus bum pa dang snying gar lha sgom tshul yod pa khrus chu'i gdams pa shin tu zab pa yin no'i mtha' can/

sgyu ma lam rim gyi skor la/ 'gor skad gnyis shan sbyar dang*/ gdod nas rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung 'gyur zhing*// zhes yod pa'i sgyu ma lam rim ni gu mas mdzad pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma de nyid dang lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ 'gor skad shan sbyar dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho rdo rje 'chang*// khyed zhabs bdag gis gus btud nas// sgyu ma lam rim gsal byed don// mdo dang rgyud las gsungs bzhin bris// zhes yod pa'i sgyu ma lam rim gyi 'grel pa gnyis mdzad pa dang 'gyur byang gong dang 'dra/ sgyu ma lam rim gyi sa bcad khyung pos yi ger bkod pa/ sgyu lus 'byams gcod kyi bsdus don don tshan bzhis bstan pa/ sgyu lus 'dzin pa rang grol 'gor ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma sgyu lus la gsum bzhi zhes yod pa/ mkha' spyod dkar mo'i dbang bskur gyi yi ge mkha' spyod dkar mo'i rgya gzhung skad gnyis shan sbyar can dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa rin bzang gi 'gyur/ yang mkha' spyod dkar mo'i sgrub thabs a ti sha'i lugs/ yang mkha' spyod ma mdun du bsgom pa'i yi ge khyung po'i lugs/ yang mdun du bla ma dang de'i smin mtshams su mkha' spyod ma bsgom ste 'od zer gyi spro bsdu la brten te dam tshig gso ba'i nyams chag bshags pa/ mkha' spyod kyi ril bu sgrub thabs chig brgyud ma/ mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho ba bya tshul/ khyung pos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod dmar mo'i sgos bka' drug gi nang tshan 'pho ba'i dbang bskur/ 'chi med kyi rgya gzhung ḍā ki mas mdzad pa/ 'gor skad gnyis dang*/ rgyal ba longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// 'chi med ye shes rang sgra 'di skad thos// zhes yod pa lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba la rin bzang gis bcos pa/ rmi lam gyi dbang chog che ba ḍā ki ma'i gsung khyung pos bkod pa/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi tho chung gcig khyung pos ḍā ki ma la zhus pa/

lam khyer gsum gyi dbang chog mdzad byang med pa/ 'pho ba'i man ngag nyung ngu*/ 'chi med kyi dbang chog mdzad byang med pa/ thugs rje chen po gsang sgrub kyi dbang chog 'gor lo ka dbang phyug gi bka' zhes pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ lus 'chi med kyi dbang chog sems 'chi med kyi khrid yig mthar 'di las zab pa rgya bod gnyis na med gsungs pa/ sems 'chi med kyi zhal gdams sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung*/ gnad 'phyugs med bar do gsum gyi nyams len khyung po'i yi ge 'byams gcod khyung po'i thugs bcud rmog cog pas mdzad pa/ khyad 'phags sdom pa bco lnga pa rgyas bsdus gsum khyung pos mdzad pa/ dbu ma yi ge bdun ma nā ros ni gu la gdams pa/ rang grol rtsa ba ḍā ki ma'i gsung khyung pos zhus pa glan dar mas bsgyur ba/ sgyu lus gdan thog gcig ma chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung*/ 'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin/ sgyu lus sbyang ba rnam gsum khyung po'i yi ge khyung po'i gnas drug ces bya ba sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung bzhin bkod ces pa'i mtha' can/ phyag chen bskyed rim rlung dang bsre ba ji ltar 'dod kyang bla ma'i snang ba dang mi 'bral zhes yod pa/ maṇ+ḍal bka' rgya ma dang rab gnas bka' rgya ma gnyis khyung pos mdzad pa/ 'gor skad gnyis shan sbyar phyag 'tshal dang bcas pa'i rjes su/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// thugs rje phrin las phun sum tshogs pa yi// bdag gis smon lam 'di dag thams cad kun// ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /ces yod pa'i smon lam bka' rgya ma khyung pos mdzad pa/ 'gor yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin// zhes yod pa'i bkra shis bka' rgya ma khyung pos mdzad pa rnams dang*/ 'gor dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'dud// 'phyugs med lam khyer rnam gsum gyi// zhes yod pa'i lam khyer rnam gsum gyi khrid yig

dh+wa dza lak+ṣas gzhan phan blos bkod pa/ bla ma lam khyer gyi byin rlabs bya tshul/ de'i sham du sgyu ma lam khyer gyi byin rlabs bya tshul gyi sa bcad tsam smos pa/ yang bla ma lam khyer gyi byin rlabs bya tshul gong ma de dang tshig rgyas bsdus tsam yod pa/ 'gor mdo rgyud man ngag nyams myong gis// zhes yod pa'i 'chi med kyi zhal gdams rat+na bir+was mdzad pa/ 'gor nyin par snang stong lha sku la// zhes yod pa'i 'chi med rang grol dharma singhas mdzad pa/ 'gor rang grol bde chen 'dus ma byas// dharma singha'i zhabs la 'dud// ces yod pa'i rang sems 'chi med rang grol gyi gdams pa dharma pradz+nyās mdzad pa/ 'gor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la btud nas// 'chi med rang grol dbang bskur bshad// ces yod pa'i 'chi med kyi dbang bskur bya tshul/ 'gor na mo gu ru/ dben pa'i gnas su 'gro zhing sems bskyed nas// rang bde mchog tu bsgoms pa'i spyi bor bsgoms la zhes yod pa'i 'chi med kyi khrid yig 'di las zab pa'i gdams pa rgya bod gnyis na med gsungs pa/ 'gor bde chen rgyal po lhun grub 'dus ma byas// longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo rje 'chang chen dang*// zhes yod pa'i 'chi med 'khrul 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i gsal byed nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bla ma'i phyag len ltar bir+ya seng ges lhag chad med par bris pa'i mtha' can/ 'gor dus gsum shes bya'i rnam pa ma lus pa// sgrib pa med pas sa ler mkhyen gyur pa'i// zhes yod pa'i zhus lan rin po che'i sgron me zhes bya ba chos rje dharma pra dz+nyā bīr+ya singhas zhus pa/ 'gor mkha' ltar dag pa'i chos sprul// zhes yod pa'i nyams myong yon tan rgya mtsho rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'gor dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs// bde gsal mi rtog dbyer med don// zhes yod pa'i zhal gdams rin po che 'od kyi phreng ba/

'gor snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun// zhes yod pa'i mun sel nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsum ngo bo chos kyi rje// rdo rje 'chang chen khyod nyid kyis// zhes yod pa'i zhus lan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyon mongs gdung sel rnams so// bzhi pa bka' srung ye shes mgon po'i skor la/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ sha ba ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ rā hu la gup+ta/ grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ brgyud 'dzin rin po che/ pu rong dpal ldan dar po/ zhe dgon pa bsod nams rtse mo/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal rtse ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med bstan pa rab rgyas/ grub dbang bsod nams chos 'phel/ ngag dbang tshul khrims bzang po/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi khrid rim shin tu zab pa thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang gong bshad ma thag pa ltar ro// phyag drug ye shes mgon po lha mang gi rjes gnang bar chad kun sel thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ sha ba ri dbang phyug nas gtsang ma shangs ston gyi bar mgon dkar gyi brgyud pa dang 'dra ba las/ de nas rgyal mtshan 'bum/ tshul khrims mgon po/ ri khrod ras chen/ sangs rgyas rdo rje/ thar pa bzang po/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/

dbang phyug rab brtan/ ngag dbang chos grags man gong dang 'dra/ yang na tshar chen nas/ mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos grags rgya mtsho/ dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra'o// yang na tshar chen nas/ gnyen ston rnam 'phrul gzhon nu blo gros/ dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra'o// ༈ //sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyi sa lo pa spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos grags kyi phyag len zin bris mdzad pa'i steng nas rgya gar gyi grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba legs par nos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ grub chen lū hi pa/1 dā ri ka pa/2 ḍeṃ ki pa/3 lī la pa/4 bir+wa pa/5 ḍom+bi pa/6 sha wa ri pa/7 sa ra ha/8 ko ka li pa/9 mi na pa/10 a naṅga

go rak+ṣa yang zer/ badz+ra/11 tsa'u ra/12 bī na pa/13 rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti pa/14 tog tse pa/15 tin+d+ra pa/16 tsa ma ri pa/17 khaḍ+ga pa/18 nā gārdzu na/19 nag po pa/20 ār+ya de wa/21 tha ga pa/22 tai lo pa/23 nā ro pa/24 sha li pa/25 tsa ta pa/26 bha ta pa/27 dho ṣan+ti/28 a dzu gi29 sa ka la/30 dhoṃ bi pa/31 me ko pa/32 ka ma ri pa/33 dza lan+dha ra pa/34 rā hu la/35 dharma pa/36 dho ka ri pa/37 me dha ni/38 sa ga dza la/39 dril bu pa/40 a yo gi41 tsa lo ki42 ghu dhu ri pa/43 lu tsi ka44 kaṃ rka ra/45 kaṃ pa li/46 bha de pa/47 tan+te pa/48 ku ku ri pa/49 kudz+nyā li/50 dha ma pa/51 ma dhi la/52 a tsīn+ta/53 bha la ha/54 na li pa/55 bhu su ku/56 in+d+ra bhū ti/57 lcam legs smin ka ra/58 dza len+d+ra pa/59 ni gu na/60 tsa pa ri pa/61 tsi pa ka62 bhi ṣa na/63 til brdung pa/64 ku mā ri pa/65 du me pa/66 ma ṇi bha dra/67 me kha la/68 ka na kha69 ka na ka70 kan+ta li/71 dha su ri pa/72 u dha ri pa/73 ka pā li pa/74 ki ra pa/75 mtsho skyes rdo rje/76 sarba bha ba/77 nā ga bo dhi/78 su ra li/79 sa na ha/80 ko ka li/81 a na ka82 sa mun+d+ra/83 bya ri pa/84 rnams kyi byin rlabs dang rtogs brjod bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ mkha' 'gro ma ko ki la dang dharma de wa mched gnyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta sūr+ya rasmi/ dpa' bo 'od gsal yang zer/ bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la/ grub thob dza wa ri pa/ ma ga dha'i paṇ+ḍi ta a bha ya dā na shrī/ mi nyag tsa mi lo tsā smon grub shes rab/ rin po che yab sras/ rat+na gu ru/ grub thob hūm̐ 'bar/ rgan mo lhas pa'ang zer/ khams chen byang chub dpal/ stag ston che brag pa/ gzhon nu dar ma/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma bde legs pa/ 'phags mchog bsod nams dar/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/
