tre bo chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ gling stod chos rje kun dga' 'byung gnas/ rmod pa grub chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ bco brgyad chos rje mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ bco brgyad pa mkhas grub mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa grub chen so so'i sh+lau ka re yod pa rnams kyi lung yang thos so// smras pa/ gong 'og rgyud sde kun las btus pa'i lha// dngos grub 'byung gnas sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang*// ba ri brgya rtsa snar thang brgya rtsar bcas// rdor phreng kri yā sa muts+tsha sogs so// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ rgyud sde gong 'og sna tshogs 'dres pa'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyis sarga ste bcu gsum pa'o// //rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos gsang chen rnying ma'i ring lugs las byung ba bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje phur ba ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por/ chos rje bla ma'i mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang dkyil chog gi dgongs don bzhin sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i bdag 'jug sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i slob ma dbang bskur gyi cho ga'i steng nas dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrungs pa/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen/ 'khon shes rab yon tan/ 'khon tshul khrims rgyal po/ 'khon rdo rje gtsug tor/ 'khon dge skyabs/ 'khon dge mthong*/ 'khon ston bal po/ 'khon shākya blo gros/

'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ kun dga' rin chen/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po badz+ra kī la ya chos kyi rje 'jam dbyangs chos dar/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i rjes su/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan nas/ sa lo tsā ba man 'dra'o// yang na rje btsun pa/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa dbang rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man 'dra'o// yang na rje sa paṇa/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ 'phags pa rin po che/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal man 'dra'o// ༈ //bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i phrin las kyi gzhung dregs pa zil gnon dang*/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog mthong ba rang grol gyi steng nas/

rtsa ba thugs gter lho brag srin mo sbar rjes can gyi brag nas mnga' bdag nyang ral chen po nyi ma 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i gter kha gu ru drag po thod phreng rtsal drag po dmar chen gyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag nyang ral chen po/ mnga' bdag sras chung pa/ gu ru dharma rat+na/ rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol/ drin chen sangs rgyas lhun dbang*/ sprul sku kun dga' bkra shis/ gnubs/ mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje/ thugs mchog rtsal gcung*/ sngags 'chang legs pa dpal bzang*/ 'khon rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs khri chen bsod nams dbang po/ brang ti nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin stsal to// yang na brang ti nam mkha' sangs rgyas nas/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ de nas 'jam dbyangs kun dga' sangs rgyas kyis gsan pa yin nam brtag de dbon 'jam dbyangs bkra shis phun tshogs/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //gu ru drag dmar mnga' bdag nyang lugs kyi rjes gnang mkhan ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha go bde gsal ba'i sgron me'i steng nas legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje yan gong dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas sngags 'chang legs pa dpal bzang*/

gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug grub mchog sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ mkhas btsun kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ drin chen pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster ma'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ khro bo rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ grub chen brtson 'grus bzang po/ rdo ring kun spangs chen po/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ rje dbang phyug dpal bzang*/ mkhan yangs can chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ brang ti nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ 'dren mchog nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'chi med dpal ster bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag la lan mang du stsal to// yang na mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ tshe dpag med dngos dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub dang*/ kun dga' chos 'phel gnyi gas gsan/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang phyi ma gnyis te de gsum ga las bla ma bkra shis bzang po dang*/ nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis thob bo// yang na mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags nas/

rgyal sras ngag dbang spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen/ de las khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las bdag gis lan mang du legs par thob bo// de dag gi yig cha phal che ba ni bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya mdud kyi steng nas mdzad cing mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub pas skabs 'gar spyan snga ba'i yi ge ltar yang mdzad do// yang na grub dbang shug ra kun dga' dpal 'byor pa las spyan snga kun dga' don grub kyi yi ge'i steng nas lan du ma'i bar du bdag gis thob kyang*/ grub chen de nyid kyi gsan yul bla ma shug ra gong ma yin nam/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs la sogs pa gang yin ma nges/ yang na rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog sdom brtson ngag dbang nyi ma/ lcags zam pa kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug bco brgyad byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs man sngar dang 'dra'o// ༈ //mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge dang*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i lhan thabs dang bcas pa'i steng nas tshe dbang lcags sdong ma rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru can gyi gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal/ byams pa bshes gnyen/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ sngags 'chang chos skyong bsod nams/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal mkhar rtse pa ngag dbang bsod rje 'dis shes rab 'byung gnas la'ang gsan no//

nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bud+dha ba/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ de nas bstan 'dzin lhun grub kyis gsan pa yin nam brtag de nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa dang*/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong pa gnyis kyis gsan nam/ bka' drin can gnyis ka las bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par thob bo// 'di la brgyud pa'i tshul rgyas pa chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sprul sku phyag na rdo rje/ smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po gdong gsum pa/ rig 'dzin lha dbang brgya byin/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ skal ldan rgyal po dza/ mkhas pa shākya pra bha/ pad+ma bi ma la/ bal po shī la mañju/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem sogs/ 'di la rje dbang phyug rab brtan gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi gsol 'debs kyi gsung gdangs mdzad cing*/ tshe mda' la dar dmar po btags pas g.yob par mdzad kyin 'dug zhabs drung a mi lags kyi gsan yig na snang*/ gsung ngo*// ༈ //gsol 'debs las/ grags pa gsum pa dbang phyug mtshan mtha' can// 'bre ban tshul bzang rnam gsum tshogs pa'i gter// bla ma grum dang yon bdag nag po mkhar// gnyis tshogs gter sgo 'byed rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i gter ston gsum tshogs ni rkyang po grags pa dbang phyug sum pa byang chub tshul khrims/ 'bre shes rab bla ma gsum gyis yer pa se ba lung nas rta mgrin pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag rnams spyan drangs nas 'bru tshang gi gnyags ston la shog ser steng nas chos rgyun lan gcig tsam las spel rgyu ma byung bar gter rdur gyis rkyang po la mdze byung*/ sum pa 'das/ 'bre smyo bas shog ser rnams rta mgrin gyi grub thob zhu ston bya ba'i lag tu byung yang des zhu sa rtsad ma chod pas las 'phro gter brgyud kyi byin rlabs bka' ma nyams pa yongs grags la med par yun ring 'byams/

ring zhig na grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'dar phya ru ba gtsang jo mo nags rgyal na bzhugs pa'i dus slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhang tshe zla grags bya ba'i sngags pa zhig tu sprul nas dbang lung rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ sngags kyi oṃ de hrīḥru bsgyur la sgrubs shig gsungs/ 'dar phyar gyis bla ma rgya la gter brgyud kyang rtsad chod nas gsan pa'i bka' gter zung 'jug gi chos skor la/ thog mar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba rgyal ba'i dbang po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gyer sgom 'jigs med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs dang kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa'i dbang chog bde chen myu gu la lha dbang gi lhan thabs sbyar zhing*/ bla chen chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dbang chu ma dag pa'i dri ma 'khrud byed kyi steng nas zhib cha'i phyag len dang bcas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du btang ste bum pa la brten nas khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i rig pa'i dbang*/ lha dbang*/ dur khrod chas dbang*/ gtor dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ bzhi pa'i dbang dang bcas pa rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' srol ma nyams pa yid ches khungs btsun du mnos/ dbus ston pa sogs sa dge'i mkhas rlom gzhan dag gis rig pa'i dbang lnga so sor phral nas bskur bas mtshon te gsang 'dus dgyes rdor sogs rgyud sde gzhan gyi rgyas bkab rang bzo'i dri ma tsam yang ma 'dres pa yin no// 'chi med tshe'i rdzong chung gi dbang kun mkhyen chen po'i yig cha dang de'i gsal byed tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i nag po 'gro shes kyi steng nas tshe 'gugs 'ching*/ bsdu ba/ dbang dngos/ sba ba/ sbel ba/ tshe rdzas myang ba/ bsrung ba rnams smin rgyas/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i byin rlabs dbang gi cho ga'i steng nas bum pa/ rta mgo dur khrod chas/ bzlas lung*/

gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang*/ bka' srung gying lnga gza' gdong gi srog gtad kyi rjes gnang zab mo rnams kyang yid brtan du rung ba thob nas/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ spyir rtsa brgyud kyi steng du dril ba/ sgrub thabs byang bu'i steng du dril ba/ man ngag las tshogs kyi steng du dril ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyud kyi le'u drug pa yan gyis stod las byang chub sgrub pa rnams ston pas/ smin byed dbang gi skor/ sgrub thabs las byang*/ bstod bskul/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg zor sogs sgrub pa chen po'i cha lag tu nges par dgos pas smad las kyi char gtogs pa 'ga' zhig kyang der tshang dgos la/ rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar gyi smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba mngon spyod drag po'i skor ni sgrub chen gyi le lag tu byung ba'i dmod pa kha sbyor dbye ba sogs ma yin pa min na'ang*/ gtso bor sbas pa mig 'byed kyi le'u gsum pa man chad kyi skor dang*/ gtor ma'i las tshogs bcu bdun gyi nang gi mngon spyod kyi skor sogs 'phrul shes par byas nas skabs gang dang gang du dgos pa de dang der len pa yin/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub phrin sbyor dngos rjes tshang la brten nas rgyud dang man ngag shog dril sogs skabs thob gang du dgos pa de bsnan nas nyams su len/ gsum pa ni/ sbas pa mig 'byed kyi skor te/ de yang rgyud ltar byed na le'u dang po dang gnyis pas stod las rgyud le'u drug pa yan dang sbyar/ lhag mas smad las rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa man dang sbyor/ man ngag ltar byed na zhal gdams shog dril byang bu sogs stod las dang thun mong gi las sgrub rnams smad las su sbyor/ man ngag rang rkyang du byed na sman sgrub dang lha sngags dmigs pa'i nges pa bstan pas stod las/ le'u gsum pa man chad kyi smad las su sbyor dgos pas sdom 'di lta bu shes na chos lugs 'di la nang byan tshud par mngon no// de yang rtsa ba rgyud kyi skor/

sdong bu byang bu'i skor/ smin byed dbang gi skor/ sgrub pa phrin las kyi skor/ sbas pa mig 'byed skor/ bde gshegs spyi dril gyi skor/ thun mong las phran shog dril gyi skor/ thun mong ma yin pa mchog lam gyi skor dang brgyad/ dang po la/ pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i rgyud le'u (pha)bcu gsum pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can slob dpon chen pos mnga' bdag rje la gtad pa lo chen bai ros bsgyur ba/ dpal au ḍ+yān chen pos mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi skabs spyod (pha)don 'grel bai ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ rgyud kyi sa bcad dbang chen zhal gzigs kun mkhyen mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa piṇa ta tha rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams so// gnyis pa sdong bu lta bu byang bu'i skor la/ au ḍ+yān chen pos mdzad pa'i dbang gi byang bu/

'di rgyud kyi le'u gsum pa'i dbang bgrod dam ldan slob dpon khur zhes pa'i skabs dang sbyor/ sgrub pa'i byang bu/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ tshe'i byang bu/ sbyin sreg gi byang bu/ le'u bcu pa dang sbyor/ rab gnas kyi byang bu/ gsum pa dang 'brel/ gnas lung gi byang bu rnams so// gsum pa smin byed dbang gi skor la/ rtsa ba'i dbang byang mdzad pa po slob dpon chen po pad+ma bzang po yin pas slob dpon pad+ma bzang po'i rnam thar lo rgyus zhes pa mdzad pa po/ rgyud/ phyogs/ dgos pa bsdus don te lnga'i sgo nas gtan la phab pa gsal ba'i mtha' can/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ chos khungs btsun pa brgyud pa'i rnam thar la grub thob 'dar bya ru ba rin chen bzang po'i rnam thar zur tsam bris pa bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje'i rnam thar tshig nyung don rgyas/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ chos rje nyan chen pa'i rnam thar 'gor 'khrungs yul dang mjug na gshegs tshul bstan pa legs par gda' 'o'i mtha' can/ sgrub chen gyi phyi'i sngon 'gro rgyan mchod pa rgyal mtho/ dam sri/ sgo byang dang bcas pa sgo gong du gzhag go'i mtha' can/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ rgyan dgod pa'i las byang mnga' brgyad ma dang bde stong dbyer med pa/ chag chag gdab pa drin chen dri chu ma/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ thig 'debs stong gsum 'jig rten ma/ dbang chen sgrub pa'i tho yig bla ma'i phyag len bzhin rdo rje 'dzin pa seng ge'i mtshan can gyis bkod pa/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ dam rdzas rnam pa lnga'i rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi ngos 'dzin/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa'i dbang chog bde chen myu gu le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ dbang chog gi lhan thabs lha dbang dang rdzas dbang gi yi ge

le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ rwa ban chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dbang chu (cha)ma dag pa'i dri ma 'khrud byed/ rdzong chung tshe dbang gi yi ge rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan seng ges bkod pa/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ tshe'i 'brang rgyas kyi bzang ngan brtag pa/ tshe chang gi kha la bzang ngan brtag pa/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ yang gsang khros pa'i sgo nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs nag po 'gro shes tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i tshe spel ba 'dir tshogs skal ldan ma rnams so/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa phrin las skor la/ dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub kyi gter mdzod/ le'u gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa gang dgos la sbyor/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa/ rta mgrin dpa' gcig phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs bla ma'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin bris pa/ le'u gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa gang dgos la sbyor/ yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs bsnyen pa dang mjug tu gdon bgegs skrod pa'i sngags dmigs dang bcas pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i yab yum rkyang sgrub (dhī)kyi sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer dngos grub myur stsol/ le'u gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa gang dgos la sbyor/ yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa/ pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i phrin las slob dpon chen po pad+mas mdzad pa/ le'u gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar dang bcu gnyis pa rnams gang dgos la sbyor/ phrin las kyi bsdus don spyi don gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po pad+ma dbang chen gyi phrin las ngag 'don mchan bur btab pa gnyags kyi ban+de rnam rgyal dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ le'u gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar dang bcu gnyis pa rnams gang dgos la sbyor/

dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa rgyal ba kun bdag ma/ le'u gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar gang dgos la sbyor/ rtag bstod slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa/ khyung bstod dbang chen ma/ le'u gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar gang dgos la sbyor/ bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa/ bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs kyi shog dril 'bru lngas byin gyis brlabs/ le'u gsum pa dang bzhi pa la sbyor/ gtor ma byin rlabs kyi shog dril 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ le'u gsum pa dang bzhi pa la sbyor/ rak+ta byin rlabs kyi shog dril 'bru gcig gis byin gyis brlabs pa/ byin 'bebs kyi dmigs pa/ le'u gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar la sbyor/ tshogs tha ma'i lag len kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa/ le'u drug pa dang bcu gnyis par sbyor/ des mdzad pa'i rig 'dzin (pha)spyi bskul/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ des mdzad pa'i (pha)dkon mchog spyi bskul/ des mdzad pa'i chos skyong (pha)spyi bskul/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ des mdzad pa'i gser skyems mdor bsdus tshigs bcad ma/ des mdzad pa'i gser skyems rgyas pa tshig lhug le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ gnyen po'i pho nya dam (pha)tshig chen po ma/ yungs kar gyi pho nya yungs (pha)kar rgyal po ma/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ sgrol gying (pha)sogs khro bo'i pho nya/ yungs thun dbab pa gser sgong (pha)bsgril 'dra ma/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ lha dang (pha)dbral ba/ khrag zor dgra (pha)la 'phen pa/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ gtor (pha)sgo dbye ba/ gtor zor (pha)bya ba/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ dbang po rab kyi bro dmar (pha)nag gru gsum ma/

'bring gi bro nub (pha)phyogs pad+ma ma/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ mtha' ma'i (pha)bro yungs kar ma/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ rta'i brtul zhugs (pha)kyi bro/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ bzlog pa rnam par rgyal ba'i lag len mus srad pa byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ bzlog pa rnam rgyal ('dar)stobs kyi mtshon cha sangs rgyas bstan pa ma/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ rta mgrin gyi yang ('dar)mdos nag po bsngo ba/ dgra bgegs la dmod pa gdab pa dug mtsho khol ma/ le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi drag po'i sbyin sreg don bcu gcig ma/ le'u bcu pa la sbyor/ gnas byang gi ṭī ka nyi ma'i 'od zer kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa/ le'u gsum pa dang bzhi par sbyor/ des mdzad pa'i phrin las kyi gsal byed rin po che'i phreng ba/ le'u gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar sbyor/ sgrub thabs kyi sgom khog chen po (rwa)rwa ban chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa rnams so// lnga pa sbas pa mig 'byed (pha)skor la/ sgrub thabs sbas pa mig 'byed dang las tshogs sbas pa mig 'byed gnyis dpe tshan so sor 'dug kyang phyag len ltar go rim du bkod pa la/ phrin las kyi zhal khrigs/ le'u bzhi par sbyor/ tshogs tha ma'i zhal khrigs/ drug par sbyor/ pho nya btang ba'i zhal khrigs/ bdun par sbyor/ bkra shis kyi zhal khrigs/ drug par sbyor/ dbang po rab kyi rta bro'i zhal khrigs/ rta bro'i dmigs rim gyi zhal khrigs/ drug par sbyor/ dbang gi zhal khrigs/ gsum par sbyor/ mngon rtogs kyi zhal khrigs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun/ gsum pa dang bzhi par sbyor/ sgrub pa'i zhal khrigs rta bdun tsha zer/

gsum pa dang bzhi pa lnga pa la sbyor/ bsnyen sgrub kyi zhal khrigs/ gnas btsal ba'i zhal khrigs/ gsum par sbyor/ lcags mkhar 'brub khung gi zhal khrigs/ bdun par sbyor/ rten bca' ba liṅga'i zhal khrigs/ 'gugs pa'i zhal khrigs nyi zer lcags kyu/ bdun pa dang bcu gnyis par sbyor/ mnan pa'i zhal khrigs chu srin lto ba/ brgyad par sbyor/ drag sngags bdun pa'i zhal khrigs spu gri me 'bar/ le'u brgyad par sbyor/ bzlog pa'i zhal khrigs gnam lcags 'bar ba/ skyin thang chu 'khyags kyi zhal khrigs/ dgu par sbyor/ gnam thog gi zhal khrigs/ gdon chen gzir ba'i zhal khrigs/ bcu par sbyor/ me dpung 'bar ba mdze nad 'joms pa'i zhal khrigs/ ral gri 'bar ba chung sri gsad pa'i zhal khrigs/ bcu par sbyor/ phyugs nad gcod pa'i zhal khrigs/ sbyin sreg gi zhal khrigs 'khor ba'i rtsa tshig bcu par sbyor/ dngos grub bsdu ba'i zhal khrigs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ drug par sbyor/ sbyin sreg gi zhal khrigs me'i sbyor ba/ bcu par sbyor/ gying lnga dril ba'i drag sngags zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ shel gying dkar po'i drag sngags zhal khrigs/ de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyi drag sngags zhal khrigs/ de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ rdo rje legs pa'i drag sngags zhal khrigs/ de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ ri nag spungs pa'i drag sngags zhal khrigs/ de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ yab shud dmar po'i drag sngags zhal khrigs/ de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/ gying lnga mchod pa'i zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ gza' rgod kyi drag sngags zhal khrigs/

bcu gcig par sbyor/ de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ de'i mchod pa'i zhal khrigs/ dbang sdud 'brub khung gi zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ 'gugs pa ting 'dzin gyi zhal khrigs/ gnod byed bgegs dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ gnod byed mi dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal khrigs/ yul khams dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ zas nor dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal khrigs/ las mtha' sbyin sreg gi zhal khrigs/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ dgra lkugs par byed pa'i zhal khrigs/ brgyad par sbyor/ gter bdag bdud kyi zhal khrigs/ gter bdag drag btsan gyi zhal khrigs/ gter bdag klu lcam gyi zhal khrigs/ mi 'phyugs thems kyi zhal khrigs te lnga bcu rtsa gsum rnams so// drug pa bde gshegs spyi dril gyi skor la/ rta mchog bde gshegs 'dus pa'i phrin las kyi sgom rim (pha)rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi cho ga rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ brag dmar 'om bu'i tshal du gu ru la rjes zhus pa'i lo rgyus las 'phros te bsrung ba bde gshegs thams cad kyi nus pa (pha)(gnas)gcig dril sde brgyad bcud bor dregs pa kun sgrol shin tu gsang ba'i mtha' can/ rlung me'i sa bon la brten pa'i dmigs rim dang seng ldeng (pha)(gnas)gi phur bas chu dang yungs dkar nag thal chen gyis ser ba bsrung ba/ gtor (pha)(gnas)ma'i las/ gnyen po'i rdzas lus la (gnas)bcangs pas klu 'bros shing sngangs bred brgyal bar 'gyur ba/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rdzas bstan pa/ phur pa sbyin sreg mnan pa gsum gyi sgo nas las kyi mjug bsdu ba/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lha sras la gtad nas gter du sba zhing las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bsrung bzlog gso ba'i las sbyor slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis khri srong lde btsan gyi phyag tu gtad pa'i mtha' can/

bde gshegs 'dus pa'i drag sngags man ngag bcud kyi nying khu rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las rim rnam brgyad la bsnyen pa/ sgrib pa bsreg pa/ chos skyong bskul ba/ sde brgyad bkol ba/ klu gnyan gdul ba/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba/ bgegs dpung gzhom pa/ gtor ma dbul ba rnams/ yang drag sngags la bsnyen pa skyel ba'i don sgrub rtags dngos grub 'grub tshul las can la phrad shog rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dam can srog 'khor la brten nas chos skyong bskul te dgra bo sgrol ba/ gnad 'bebs kyi 'khor lo la brten nas sde brgyad bran du bskul ba/ 'khor lo la brten nas rigs bzhi'i klu gdon gdul ba/ 'khor lo la brten nas dgra bgegs dam sri gdul ba/ 'khor lo la brten nas rbod gtong bzlog pa/ rang srung 'khor lo/ lcags sam seng ldeng gi phur pa la brten nas sri'u gso ba/ 'khor lo la brten nas smyo 'bog gdul ba/ gu gul dang srin lag bsdams pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis 'dre ngan gdul ba/ 'khor lo dang la cha'i sbal pas zho chang bsrung ba/ mu zi bcu pa dang gi waṃ dgu sbyor gyis mdze lhog sogs gdon rims srung ba rnams so// bdun pa thun mong las phran shog dril gyi skor la/ chu'i bcud len/ 'di gtso bor bsnyen sgrub dang mchog sgrub la sbyor/ nas phye'i dka' thub/ gtor ma'i las tshogs la (pha)dngos grub sgrub pa/ dgra bgegs sgrub pa/ bzlog pa/ mnan pa/ zor du bya ba/ 'di yan sgrub thabs la sbyor/ sbyin sreg tu bya ba/ byab par byed pa/ dbang bskur du byed pa/ dngos grub tu sgrub pa/ tshe sgrub pa/ 'di yan sgrub chen dang tshe sgrub la sbyor/ rigs brgyud sgrub pa/ sri'u gso ba/ nor du sgrub pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bya ba/ 'byung po sdud pa/ ser ba bzlog pa/ chu me rims sogs gang gnod par brdeg pa ste bcu bdun/

'di yan gong dgos su len na'ang gtso bor sgrub thabs la sbyor/ las thor bu'i skor (pha)la 'khor lo bsrung ba/ le'u bcu par sbyor/ bsnyen tshad/ lnga par sbyor/ gdon brtag pa/ bcu par sbyor/ sngags chu/ srung skud/ bcu par sbyor/ chu dang bye mas bsrung ba/ nad gdon/ bcu par sbyor/ mi ma yin mnan pa/ brgyad par sbyor/ mig mthong*/ drug par sbyor/ 'khor lo kha sbyor gyis bgegs gdul ba/ bcu par sbyor/ rgyal 'gong gdul ba/ bdud bzhi gdul ba/ bcu par sbyor/ zhi bas mi thul na gzir ba/ bcu par sbyor/ mnan pa/ bcu par sbyor/ byug pa/ mdze brtag pa/ bcu par sbyor/ chung sri gsad pa/ chung sri la khad bu gzhug pa/ bcu par sbyor/ sri'u gso ba/ bcu par sbyor/ gshin po 'dre ru mi 'ong*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i byas pa bshig pa'i phra men 'dzul chog bcu par sbyor/ lam srung lcags khang ma rnams so// zhar byung ser srung bka' rgya ma/ dgu par sbyor/ mtho phur gyi zhal gdams bka' rgya ma/ ser ba 'ong mi 'ong*/

dgu par sbyor/ ser lam gcod pa/ thun zor gta' ma'i las kyis ser (pha)ba dbab pa la/ klu gnad la bor bas dbab pa/ sbyin sreg thab gzhob/ ser gta'/ dbyug pa/ gtor ma/ glo bur drag shul/ rdzas rgod/ thod skam/ thod gsher/ gcer bu g.yang gzhi/ grod pas dbab pa dang bcu gnyis bai ro'i zhal khrigs/ dgu par sbyor/ rgyud du gab pa'i sngags kyi sham bu sbyor tshul mdze dang sri'u bsrung ba sogs zhar la bstan pa rgyud lha sar bsgyur nas/ lnga par sbyor/ rje la gtad pa bai ro'i zhal khrigs zab pa'i gnad/ khyad par gsad thabs gying lnga srog gcod kyi man ngag bcu gcig par sbyor/ man ngag 'di gnyis la rgya gsum btab pa'i man ngag mnga' bdag gis bai ro la dung g.yas 'khyil sogs phul skad do// gying lnga gza' gdong gi mngon (pha)('dar)rtogs yig rnying*/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ de'i mdos (pha)('dar)chog gying lnga gza' gdong gi gtor 'bul/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ phrin las myur 'grub tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ des mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i bca' thabs dang phan yon/ gying lnga gza' gdong gi rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams so/ bcu gcig par sbyor/ /brgyad pa mchog lam skor la/ bum dbang gi lam lha (pha)khrid sems bzung gi shog dril/ 'di man le'u gsum pa'i/ dbang bgrod dam ldan slob dpon bkuraḥ brtson 'grus ldan pas rtse gcig sgrubaḥ ces pa'i shugs bstan gyis dgongs par sbyor ro/ /lha 'grub mi 'grub brtag (pha)pa'i shog dril/ gsang dbang dang 'brel ba drod kyi gdams pa gtum mo'i dmigs skor bco brgyad/ sher dbang zhal las shes par bya/ bzhi pa 'brel pa rta skad thengs cig (pha)ma'i dgongs pa dbu gtsug sprul pa ma/ dbang bzhi thun mong gi lam dang 'brel ba bskyed (pha)rdzogs zung 'jug gi shog dril/ dngos grub (pha)spyod pa/

dug gsum (pha)lam slong*/ sdom pa (pha)dam tshig dngos (pha)grub/ yang dag lta ba rnams (pha)kyi shog dril/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi rdzogs rim ye shes gsang lam zab mo/ rdzogs rim pad+ma gsang lam gyi nyams len gu rus chos rgyal la gsungs pa/ dpal rta mgrin gyi dbang bzhi'i khrid/ 'gor blo gros mnyam med dang zhes yod pa/ bla ma mkhas la bzod par mdzod ces pa'i mtha' can rwa ban chos dpal bzang po'i zin bris/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gyer sgom 'jigs med sgra dbyangs rnams legs par thob pa'i gying lnga gza' gdong gi dbang lung la/ bde gshegs spyi dril gyi gnas kyi rtags med pa rnams dang sa bcad lnga pa yongs rdzogs rwa dhī 'dar gyi rtags yod rnams ma gtogs pa'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku pad+ma dbang chen/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ lo chen bai ro tsa na/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston rkyang po grags pa dbang phyug sum pa dbang phyug tshul khrims/ 'bre shes rab bla ma/ 'brug tshar gyi zhang ston gzi brjid 'bar/ gsang mtshan dri med zla shar/ rta nag gi bla ma rgya/ dpal ldan grub thob 'dar phya ru ba/ chos rgyal bo dong rin chen/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ brag rams pa chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge rnam grol ba rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ 'khrul zhig dkon mchog bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/

mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che pad+ma phrin las/ rnam mang rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pa la stsal to// yang na rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub nas/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhas btsun grub pa rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pa la'o// sa bcad lnga pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'di skor mnga' bdag gtso che ba tsam ma gtogs gter ston gsum tshogs la'ang byung ba sbas pa mig 'byed gter du sbas tshul gyi lo rgyus kyis shes/ mnga' bdag yan gong ltar la gter ston nyang ral/ she ma 'od 'byung*/ grub thob 'dar phyar/ brtson 'grus rdo rje/ nyan chen pa/ chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ nye gnas chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma blo gros seng ge bla ma sid+dhi singha*/ bla chen chos dpal ba man gong ltar ro// rwa'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ bla chen nas/ chos rje nor bu phun tshogs/ sngags 'chang sangs rgyas grags pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po man gong ltar ro// dhī'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse nas/ 'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang*/ rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang nye brgyud du byed na/ slob dpon pad+ma las grub thob 'dar phyar gyis dngos su gsan pas/ slob dpon chen po nas grub thob 'dar phyar gyis kyang thus/ yang dbang dang lung pha'i rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge yan gong ltar la/ chos rje bsod nams bzang po/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ rje nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mus srad pa blo gros rin chen seng ge gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bde legs nyi ma/ shar pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/

chos rje rin chen bshes gnyen/ bla ma phrin las lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ sprul sku rin po che pad+ma phrin las/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ bstan pa'i snang byed ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na rje btsun chos rgyan nas/ yang dgon spyan snga ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ bla ma phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ brgyud lugs 'di'i sbas pa mig 'byed kyang chos rgyal dpal bzang nas dpal ldan seng ge la brgyud pas chog go /rta mgrin bde gshegs gcig dril gyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs dang 'dar gyi rtags can gying lnga gza' gdong gi srog gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar la/ de nas mnyam med dkon mchog dpal bzang*/ nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras byams pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/ nub dgon sprul sku shākya rgyal mtshan/ 'dar nag rgyal sras bde ba bzang po/ des bdag la'o// gying lnga gza' gdong gi srog gtad brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'khrul zhig dkon mchog bzang po yan gong ltar la/ de nas nub dgon pa nyi zla bzang po/ sngags 'chang kun bzang nyi ma/ zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mchog gi sprul sku pad+ma phrin las/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhas btsun rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o// ༈ //dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul gyi yi ge'i steng nas grwa pa mngon shes nas brgyud pa'i dzam+bha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob nas/

rgyab brten lung la bshes gnyen grwa pas bsam yas nas spyan drangs pa'i 'phags pa dzam+bha la dmar po gsung gi sgrub skor la/ thod pa la brten nas khams gsum snying khrag sdud pa'i dbang*/ gtor ma rin chen 'bar bas 'dod dgu char 'bebs kyi dbang*/ chu sbyin dang lha sgom sngags bzlas kyi dbang mnos nas/ lung la/ 'phags pa dzam+bha la dmar po gsung gi sgrub thabs/ chu sbyin gtor ma la brten nas bsgrub pa/ ga'u la brten nas bsgrub pa/ thod pa la brten nas bsgrub pa/ dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa dbang du bya ba'i phrin las/ sbyin sreg la brten nas bsgrub pa/ tshogs mchod/ bstod pa bde gshegs ma/ sgab 'dre mnan pa/ 'khor lo'i bri yig dzam dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub pa/ dzam+bha la dmar po'i dbang bskur gyi yi ge rnams kyi lung dang rjes su gnang ba bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma ka raḥ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ grwa pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar/ gsan yig 'ga' zhig tu shes rab rgyal ba zer ba'ang byung*/ grwa pa thugs rje 'bum/ slob dpon shu la tsan+d+ra/ slob dpon tshul rgyal ba/ mkhan po nyi ma/ slob dpon don bzang ba/ dbu ma la lar dbu gru btsun zer ba yod kyang rdo ring ba'i gsan yig na dkyus ltar snang gsung*/ pa grub pa brtson 'grus/ bka' bcu pa bkra shis bzang po/ bla ma blo gros bzang po/ rje btsun seng ge snyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'di nas bla ma 'ga' zhig btsal dgos/ de nas mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris pa chos rje ye shes phrin las/ bla ma yon tan phun tshogs kyis de nas gsan nam brtag de nas rdo rje 'chang bkra shis bzang po/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na dbu ma pa grub pa brtson 'grus nas/ bka' bcu gzhon nu seng ge

bla ma shākya grub pa/ rdo ston bsod nams bzang po/ rje rgyal ba dpal/ ya ma lag pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ gur rdzong pa chos 'byor dpal bzang*/ rigs 'dzin gzhon nu don grub/ 'di nas bla ma gnyis tsam gyi mtshan btsal te bri dgos/ de nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la sgrub skor gyi lung dang rjes su gnang ba chu sbyin bcas legs par stsal to// yang na gter ston nas/ lce ston gsal ba'i shes rab/ tshe don gsal/ 'u yug dam pa shag po/ dam pa sher rdor/ bla ma bsod nams rin chen/ gzhon nu seng ge man gong ltar ro// yang na gter ston nas/ gzhung pa rgyan legs/ rong pa chos mgon/ bla ma dbang phyug grags/ grwa dur pa/ mkhan po kun dga' rin chen/ rje rin chen mchog dbu ma pa grub brtson man gong bzhin no// lung gi brgyud pa dang rjes gnang gi brgyud pa'i smad gcig gam ma yin cung zad blta'o// ༈ //slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs yig rnying dang*/ rjes gnang gi tho chung ngag dbang brtan pas mdzad pa'i steng nas/ slob dpon pad+ma nas brgyud pa'i khyung dmar gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas nas rim par/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ byams pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje sogs nas rim bzhin mkhan chen bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang rdo rje 'chang shug ra kun dga' dpal 'byor gyi drung nas kyang thob ste gsan yul gyi bla ma gang yin ma 'tshal to// yang na 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ chos rje bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/

sogs nas brgyud pa'ang yod pa'i sbrel mtshams btsal bar bya'o// ༈ //dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyang ston sgrub pos lho brag mkhar chu'i gter nas spyan drangs pa'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas mig gsal byed kyi gdams pa'i lung thob pa la/ lo rgyus dang gdams pa nyang ston rang gis yi ger bkod pa/ sngags 'chang bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa'i de'i gsal byed kyi yi ge 'gor thugs rje chen pos rtag par 'gro kun la/ zhes yod pa'i dang por lo rgyus/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi nyams len/ gsum pa phan yon te skabs gsum gsal bar byed pa tshigs bcad ma/ des mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ yang de'i lo rgyus dang nyams len tshig lhug pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ nyang ston sgrub pa po/ 'gro mgon shākya bzang po/ rig 'dzin chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ rje bkra shis rnam rgyal/ gling stod zhabs drung dkon mchog dpal 'byor/ sprul sku rin po che pad+ma phrin las/ rje blo bzang don grub/ gnas gsar pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung nas/ mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ chos kyi rje dam pa ting 'dzin rdo rje/ des bdag la'o// smras pa/ 'khon ston las brgyud rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang*// bla ma drag sgrub 'chi med sgrub skor gnyis// yang gsang dbang dang chos skor rmugs 'dzin sogs// snga 'gyur gsang sngags thor bu'i thos tshul yin// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyis sarga ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //mkhas shing grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid chen po mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zlos gar/

rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa 'gyur med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis/ bka' dang zab gter gyi bstan pa'i chu gter chen po las/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thogs pa med par sgrub pa'i/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lhag pa'i lha'i 'khor lo'i rnam pa mtha' yas par 'byung ba rnams kyi sgrub pa'i thabs yongs su grags pa rnams don du gnyer ba dang po'i las can rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i phyir dang*/ shin tu dkon pa 'ga' zhig ni rgyun mi chad par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ phyi 'gyur gyi sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig kyang nyer mkho'i dbang du byas nas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang zhes bya ba nas 'byung ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dbang bskur byin rlabs rjes gnang rig gtad/ bzlas lung la sogs pa'i bka' srol ma nyams par bzhugs pa'i cho ga'i rnam grangs tha dad pa'i tshul can ji snyed cig bzhugs pa rnams legs par thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ ༈ thog mar bla ma zhi ba'i skor la/ bla ma gsang 'dus las thod phreng rtsal sgos sgrub kyi zlum po bzhi dbang*/ gsang 'dus gtor dbang gnad kyi shog gcig mar grags pa/ nyang gter bla ma yongs rdzogs kyi gtor dbang rnams so// bla ma drag po'i skor la/ nyang gter drag dmar bde 'dus kyi dbang bka' rdo rje spyi blugs/ 'bring po me'i spu gri'i dbang chog che 'bring gnyis ka dang 'brel pa'i byin rlabs lu gu brgyud/ brag dmar bka' ma 'o bran lugs/ byang gter drag po rtsal gyi byin rlabs thugs rje'i dbang bskur rnams so// ༈ //tshe dpag med kyi skor la/ tshe dpag med lung lugs sangs rgyas gsang ba'i man ngag chos dbang gi gter ma bla ma longs sku'i rdzong chen tshe dbang*/ byang gter tshe sgrub lcags sdong ma/ pad gling tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng ba'i tshe dbang sgrub khog las gsung rgyun bzhin phyungs pa/ grub thob thang stong pa'i gdams pa 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe sgrub rnams so//

༈ /spyan ras gzigs kyi skor la/ thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs phyag bzhi pa/ rgyal po lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho bde gshegs bzhi sgril gyi sgrub thabs rnams so// ༈ /'jam dpal tshe bdag yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i rnon po nad gcod kyi dbang bka'o// ༈ /rta mgrin gyi skor la/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub shangs lugs/ nyang gter rta nag lcags ral can/ chos dbang lugs rta nag gi sgrub thabs rnams so// ༈ /phyag rdor gyi skor la/ las 'brel rtsal gyi phyag rdor dregs 'dul bum pa dang gtor ma'i las tshogs la brten pa/ byang chub gling pa'i phyag rdor gtum po drag po/ grwa pa'i gter ma phyag rdor khang brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs rnams so// ༈ /phag mo'i skor la/ nyang gter mkha' 'gro chen mor grags pa phag mo zhal gnyis ma/ rdo rje phag mo don grub ma/ phag mo dbu bcad ma/ khros nag gi sgrub thabs rnams so// shes rab kyi lha'i skor la/ ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dpal dkar po/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyi lugs 'jam dpal smra seng*/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs rnams so// ༈ /phrin las kyi lha'i skor la/ rnam 'joms sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs/ chos dbang lugs kyi drang srong lok+t+ri pā la/ rin chen gling pa'i nā ga rak+sha'i sgrub thabs rnams so// ༈ /bstan srung mgon po'i skor la/ dpal mgon legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po/ nyang gter dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa/ mgon po dkar po'i tshe dbang*/ chos dbang lugs kyi ma ning*/ gnubs lugs kyi dpal mgon stag zhon/ gnubs lugs kyi mgon po beng gi sgrub thabs rnams so// ༈ /bstan srung sna tshogs pa'i skor la/ ye shes ma mo e ka dza ṭī sde bdun gyi sbags sgrub/ snying thig ma mo e ka dza ṭī gtso rkyang*/ re ti rang byung ma bka' gter gnyis ldan/ nyang gter gshog rgod ma/ las 'brel lugs lha mo srog sgrub ma/

las 'brel lugs gza' rgod dug gi spu gri/ las 'brel lugs gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar nag rdor legs kyi sgrub thabs gter brgyud gnyis ldan/ rgyal sras legs ldan pa'i gter byon zhing skyong seng gdong can/ nyang gter dur khrod ma mo/ chos dbang gi brtan ma bcu gnyis/ nyang gter dkor bdag pe ha ra'i sgrub thabs rnams so// nor lha'i skor la/ rnam sras phyi sgrub ser chen sprin gseb ma/ nang sgrub mdung dmar can rta sngon ma/ gsang sgrub drag po rta sngon ma/ yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa/ gnod sbyin zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul/ dzaṃ dmar chags pa rdo rje/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po'i sgrub thabs rnams te/ de rnams las 'jam dkar dang*/ 'jam dpal smra seng*/ dbyangs can ma/ rnam 'joms rigs gnyis rnams ni gsar ma las brgyud pa yin cing*/ drag po 'o bran lugs/ tshe dpag med lung lugs/ dpal mgon legs ldan/ rnam sras gsang sgrub drag po rta sngon ma rnams ni snga 'gyur bka' ma dang*/ stag zhon dang beng rang byung ma rnams ni bka' gter gnyis ldan dang*/ gzhan rnams ni zab gter sna tshogs las byung ba'i gdams pa sha stag go /de ltar le tshan lnga bcu rtsa gsum la brgyud pa'i bka' srol dang cho ga'i khyad par las nang gses su phye bas drug cu rtsa bdun legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa'i rim pa la/ ༈ thog mar bla ma zhi ba'i skor las/ thugs gter gnam skas ma bla ma gsang 'dus thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub dang 'brel pa zlum po bzhi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gter ston chos dbang*/ sman lung pa/ dwags ston/ gnyan ston/ se sdings pa yab sras/ chos sku 'od zer/ chos kyi dbang po/ karma gu ru/ kun bzang dpal 'byor/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje/

rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ pad+ma bstan 'dzin theg mchog rgya mtsho'i sde'am 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ bka' drin zla bral 'gyur med kun bzang rnam rgyal blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde'am/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin zhes bya ba/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen can la dgyes bzhin du bka' drin stsal to// ༈ /gtor dbang gnad kyi shog gcig ma la/ chos longs sprul gsum/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag nyang yab sras/ gu ru chos dbang*/ sman lung pa/ dwags ston/ gnyan ston/ yon tan bzang po/ chos sku 'od zer/ chos kyi rdo rje/ shes rab dbang phyug chos kyi dbang po/ karma gu ru/ chos dbang bsam grub/ chos dbang kun bzang*/ rje phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na karma gu ru nas/ kun bzang dpal 'byor/ chos dbang lhun grub/ de gnyis ka las rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /nyang gter bla ma yongs rdzogs la/ chos longs sprul gsum/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gter ston nyang chen/ sras 'gro mgon/ slob dpon nam langs/ byang chub mgon/ slob dpon bstan srung*/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa/ bde legs rgya mtsho/ bya bral chos rje/ sangs rgyas dbon/ kun spangs pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ sna tshogs rang grol/ bstan 'dzin grags pa/ pad+ma phrin las/ tshul khrims rdo rje/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/

pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /bla ma drag po'i skor las/ nyang gter drag dmar bde 'dus rdo rje spyi blugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ gter ston nyang*/ gnyos zhig mtshan ldan grub thob/ grags 'od/ grags rgyal/ tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ shes rab rgyal po/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ mkha' klong yangs pa/ skal ldan rgya mtsho/ mi 'gyur las 'phro ba/ 'bri khung pa rat+na/ gtsang pa ngag dbang*/ gar gyi dbang phyug blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gzhan phan rdo rje/ phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na gter ston nyang chen nas/ sras 'gro mgon/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ chos nyid rang grol/ sangs rgyas lhun dbang*/ kun dga' bkra shis/ rgyal sras thugs mchog legs pa dpal bzang*/ nyang ston chos dbang*/ snubs ston rin dpal/ yab rin rgyal/ sras paṇa chen mched/ 'a zhwa mkhyen brtse dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// 'di la rdo rje gling pa'i gter brgyud ltar na/ au ḍ+yān yab yum nas/ bai ro tsa na/ gter ston rdo rje gling pa/ bkra shis 'byung gnas/ chos nyid rang grol/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams 'byung gnas/ rgyal ba'i mtshan can/ 'dzam gling grags pa/ pad+ma grags pa/ lung rigs rgya mtsho/ bstan 'phel rgya mtsho/ gzhan phan rnam rol/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/

rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// pad+ma gling pa'i gter brgyud ltar na/ au ḍ+yān yab yum nas/ pad+ma gling pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bstan 'dzin grags pa/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ rje phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na/ bstan 'dzin grags pa nas/ pad+ma phrin las/ tshul khrims rdo rje/ phrin las lhun grub de gnyis ka las rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ //'bring po me'i spu gri la/ gong gi nyang gter rdo rje spyi blugs bzhin no// chung ba lu gu brgyud la/ nyang chen dang rdo rje gling pa gnyis ka'i brgyud srol snga ma bzhin las/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ de gnyis ka las rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /drag dmar bka' ma 'o bran lugs la/ chos longs sprul gsum/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ 'o bran dpal gyi 'byung gnas/ dpal gyi dbang phyug chos kyi 'byung gnas/ grags pa rgya mtsho/ dbang gi rgyal po/ rta mchog rgyal po/ ri rab brtan pa ste bdun po 'o bran brgyud do// de nas nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun blo/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ tshul khrims dbang phyug dkon mchog 'bangs/ dbang phyug rdo rje/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ karma lung rigs/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/

rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /byang gter drag po rtsal gyi byin rlabs thugs rje'i dbang la/ kun tu bzang po/ bde gshegs rigs lnga/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ dbang gi mkha' 'gro/ tshangs pa/ lha'i dbang po/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ rgyal po dzaḥ shākya pra bha/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ bi ma la/ shī la mañju/ rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gter ston rgod ldem/ sras rnam rgyal mgon po/ rdo rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma rnam gnyis/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ tshe ring dbang po/ klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' rig 'dzin/ thugs mchog 'od 'bar/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /yang na gter ston nas/ sangs rgyas byams bzang*/ se nyi ma bzang po/ mgon bzang*/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ spyan 'tshab pa/ byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ byams pa bzang po/ kun bzang nyi ma/ nam mkha' 'brug sgra/ phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas/ byang bdag dbang po'i sde/ sras ngag gi dbang po/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ de gnyis ka las rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /tshe dpag med kyi skor las/ lung lugs sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/

kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ phyag na rdo rje/ ku ku rā dza/ rgyal po dzaḥ singha rā dza/ u pa rā dza/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ bi ma la mi tra/ gnyags lo tsā ba/ sog po dpal ye/ gnubs chen/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ nyang sher mchog nyang ye 'byung*/ zur che chung*/ thugs sras ka chen bzhi/ gsang bdag sgro phug pa/ kha rag gnubs gshen/ mkhas pa jo sad/ rog shes rab 'od/ rog brtson 'grus seng ge 'khrul zhig dar ma seng ge bsod nams dpal/ de gnyis ka las dpal chen pa/ drin can pa/ gtsug rgyan nor bu/ kun rgyal ba/ chos rgyal ba/ byang chub bzang po/ kun rdor ba rnams rog brgyud dang*/ de nas sa dpal mgon pa/ so bsod nams rig 'dzin/ so bdud 'dul/ so dbang 'dzin pa/ grub chen dam pa rin po che/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /rdzong chen lugs kyi tshe dbang la/ chos longs sprul gsum sogs gong gi gtor dbang gnad kyi shog gcig ma'i brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// byang gter tshe sgrub lcags sdong ma la/ tshe dpag med/ lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ gter ston rgod ldem/ sangs rgyas byams bzang*/ se ston rin rgyal/ spyan 'tshab pa/ byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ byams pa bzang po/ kun bzang nyi ma/ nam mkha' 'brug sgra/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /yang na byams pa chos rgyan nas/ byang bdag yab sras/ chos dbyings rang grol/ kun mkhyen bla ma/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ de gnyis ka las rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/

rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /pad+ma gling pa'i rdor phreng la/ snang ba mtha' yas/ tshe dpag med/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa/ de'i sras zla ba/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ gsum ka las bstan 'dzin grags pa/ des mdo sngags bstan 'dzin dang*/ pad+ma phrin las/ snga mas phrin las lhun grub/ phyi mas gsung sprul tshul rdor/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ de gnyis ka las rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /grub thob lugs kyi tshe dbang la/ snang ba mtha' yas/ tshe dpag med/ dpal rta mgrin/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ thang stong rgyal po/ rdo rings kun spangs pa/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ dbang phyug rab brtan khu dbon/ kun mkhyen bla ma/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ gnyis ka las rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /yang na dbon mchog ldan nas/ rje bla ma rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las man 'dra'o// ༈ /spyan ras gzigs kyi skor las/ 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi pa'i dbang dang*/ nam mkha' rgyal po'i sgom lung la/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ srong btsan sgam po/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ grub thob dngos grub/ mnga' bdag nyang*/ la stod pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ shākya bzang po/ lha rje dge 'bum/ lcam ye shes mchog chu sgom pa/ mtha' bzhi bya bral/ tshul chen bsod nams seng ge bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ chu rags pa blo rgyam/ 'phags mchog nor bzang*/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ ngag dbang grags pa/

byang sems shes rab dpal/ rje kun dga' grol mchog sna tshogs rang grol/ de gnyis ka las bstan 'dzin grags pa/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /yang na 'phags mchog nor bzang pa nas/ mkhas grub chos rje/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog skyabs/ mnga' ris paṇa chen/ gtsang pa ngag dbang*/ gar gyi dbang po/ ngag gi dbang phyug gzhan phan rdo rje/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho la/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu pa/ zangs ri ras pa/ rje dbu se/ ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pak+shi/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ rang byung rdo rje/ she grags seng*/ dar rgyal ba/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ chos dpal ye shes/ dpal 'byor don grub/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ bkra shis dpal 'byor/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ dkon mchog 'bangs/ dbang phyug rdo rje/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag rnon po nad gcod la/ gshin rje'i gshed/ rdo rje rnon po/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shān+tiṃ gar+bha/ ye shes snying po/ kha gar+bha/ khrag 'thung nag po/ gtsug lag dpal dge au ḍ+yān chen po pad+mā ka ra/ ba su dhā ra/ gnubs chen/ rgya zhang khrom/

gnubs chung*/ mtshur ston rin rdor/ sku zhang dpal ldan/ tshul khrims rin chen/ byang chub mgon/ nam mkha'i mtshan can/ rig 'dzin tshul khrims/ rgya ston dbon po/ 'bri khung pa rat+na/ chos rgyal phun tshogs/ bkra shis phun tshogs/ chos kyi grags pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na chos rgyal phun tshogs nas/ rin chen dar rgyas/ rje bla ma rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las man 'dra'o// ༈ /rta mgrin gyi skor las/ yang gsang gi gtor dbang la/ snang ba mtha' yas/ dpal rta mgrin/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ lo chen bai ro tsa na/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ gter ston rnam gsum/ zhang gzi brjid/ bla ma rgya/ 'dar phyar/ bo stong rin chen/ nyan chen pa/ chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ dpal ldan seng ge rin chen bkra shis/ yon tan mgon po/ rwa ban chos dpal/ mus srad pa/ rnam rgyal bzang po/ dkon mchog bzang po/ tshar chen/ mkhyen brtse/ bsod nams chos 'phel/ dbang rab khu dbon/ zur chen/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /shangs lugs su grags pa rta mgrin gsang sgrub la/ snang ba mtha' yas/ pad+ma dbang chen/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ sangs rgyas dbang chen/ skyer khang pa/ gnyan ston/ chos rje ston pa/ shangs ston/ rgyal mtshan 'bum/ khyung po tshul mgon/ ri khrod ras chen/ sangs rgyas rdo rje/ thar pa dpal bzang*/ sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen/ mkhyen brtse/ dbang rab/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ chos dbyings rang grol/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las man 'dra'o// nyang gter rta nag la/ snang ba mtha' yas/ rta mchog

au ḍ+yān yab yum/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ nyang ral/ nyang zhig rgyal sras sne'u/ nyi ma 'od zer/ sbyin pa seng ge ye shes snying po/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ bsam gtan dpal/ nyi ma rdo rje/ phrin las don grub/ ri pa brtson rgyal/ ngag dbang bstan pa/ 'khon bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las man 'dra'o// chos dbang rta nag la/ snang ba mtha' yas/ rta mgrin nag po/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ chos dbang*/ yar klungs sprul sku mched/ sman lung pa shāka 'bum dang*/ shāka gzhon/ de gnyis kyis chos kyi 'od zer/ rgya rwa ba sangs rgyas ye shes/ rin chen bzang po/ rin chen dbang phyug nam mkha' dpal/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ karma gu ru/ chos dbang bsam grub/ chos dbang kun bzang*/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /phyag rdor gyi skor las/ byang chub gling pa'i gtum po la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ nam mkha'i snying po/ gter ston dpal rgyal mtshan/ rgyal mtshan bshes gnyen/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos nyid shes rab/ nam mkha' grags pa/ bde legs rgyal mtshan/ se rin rgyal/ mgon po zla ba/ byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ byang bdag yab sras/ gcen bstan 'dzin nor bu/ gcung phyag rdor nor bu/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las man 'dra'o// grwa pa'i phyag rdor khang brtsegs la/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon pad+ma/ grwa pa mngon shes/ bu rwa ba bsod rin/ nye gnas ga dran/ sgom chen smon lam 'bar/ gung chung ston pa/ sha mi sgom chen/ dol pa badz+ra pā ṇi/ rgya byang sems/ brag dkar sman bla/ dkon mchog gzhon nu/ mang mkhar tshul gzhon/

chos dpal bzang po/ sras sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'gos lo gzhon nu/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba rin rgyal/ rje grol mchog sangs rgyas ye shes/ byams pa lhun grub/ rje btsun kun snying*/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las man 'dra'o// las 'brel rtsal gyi dregs 'dul la/ kun tu bzang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ las 'brel rtsal/ legs ldan pa/ sras legs ldan rtsal/ yon tan mgon po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ chos sku 'od zer/ ye shes kun dga'/ pad+ma 'od zer/ ga ga shrī/ rtse le rig 'dzin/ karma gu ru/ mnga' bdag bkra shis lhun grub/ bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// rdo rje gling gter brgyud ltar na/ gter ston nyang chen po nas/ thugs sras pa/ chos nyid rang grol/ ras chen pa/ bsod nams mtshan can/ 'khrul zhig pa/ 'dzam gling grags pa/ pad+ma grags pa/ lung rigs rgya mtsho/ bstan 'phel rgya mtsho/ gzhan phan rnam rol/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// pad+ma gling pa'i gter brgyud ltar na/ gter ston chen po nas/ grub pa kun 'dus/ bstan 'dzin grags pa/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang dbang bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /phag mo'i skor las/ nyang gter zhal gnyis ma/ don grub ma/ dbu bcad ma gsum la/ rdo rje phag mo/ dga' rab rdo rje/

au ḍ+yān yab yum/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ mnga' bdag nyang ral/ nam mkha' dpal/ glan bang so ba/ gnyos bsod grags/ gnyos ston dpal/ sangs rgyas 'bar/ nyi ma'i snying po/ 'od gsal rgyal mtshan/ chos nyid shes rab/ bsod nams mtshan can/ yon tan seng ge shes rab rnam rgyal/ a seng rgyal mtshan/ kun bzang rnam rgyal/ shākya bzang po/ mnga' ris paṇa chen/ nyang kun dga' lhun grub/ karma gu ru/ nyang bstan 'dzin chos rgyal/ nyang bstan 'dzin chos dbang*/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /khros nag la/ rjes ma khros nag au ḍ+yān yab yum/ nyang yab sras/ lha ri sangs rgyas ras pa/ grub thob me long rdo rje/ shes rab dbang phyug blo gros seng ge yon tan rdo rje/ rin chen dngos grub/ mnga' ris paṇa chen/ kun dga' lhun grub/ kun bzang dpal 'byor/ chos dbang lhun grub/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /shes rab kyi lha'i skor las/ ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dkar la/ 'jam dpal/ dzai tā ri/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti/ nor bu gling pa/ 'byung gnas sbas pa/ kha che paṇa chen/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ grags pa gzhon nu/ bsod nams grags/ 'khon bsod nams rgyal/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal/ nam mkha' 'od zer/ grags pa 'phel/ lo chen shes rin/ gnas brtan 'od 'phro ba/ shes rin sku skye/ rje tshar chen pa/ mkhyen brtse khu dbon/ bsod nams mchog grub/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las man 'dra'o// yang na mkhan chen bde ba dpal nas/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu pa/ bsod nams shes rab/ shes rab mgon po/ shar chen/ ngor chen/

mus chen/ byams rams pa/ nor bu phun tshogs/ shangs ston pa/ shes rab 'od zer/ thar pa rgyal mtshan/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// dam pa'i 'jam dpal smra seng la/ sangs rgyas/ nyi ma'i shing rta/ rig byed gzhon nu/ dbyangs can bzang po/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ dar+pan ā tsār+ya/ 'chims nam mkha' grags/ gzhon nu byang chub/ nyang stod pa tshul khrims/ don grub rin chen/ de ba rā dza/ slob dpon gnyan/ tshul khrims dga'/ bkra shis dpal/ bla brang pa bzang po dpal/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ rong ston/ dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal/ bsod nams lha dbang*/ kun dga' bkra shis/ dwags po phyogs las rnam rgyal/ bsod nams dge legs/ rtse le rig 'dzin/ au ḍ+yān bstan 'dzin/ karma gu ru/ nam mkha' chos dbang*/ blo mchog rdo rje/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ pha bong kha pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /dbyangs can ma la/ lha mo dbyangs can/ bram ze phur bu/ gtum po'i sde/ mchod sdong seng ge nyi ma seng ge dpe med 'tsho/ rgya mtsho chen po/ sum pa lo tsā ba/ gzad pa rin rgyal ba/ bo dong rin rtse/ thang chen blo gros dpal/ chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen chen po/ mkhas grub chos rje/ sangs rgyas dbon po/ kun spangs sems dpa' chen po/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rdza yig pa tshul rgyal/ rtse le rig 'dzin pa/ sras au ḍ+yān bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma dbang chen/ rin chen dar rgyas/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/

rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /phrin las kyi lha'i skor las/ rnam 'joms mthing ga sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs la/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ rgyal ba'i sde/ gzhon nu'i sde/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku sa li che chung*/ jo bo a ti sha/ rong pa 'gar dge 'dzad rkyang phu ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa gong ma lnga/ bla ma bsod dbang*/ byang gzhon pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ dkon mchog blo gros/ karma phrin las pa/ chos grub grags pa/ dkon mchog 'bangs/ dbang phyug rdo rje/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /rnam 'joms ba ri lugs la/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dzai tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug rin chen dpal/ byang gzhon pa/ byang chub seng ge shar chen/ ngor chen/ dpal rdor ba/ bya 'gyur ba bsod seng*/ sgo rum kun legs/ mkhyen brtse khu dbon/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ bsod nams mchog grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /chos dbang drang srong lok+t+ri la/ drang srong dri med/ dharma a shwa ka bram ze legs grub/ pra hasti/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ mnga' bdag yab sras/ gter ston chos dbang*/ pad+ma dbang chen/ yar ston sangs rgyas/ gnyan ston bkras seng*/ chos nyid rang grol/ sangs rgyas lhun dbang*/ kun dga' bkra shis/

rgyal sras chos rje/ chos 'phags bzang po/ shākya dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ mkha' dbyings rdo rje/ rin chen phun tshogs/ chos rgyal phun tshogs/ bkra shis phun tshogs/ gnyis kas chos kyi grags pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na bkra shis phun tshogs nas/ chos dbyings rang grol/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na gter ston nas/ ka thog pa rgyal bzang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mdo sde rgya mtsho/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ mkha' dbyings rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na dge 'dun rgya mtsho nas/ rab 'byams chos rje yab sras/ rtse le rig 'dzin/ au ḍ+yān bstan 'dzin/ karma gu ru/ chos dbang bstan 'dzin/ chos dbang kun bzang*/ phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ /rin chen gling pa'i 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha la/ 'jam dpal/ phyag na rdo rje/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ mnga' bdag khri srong*/ gter ston rin chen gling pa/ nam mkha' 'od zer/ chos dbyings pa/ bla ma dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' legs pa/ slob dpon phun tshogs/ rdo rje rin chen/ yon tan rdo rje/ g.yung drung rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams blo gros/ rtse le rig 'dzin/ karma gu ru/ chos dbang bsam grub/ chos dbang kun bzang*/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub nas/ karma gsang sngags dang*/ blo mchog rdo rje brgyud de/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra'o// ༈ /bstan srung mgon po'i skor las/ legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po'i brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang*/ rigs lnga/ phyag rdor/ rgyal po dzaḥ ku ku rā dza/ ro langs bde ba/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ dharma bo dhi/ bal po nor 'dzin/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ nyang sher mchog nyang ye 'byung*/ zur chen shāka 'byung*/ zur chung sher grags/ glan shāka bzang*/ 'dar nag bsod grags/ 'dar nag kun dga'/ jo btsun shes 'bar/ hor nag dpang sgron/ chos skyong 'od/ 'dar shākya byang chub/

'dar kun dga' 'od/ bar ston blo rgyal/ snar ston shākya dpal/ snar ston bud+dha dh+wa dza/ shākya ram pa/ rdor rgyal bzang po/ dpang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gnyis kas dpang bde legs rgyal mtshan/ se ston rin rgyal/ 'dar nag kun bzang rin chen/ gzhon nu stobs ldan/ byams pa rin chen rdo rje/ skyi ston tshe ring dbang po/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /yang dbang kha 'di kho na'i brgyud pa ltar na/ ba su dhā ra nas/ grub thob rin chen skye/ rmad bu chos seng*/ bye bu log se/ shud bu rdor seng*/ zhang ston bkra shis/ zur che chung*/ glan jo gzungs/ zur he ru/ g.yu ston sangs rgyas/ g.yu ston chos mgon/ lce grub pa 'bum/ zur bde byed mgon po/ 'bro 'jam dbyangs bsam rdor/ zur haṃ shāka 'byung*/ lang 'gro tshe dbang rgyal po/ rgyal sras chos rje/ legs pa dpal bzang*/ gnubs rat+na shrī/ zur rgyal ba'i sras po/ zur gsang bdag nor bu/ zur bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ zur shākya shes rab man 'dra/ yang rjes gnang gtor dbang ltar na/ lce grub 'bum nas/ bla ma shākya seng ge sras seng ge dpal/ rdor gling pa byang chub rin chen/ bsod nams blo rgyal/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dbang bde legs rgyal mtshan/ se rin rgyal/ spyan 'tshab pa/ nub dgon pa byams pa chos rgyan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ byams pa bzang po/ shākya rgyal mtshan/ rin chen chos 'phel/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las man 'dra/ nyang gter phyag bzhi pa la/ che mchog he ru ka ye shes mgon po/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ nyang yab sras/ lha ri sangs rgyas ras pa/ me long rdo rje/ bsod nams blo gros/ sgom sde bya bral/ maṅga la sid+dhi/ bsod nams rin chen/

kun dga' tshul khrims/ bkra shis dbang phyug bsod nams bzang po/ 'od gsal klong yangs/ shākya dpal bzang*/ nyi zla grags pa/ nam mkha' dpal ldan/ 'brug sgra bzang po/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang*/ dbang bka' de nyid dang*/ mgon dkar tshe dbang gi brgyud pa ltar na/ me long rdo rje nas/ ku mā rā dza/ dbang phyug rin chen/ shes rab dbang phyug blo gros seng ge yon tan rdo rje/ bla ma dpal 'byung*/ dol po rin chen grub/ khro rgyal 'bar/ mnga' ris paṇa chen/ mnga' bdag kun dga' lhun grub/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ bstan 'dzin nor bu/ bstan 'dzin chos rgyal/ nam mkha' 'brug sgra/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje/ thugs sras pad+mar 'gyur med rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// chos dbang ma ning la/ kun bzang*/ che mchog dpal mgon/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ gter ston chos dbang*/ sman lung pa/ dwags ston/ gnyan ston/ se sdings pa khu dbon/ chos sku 'od zer/ dpal 'byor dbang phyug chos kyi dbang po/ karma gu ru/ mnga' bdag sprul sku/ chos dbang kun bzang*/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ cho ga'i khrigs 'dis rdor gling*/ rata gling*/ pad gling*/ 'ja' tshon pa rnams kyi ma ning gi srog dbang kyang 'gros gcig pa'i phyir brgyud tshul gang 'dod grangs kyang chog go /mgon po stag zhon dang*/ bed bka' gter la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ shān+tiṃ gar+bha/ rom bu gu h+ya/ khrag 'thung nag po/ sgeg pa rdo rje/ ba su dha ra/ gnubs chen/ brang nga kun grags/ so ban 'bum grags/ skyo ban mthu chen/ lce mdo sde seng ge rong pa rgwa lo/ lce blo ldan seng ge bla ma sri'u chung pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ chos rgyal dpal bzang*/

chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ chos skyong rin chen/ tshar chen no// yang*/ gnubs chen nas/ zhang khrom/ rog grags se/ rog sher dbang*/ lce mdo sde seng ge rong pa rgwa lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ bsod nams lhun grub/ kun 'phel/ ngag dbang grags pa/ dpal ldan legs dbang*/ bla ma dbang rgyal/ bkra shis ye shes/ chos rgyal bzang po/ chos kyi 'od zer/ ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams blo gros/ sham+bha ra ba kun dga'/ tshar chen no// de nas/ mkhyen brtse/ bsod nams chos 'phel/ dbang rab khu dbon/ chos dbyings rang grol/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra/ yang na lce blo ldan seng ge nas/ lce rin chen dpal/ lce dbang phyug rdo rje/ bla ma chos grags/ chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ bsod nams blo gros man 'dra'o// ༈ /bstan bsrung sna tshogs pa'i skor las/ e ka dza ṭī sde bdun sbags sgrub la/ kun mkhyen yan snying tig spyi brgyud ltar las/ kun mkhyen nas/ bde legs rgya mtsho/ ma ti maṅga/ yon tan dpal/ sprul sku bsam rgyal/ nam mkha' gzhon nu/ mkha' klong yangs pa/ sman rtse ba blo rgyal/ sna tshogs rang grol/ bstan 'dzin grags pa/ karma rgyal sras/ rin chen dar rgyas/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// e ka dza ṭī gtso rkyang la/ jo 'beng yan snying tig spyi brgyud ltar las/ de nas khams sgom chen po/ stong gsum sgom chen/ ku mā rā dza/ kun mkhyen chen po/ bde legs rgya mtsho/ bya bral chos rje/ sangs rgyas dbon po/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rin chen grub/ 'jangs pa kun rgyal/ gar gyi dbang phyug blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dbang gi rgyal po/ kun bzang rnam rgyal/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// ༈ /lha mo re ma ti rang byung rgyal mo la/ bka' ma ltar na/ gsang bdag au ḍ+yān yab yum/ dam 'bre sa le/ lang lab byang rdor/ skyi nag gyang 'gyel/ skyi byang chub 'bum/ skyi ston blo gros/ 'dre ge rad/ lce rin rdor/ rwa chos dbyings/

brtson seng*/ chos bkra shis/ sher seng*/ kun dga' seng ge 'jam blo/ phur pa skyabs/ tshul rgyam pa/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos bsam pa sogs las blo gros rgya mtshor brgyud pa man 'dra'o// gter brgyud ni/ slob dpon pad+ma nas/ gter ston pu rangs pa zhang btsun/ khyung po stag gsham pa/ kyu ra rgyal ye/ chag bla chen/ stong dpon sher mgon/ rje dus mkhyen/ ras chen pa/ spom brag pa/ karma pa/ gnyan ras/ rang byung rdo rje/ kun dga' 'od zer/ bsod nams dpal/ kun dga' blo gros/ sog dbon pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ gnyan pa grub chen/ chos grub grags pa/ dkon mchog 'bangs/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ chos kyi blo gros/ lung rigs rgya mtsho/ gter bdag gling pa man 'dra/ lha mo gshog rgod ma la/ slob dpon pad+ma/ nyang yab sras/ chos dbang yab sras/ 'do bo ras pa/ yon tan rdo rje/ chos rje shes rab/ khrag 'thung pa/ dz+nyā na bha dra/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bsam gtan rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ bsod nams bkra shis/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ rje btsun kun snying*/ bsod nams mchog grub/ gter bdag gling pa man 'dra/ yang na rje btsun nas rim par brgyud de/ blo gros rgya mtsho man 'dra'o// ༈ /lha mo srog sgrub ma'i gtor dbang la/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ las 'brel rtsal/ rgyal sras legs pa/ bde legs rgya mtsho/ bya bral chos rje/ sangs rgyas dbon po/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rgya ma mi 'gyur ba/ rin chen phun tshogs/ shes rab 'od zer/ sras kun bzang*/ rin chen dar rgyas/ phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na au ḍ+yān yab yum nas/ kun mkhyen chen po/ bde legs rgya mtsho man sngar ltar ro// gza' bdud kyi srog dbang la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rin chen snying po/ phyag rdor/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ las 'brel rtsal/ lo ston rdo rje 'bum/ mthing ma sangs rgyas grags 'od/

rdo rje rgyal po/ dharma ke tu/ chos kyi blo gros/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/ sna tshogs rang grol/ kun dga' grags pa/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na kong chen po nas/ legs ldan rje/ byang bdag yab sras/ chos dbyings rang grol/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na gter ston nas/ rgyal sras legs pa/ ku mā rā dza/ kun mkhyen chen po nas/ rin chen phun tshogs par srog sgrub ma ltar las/ de nas/ gtsang pa ngag dbang*/ snang rtse ba/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gzhan phan rdo rje/ phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// gtor dbang la/ gsang bdag au ḍ+yān chen po/ kun mkhyen chos rje/ 'od gsal rang grol/ grags pa 'od zer/ zla ba grags pa/ grags pa rgya mtsho/ sman rtse ba blo rgyal/ bsod nams rin chen/ karma gu ru/ bshes gnyen phun tshogs/ rin chen dar rgyas/ phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// gza' dmar la/ gsang bdag phyag rdor/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ las 'brel rtsal/ rgyal sras legs pa/ ku mā rā dza/ kun mkhyen chen po nas/ rin chen phun tshogs bar srog sgrub ma ltar las/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ du ma rang grol/ ngag dbang ye grub/ chos dbyings rang grol/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// dam can rdor legs gter kha gnyis ldan las/ byang gter ltar na/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ gter ston yab sras/ rdo rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma rnam gnyis/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ chos rgyal bsod nams yab sras/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug byams pa skal bzang*/ dbang rab khu dbon/ chos dbyings rang grol/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra'o// rat+na'i gter brgyud ltar na/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/

gter ston/ tshe dbang grags pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ spel lcog las 'phro ba/ 'jig rten mgon po/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ nor bu chos brtan/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// zhing skyong seng gdong can las gsang ba'i bdag po/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ pad+ma gsal/ las 'brel rtsal/ gter ston legs ldan pa/ ku mā rā dza/ kun mkhyen chen po/ bsod nams 'od zer/ dharma pha la/ ga ga ke tu/ bsod nams bzang po/ bla ma rnam 'joms/ dri med sangs rgyas/ puṇ+yā shrī/ gu ru dzam+bha la/ bzang po dpal/ bsam grub rgyal po/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ du ma rang grol/ gzhon nu don grub/ chos dbyings rang grol/ phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// nyang gter dur khrod ma mo la/ khros nag au ḍ+yān yab yum/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ nyang yab sras/ sangs rgyas ras chen/ me long rdo rje/ rgyal sras blo ldan seng ge dpal mgon rdo rje/ rdo rje rang grol/ bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ dga' ba'i rdo rje/ bsam rgyal rdo rje/ byang chub gling pa/ sna tshogs rang grol/ sras kun dga' grags pa/ kun dga' rdo rje/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ bstan 'dzin lung rigs man 'dra'o// brtan ma bcu gnyis la/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ chos dbang yab sras/ dmar zhabs pa/ grags rgyal/ bkra shis mtshan can/ bdud 'dul sher 'od/ rnam mkhyen chos blo/ bsod nams seng ge 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ chos skyong tshul khrims/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen sku mched/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse khu dbon gsum/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// yang na dbon bsod mchog nas/ chos dbyings rang grol/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra'o// nyang gter pe ha ra la/
