gsang bdag au ḍ+yān yab yum/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ mnga' bdag nyang*/ don seng rgyal mtshan/ rtsa thar bya btang*/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs dpal rin/ dpal ldan don grub/ nam mkha' bzang po/ mkha' klong yangs pa/ skal ldan rgya mtsho/ rgya ma me 'gyur ba/ 'bri khung zur pa/ nyi zla sangs rgyas/ lan bu a mi/ dpal 'byor lhun grub/ chos dbyings rang grol/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra'o// ༈ /nor lha'i skor las/ rnam sras phyi sgrub ser chen sprin gseb ma la/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ mu tig btsan po/ zhang lha bzang klu dpal/ gter ston gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi 'od/ dbus pa dmar ston/ gcur ston/ 'od zer bla ma/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ thabs kyi blo gros/ gzad pa rin rgyal/ brag thog pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ sham+bha ra ba kun dga' sangs rgyas/ tshar chen/ mkhyen brtse/ dbang rab/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa bsod mchog rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /nang sgrub mdung dmar can rta sngon ma ni/ bshad ma thag pa bzhin no// gsang sgrub drag po rta sngon la/ gshin rje'i gshed/ rgyal po kun skyong*/ bal po nor 'dzin/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs rdo rje 'bar/ byang chub snying po/ spyi bo dong ring*/ gtsug tor 'gying ba/ bya pho brtsegs pa/ 'jol po dbang phyug dpal sras/ klus byin/ ra thung*/ gtso bo lha ste 'di yan gnubs brgyud do// de nas sbas ti dgra bcom/ shes rab seng ge tshul khrims dbang phyug yon tan tshul khrims/ shes rab rdo rje/ bka' bzhi pa blo gsal chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ legs pa'i blo gros/ rje dbon shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun grol mchog stag lung kun bkras/ rje btsun kun snying*/

mkhan chen zhwa lu pa/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// ༈ /yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī singha*/ bai ro tsa na/ g.yu sgra snying po/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ zhang lha bzang klu dpal/ gnyal pa nyi she nas thabs kyi blo gros yan phyi nang gnyis ltar las/ de nas dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rin chen/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ gnyags dbon chen po/ mkhan chen pad+ma bzang po/ mkhan chen chos dbang*/ mkhan chen chos grub seng ge thugs sras kun rgyal/ tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen/ mkhyen brtse khu dbon gsum/ phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// nang sgrub rta sngon can dang yang gsang gnyis la zangs dkar lo tsā ba nas brgyud de gsar ma'i 'dren tshul kyang yod do// gnod sbyin zhang blon la/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ mgon po klu sgrub/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ grwa pa mngon shes/ nye gnas ga dran/ pu ra ba bsod rin/ gnyis kas smon lam 'bar/ sha mi rdor rgyal/ dol pa badz+ra pā ṇi/ rgya byang seng*/ brag dkar sman bla/ dkon mchog gzhon nu/ 'gar tshul gzhon/ chos dpal bzang po/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen sku mched/ au ḍ+yān rgyal po/ kun dga' bkra shis/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ dzam dmar la/ au ḍ+yān chen po/ grwa pa mngon shes/ grwa thugs rje 'bum/ shu la tsan+d+ra/ slob dpon tshul rgyal/ mkhan po nyi ma/ slob dpon don bzang*/ dbu ma pa grub brtson/ bkra shis bzang po/ blo gros bzang po/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ paṇa chen byams gling pa/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rtse le rig 'dzin/ au ḍ+yān bstan 'dzin/ karma gu ru/ chos dbang bstan rgyal/ chos dbang bsam grub/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub man 'dra'o// lha chen la/

snang mtha'/ thugs rje chen po/ au ḍ+yān yab yum/ mchims rdo rje sbre chung*/ gter ston las 'brel rtsal/ rgyal sras legs pa/ karma pa rang byung rdo rje/ g.yung ston pa/ rol dpal rdo rje/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ sog dbon pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ khams pa grags rgyal/ nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma sprul sku/ chos bzang rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' lhun grub/ pad+ma phrin las/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// smras pa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mkhyen brtse nus so cog /'dus pa'i rang bzhin rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi// dngos grub sgrub thabs dbang bskur rjes su gnang*// gces btus 'dod 'jo'i bum pa bzang pos 'byor// zhes dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter las/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang zhes bya ba'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi sarga ste bco lnga pa'o// //rgyud sde bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa ni/ gdul bya dbang po rnon po'i mchog gi rigs can gyis/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas thams cad dang dbyer med du 'dzin cing thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas pa bsrung ba lhur len pa la/ gzhan don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di'am bar do'am skye ba bdun la sogs pa nas 'grub par byed pa'i/ lam gyi rtsa ba bum pa'i dbang mtha' dag gi steng du/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ dbang bzhi pa bcas yongs su rdzogs par bskur nas/ kye rdo rje las/ dngos po nyid kyis rnam grol zhing*// dngos po'i 'ching bas 'ching bar 'gyur// de yongs shes pas grol ba yin// dngos po med pa'ang yongs shes pas// dngos po bsgom 'gyur shes rab can// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

'khor ba'i 'dra 'bag lam du byed pa'i tshul gyis rang nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du bsgoms pas sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo tha mal gyi skye 'chi bar do'i gnas skabs su snang ba'i chos thams cad de/ de'ang lha'i ngo bor rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pas lhar 'gyur ba'i gzhi yin pa dang*/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog gis de dag la tha mal du bzung nas 'khor bar 'ching ba'i rgyur byed pas sbyang dgos pa'i gzhi yang yin pa'i phyir ro// sbyang bya snang ba de dag la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa mtha' dag sbyong byed rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi cha dang*/ ye shes lnga la sogs pa chos kyi sku'i yon tan rnams dang*/ lha'i rnam par bskyed cing bsdu ba la sogs pas gzugs kyi skur bsgom pa rnams yin la/ sbyang tshul sbyang gzhi'i chos su snang ba thams cad sku gsum gyi lam du sgyur bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs nas/ sbyangs 'bras mthar thug sku bzhi zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa/ thabs ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med par spyod pa'i don du gsungs pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste/ de la dbye na/ tshul gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan las/ rnal 'byor che la thabs shes gnyis med gsum// zhes thabs kyi rgyud bla na med pa dang*/ shes rab kyi rgyud bla na med pa dang*/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud bla na med pa gsum du phye ba'i khyad par yang*/ de nyid las/ de yi khyad par gleng gzhi'i yi ge dang*// bskyed rim lha dang rdzogs rim rnam pa gnyis/ rjes spyod rnam dag rgyud kyi gdul bya rnams// rim bzhin mang nyung pho mo thabs shes te// gang gang gtso che thabs dang shes rab ste// de de gnyis ka ldan na gnyis med rgyud// ces rags pa'i 'jog byed du gsungs shing*/ don la gsang ba 'dus pa sogs kyang gnyis su med pa nyid du byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel chen las bshad pa ltar nges dgos shing*/

'dir 'jog byed de dag dang rjes su mthun par gtso bor pha rgyud dam thabs kyi rgyud de/ de la'ang zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum gyi/ dang por 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul bar byed pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs su gtogs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsungs shing rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis legs par bkral ba'i bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod rdo rje lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho/ gtor chog 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho/ rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho/ mchod phreng mchod sbyin rgya mtsho/ bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho bcas dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi sgrub dkyil zur 'debs mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor dang bcas pa'i steng nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par nos pa'i brgyud pa la bka' babs bdun ldan du bzhugs pa'i thog mar 'gos lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/

rngog lugs kyang zer/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ mkha' 'gro ma gri thod can/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ rgya gar shar phyogs o ḍi bi sha bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ dpal mgon/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i dge slong dpal ldan/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ de la slob ma'i mchog ār+ya de wa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ klu'i byang chub/ zla ba grags pa ste bzhis zhus/ de bzhi ka las slob pa'i rdo rje/ paṇa ser/ de nas nag po spyod pa ba/ sa 'dres pa chen po/ paṇa phud rab byung*/ de las mar me mdzad/ dī paṃ ka ra/ de wa a ka ra tsan+d+ra/ paṇa dka' khyim pa'i rten can/ mngon shes can gyi paṇ+ḍi ta yin/ bi d+yā bha dra gsum gyis gsan/ sa 'dres pa'i slob ma lnga las shān+ti pa dang*/ dpa' sras gnyis las ma gsan/ gzhan gsum ga las gsan par bu ston gyis bshad do// gsum ga las 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis gsan zhing*/ sngags pa gos dkar co breg can yin/ deng sang rab byung gi chas 'dri ba ni rnam par ma brtags pa'o// der ma zad za hor gyi mkhas pa btsun mo can/ paṇa dkar/ bal yul ljongs kyi nā ga ko ṭi bi kra ma la shī la'i thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis par grags pa dī paṃ ka ra/ paṇa ser/ rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po nag po pa/ paṇa ser/ kaṅka la'i mkhas pa chen po rgyal bu sprin paṇa dkar/ gyi shugs can/ zur gyis 'gos la mthu byung bar de'i gnyen por gshin rje 'char ka zhus nas bsgyur ba'i 'char ka sprin shugs mar grags pa 'di las gsan pa yin no/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi mkhas pa chen po dza hūm̐ gsan yig na dza hu zhes snang*/ zhes pa zhi ba bzang po/ paṇa dkar/ kha che khri brtan gyi mkhas pa chen po tsan+d+ra ha ri sogs paṇ+ḍi ta bdun bcu/ paṇa dkar/ mkha' 'gro'i bla ma gnyis dang bcas pa las lo tsā ba 'gos kyis gsan/

'gos lo tsā ba nas/ 'jad pa so rong gi mang ra ba rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na 'dzad bo dong gi zhes snang*/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rab byung*/ 'jad brag ltag gi rngog ye shes seng ge rab byung*/ de'i dbon po rngog nyi ma seng ge rngog mu ne rab tu byung ba'i mtshan/ bres chu dbar gyi glan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam/ sngags pa gos dkar co breg de gnyis ka las rngog ār+ya de wa/ rngog mu ni rab tu ma byung gong gi sras sngags dkar/ de'i zhar chos pa skyi mkhar 'jug bres kha dben tsha'i rtag pa rin chen grags/ rab byung*/ de las bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chos sku 'od zer gyis rgyud 'grel bshad bka' thob/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod zhwa lu'i ri phug gi byang nag phug gong gi dgon pa tshes phug pa de yang tshong 'dus kyi nub dgon pa khyung po lhas kyi gdan sa thog gcig mdzad pas khyung lhas par grags/ gdung nas skyo/ nams/ pa ri dga' chen/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bstan pa'i sgron me 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ bka' drin mnyam med mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/

tshul khrims dpal bzang ngam/ tshul khrims lhun grub/ thar rtse pa mkhan chen nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la'o// yang na kun mkhyen nas/ paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen man gong bzhin/ yang na rje dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ zhabs drung a mi lags man sngar bzhin no// yang na rngog ye shes seng ge dang glan rtsad tsha gnyis las/ snyi mo phug ka ba 'bum skyabs/ rong lha steng gi gtsong ston smra seng*/ nyang stod sribs chung gi lce mdo sde seng ge de nas kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer man 'dra/ yang na brag ltag pa ye shes seng ge las/ bod btsun/ cha gar mon mo brag gi mi nyag rdo rje sngags pa gos dkar co breg can/ grags/ de nas lce mdo sde seng ge gos dkar co breg can/ dge sdings pa chos sku 'od zer man 'dra/ yang na glan rtsad tsha nas/ thang spe ba/ grub thob gser sdings pa/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na dge sdings pa chos sku 'od zer nas/ lce blo ldan seng ge blo ma 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na 'gos lo tsā ba nas/ dbus pa dge ser/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa chen/ kha'u pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang man sngar dang 'dra'o// bka' babs gnyis pa mar lugs kyi brgyud par nang gses kyi sgro 'dogs nang nas chod pa grub thob nyams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i gsan yig na 'di 'phags lugs min gsung*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ ḍā ki bde ba'i zhabs/ ḍom+bi he ru ka rdo rje dril bu pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/

kam+ba la pa/ nag po spyod pa/ me tog dkar po'i thod can/ tai lo pa/ nā ro nag po mi lpags gsol ba rgyan drug phyag ḍā thod/ pa/ kun tu bzang po/ nam mkha'i snying po ye shes dngos grub/ rtsa bshad pa/ snyan grags bzang po rnams mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ mar lo chos kyi blo gros/ gos dkar lcang lo can/ mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje/ sngags dkar/ 'khon gad pa kīrti/ bod btsun/ 'khon bya khang pa bsod nams rin chen/ 'khon thur lha ba tshul khrims skyabs/ bod btsun/ thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od/ bod btsun/ dge sdings pa chos sku 'od gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje zer/ zer man 'gos lugs dang 'dra/ yang na 'khon gad pa kīrti nas/ 'gar ston shes rab rgya mtsho/ yar klungs zur ri dgon bsngags dkar/ grang po khra bo la rtsar aṅku pa rin chen seng ge la stod pa bod btsun/ rong pa shes rab seng ge rab byung*/ ston mo lung pa ye shes 'bar/ bod btsun/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer man sngar bzhin no// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ lha bu ser po chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ gsang mtshan ma taṅgi pa/ grub thob dmar smug ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya me tog gi thod can/ tai lo pa man 'dra'o// bka' babs gsum pa mar lugs mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub yan 'gos lugs ltar la/ rje btsun btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na mi 'dren pa 'dra zhig 'dug kyang chu bo gnyis 'dres yin pas skyon du mi 'gyur/ de nas 'jam dpal zhal mthong shākya mi tra/ sgrol ma zhal gzigs nā ga bo dhi/ sa brgyad non pa ār+ya de wa/ spyan ras gzigs zhal mthong*/ ma taṅgi pa ste klu sgrub kyi thugs sras bzhi/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/

legs ldan 'byed/ mkhas mchog dpa' bo ste nye ba'i sras gsum/ bdun po de'i nang nas ma taṅgi pa nas/ tai lo pa/ na ro pa/ mar pa'o// yang na klu sgrub kyis ma taṅgi pa nas/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug a wa dhū tī pa/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ nag po'i zhabs/ dri med blo gros/ nub lak+ṣe tra'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i dpal ye shes snying pos lho brag mar pa lo tsā ba la gdams te/ mar pa la 'phags skor gyi rgyud 'grel pa dang rgyud rkyang bshad rgyud lnga gzhung phran dang bcas pa dang*/ ye shes zhabs lugs sogs rgya gar nas 'grel pa nyer gsum/ jo bos nyer lnga tsam yang gsan par grags/ bod na 'grel pa bdun zer yang mang du snang*/ mar pa la/ dza ya na/ tha ga na/ snyim tog gsum yod/ lo tsā ba 'dis rgya gar du lan gsum/ bal por lan bzhi ste lan bdun byon/ shar nub lho byang kha che bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang ku sa lir grags tshad la bla ma brgya rtsa/ brgyud pa 'dzin nges lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum/ 'dus pa la mkhas pa'i bla ma bdun dang bcas yod pa'i nang gi ye shes snying po 'di dbang brgyud man ngag gdams pa'i bka' thams cad babs pa'i gtso bor 'dzin no// bu bzhi'i nang tshan mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge*/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po/ gung thang gi mid la ras pa/ 'khon ston gad pa kīrti/ de las mi nyag thur lwa ba tshul khrims skyabs/ dbus pa 'gar dge grub thob zhang zhung pa ste thugs sras gsum gyis gsan/ gsum ga las gangs par ser kha'i rin chen gling pa tshul khrims mdzes/ btsong kha pa/ mkhyen brtse/ thar rtse/ sgrub khang pa bzhi'i gsan yig na 'di bzhin byung yang kun mkhyen bu'i gsan yig na gling pa tshul khrims mdzes zur du mdzad 'dug pa brtag ces lnga pa chen po gsung ngo*// bla ma rgya rnal 'byor pho ba lung pa/

dge slong chos grags dpal bzang po/ bla ma shākya gzhon nu/ bla ma blo ldan pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od man sngar ltar ro// yang na 'khon gad pa kīrti nas/ 'gar ston pa/ gnyan rtse ba/ go lung pa ye rgyal/ rong ston mkhan po/ phug ri ba byang chub gzungs/ shong blo brtan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na lo mchog pa nas/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ rje thog ston pa/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab man 'dra'o// bka' babs bzhi pa jo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti che ba/ slob dpon nā ga dzo ki bram zes ha ra/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ zla ba grags pa/ ku sa li che chung*/ jo bo chen po dī paṃ ka ra/ rong pa 'gar dge lha rje stod pa tshul khrims dpal/ sngags pa gos dkar lcang lo can/ de sras che ba shes rab rgyal po/ chung ba shes rab gtsug tor/ lha rje chen po dharma tsakra/ thang stod chos kyi 'od/ bla chen klog skya grags pa bzang po/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bu dang sngags rams pa'i gsan yig na 'di ltar snang*/ thar rtse pa dang sgrub khang pa'i gsan yig na shes rab rgyal mtshan zer ba 'dug pa dpyad/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtshos gsan pa man 'dra'o/ bu thar rtse sgrub khang shar pa bzhi'i gsan yig na bla ma sgom ye zer ba zhig 'dug kyang de'i brgyud pa gong ma tshigs bcad kyi stabs nas mi gsal lo/ /bka' babs lnga pa chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub yan sngar ltar la/ de las slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen/ slob dpon ār+ya de wa/ klu byang*/ zla ba grags pa ste sras kyi thu bo bzhis gsan/ ār+ya de wa nas/ 'phags pa rta dbyangs/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ dpe med dpal/ gam+bhi ra ma ti pa/

niska laṅka pa de wa/ paṇa dkar/ re wen+d+ra pa de wa/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ pod ka dkar po phyar bu dang zhwa rtse ring ser po/ 'u yug kung ra ba bla ma dpal/ phyar bu bse bo/ bla ma grags chen/ don mo ri pa/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na slob dpon klu'i byang chub nas/ ḍom+bi pa/ bī ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ rdo rje gdan pa/ paṇa dkar/ re wen+d+ra/ chag lo tsā ba man 'dra/ yang na slob dpon zla ba grags pa nas/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rnam par grags pa'i lha/ rnyog med lha/ paṇa dkar/ gong gi niska laṅka ba de wa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ 'di gsum don gcig ming gi rnam grangs/ re wen+d+ra/ chag lo man 'dra'o// bka' babs drug pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ klu byang gi dkyil chog dang mthun pa'i brgyud par ngos bzung*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ klu las gyur pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ klu'i byang chub/ zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ nag po spyod pa/ sa 'dres pa chen po/ bir+ya bha dra/ de wa ā ka ra tsan+d+ra dī paṃ ka ra/ 'gos lo tsā ba/ dbus pa dge ser/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ gnam kha'u pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ de gnyis ka las bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de las grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin no// sa lugs brgyud pa phyi ma ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ mgon po klu sgrub/

ār+ya de wa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bi khyā ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'od zer shākya/ kha'u pa dar ma shes rab/ se mo ra pa rin chen dpal/ bla ma ra gnyis pa rgyal mtshan rin chen/ spro lung nags phug pa kun smon/ bla ma grags chen pa/ chos rje 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/ shong blo gros brtan pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal seng*/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab man sngar bzhin no// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ sngags rams pa'i gsan yig na sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen dang mthun pa'i brgyud par mdzad/ shar pa'i gsan yig na dbang bka' gsar ma'i nye brgyud du ngos 'dzin/ phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ ma taṅgi pa/ sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen/ bi khyā ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta man 'dra/ jo bo lugs kyi dbang gi mjug na dpyal a mo ghas sbyar ba'i bum dbang cho ga'i dbang bka' 'di dkyil chog dpyal ba'i dpe steng nas byas pa yin gyi/ dbang bka' jo bo'i bar ma chad pa yin no zhes 'byung ngo*// bka' babs bdun pa dpyal lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni jo bo dang 'dra'o zhes zer ba bu ston rin po che'i gsan yig na snang yang*/ dpyal lo tsā bas kha che paṇa chen las gsan par snang bas/ kha che paṇa chen yan sa lugs dang 'dra ba las/ de nas dpyal chos kyi bzang po/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ bla ma dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma don ri grags chen/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston man 'dra/ yang na 'gos lo tsā ba nas/ mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mgo pa dharma tsakra/ stag pa jo bzang*/ dpyal chos bzang man 'dra/ yang na dpyal chos bzang nas/

bod btsun/ klog skya ba grags pa dpal/ klog skya bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje chos/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ pad+ma'i zhabs/ rta mchog sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ klu byang*/ bal po phyag rdor/ rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti pa shrī kīrti/ shrī legs smin/ shrī ku mā ra sha na/ bi nā ya ka rat+na badz+ra/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba chos kyi brtson 'grus/ she ston mar lam/ jo ston dkon seng*/ kun mkhyen chos 'od/ sri chung ba lce blo ldan/ 'phags 'od man 'dra/ yang na she ston nas/ ya stod tshul bzang*/ dpyal nyi ma/ chos sku 'od zer man 'dra/ yang brgyud lugs gcig la/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen nas/ dkon mchog rin chen/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs man 'dra'o// des na sngon gyi dus su lugs srol so sor yod par snang yang*/ kun mkhyen bu ston sogs bla ma phyi ma rnams kyi dbang bka' thams cad gsan nas/ byin rlabs kyi chu bo kun 'dus phyag len kyang snying po dril ba ste bka' drin che 'dug go /dbang gi mtshams sbyor sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas mnos so// ༈ /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po cher chos rje bla ma dam pa'i gsung gis bskul nas mdzad pa'i khrid yig yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i za ma tog dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i yid bzhin nor bu'i za ma tog kha 'byed pa'i lde mig ma bu sbyar ba'i steng nas pha rgyud bla na med pa'i snying po las kyang ches snying por gyur pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bshad pa'i rgyud thun mong ma yin pa bzhis gsal bar byas pa'i don rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis thugs nyams su bzhes nas tai lo nā ro sogs paṇa grub las nye bar 'ongs pa'i zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim rim pa lnga'i dmar khrid zab mo nyams khrid du legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

'di sngar ma thob kyang thob 'gyur gyis bris/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ lha'i bu mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i brgyud par 'byung ba dang gcig dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ mtshan gsang ba ma taṅgi pa/ tai lo pa shes rab bzang po/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros/ mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kīrti/ 'khon bya khang pa bsod nams rin chen/ mi nyag thur lha ba tshul khrims skyabs/ rgya mkhar thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ se sdings pa gzhon nu 'od/ mag dge sdings pa kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin chen grub/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin chen tshul khrims/ mkhan chen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhan chen sku zhang rin chen mkhyen brtse mchog grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ skyor mda' ba mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bdag la'o// yang khrid yig gnyis kyi lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khu dbon gnyis ka las mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis gsan pa man 'dra'o// ༈ /mkhas shing grub pa'i slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi legs par bkral ba'i gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po'i nyi 'od/

dkyil chog ye shes rnam rol/ phyi rol tshogs bsags kyi cho ga gtor chog phrin las rnam rol rnams dang*/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor bcas pa'i steng nas yi ge rnams kyi lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bka' babs drug dang ldan pa las/ a bo tsa dā di ma hā lo tsā ne ta s+ya mā laḥ/ bka' babs dang po lo chen lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ mañju shrī gho ṣa tsā dwa ya wa dhū tiḥ/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dang gnyis su med pa gnyis spangs pa/ ā tsār+ya bud+dha dz+nyā na pā daḥ/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ shrī dī paṃ ka ra bha draḥ/ dpal mar me mdzad bzang po/ ā nan+da gar+bhaḥ kun dga' snying po/ tha ga naḥ tha ga pa/ rat+nā ka ra shān+tiḥ/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba/ shrād+dhā ka ra warmaḥ/ dad byed go cha/ pad+ma ka ra warmaḥ/ pad+ma 'byung gnas go cha/ to dwa yi ma hā lo tsā rat+na bha dra ṇa pṛts+tshaḥ/ de gnyis ka las lo chen rin chen bzang pos zhus/ rka da po dhar+m+ma ma tiḥ/ rkyang po chos kyi blo gros/ ka l+yā ṇa mi tra sha ra ṇa singhaḥ/ dge bshes skyabs seng*/ rje btsong kha pa'i gsan yig na skyabs se 'dug pa brtag badz+ra sā ra s+thī raḥ/ rdo rje sra brtan/ rat+na dz+wa laḥ/ dkon mchog 'bar/ ka l+yā ṇa mi tre shwa ra rat+naḥ/ dge bshes dbang phyug rin chen/ dhā twa wa ni gu hi kaḥ/ khams pa sa phug pa/ shākya badz+raḥ/ shākya rdo rje/ nim+naṃ dhar+m+ma nā tha/ rong pa chos mgon/ lo tsā wa rīḥ/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ gu ru shrī wāṃ singhaḥ/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge pu tra shāstā rat+na sid+dhiḥ bu ston rin chen grub/ pa ṭu sid+dhiḥku mā ra puṇ+yeḥ/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ khyung po lhas pa/ dhar+m+ma swā mi dz+nyā nā dh+wa dzaḥ/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/

ngorma hā badz+ra dha rā nan+da bha draḥ/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ yu ba rā dzā nan+da shwa raḥ/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug sarba dz+nyā puṇ+ya singhaḥ/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka bud+dha rat+naḥ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ bhū mi paṇ+ḍi rā mañju gho ṣā nan+da puṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha draḥ/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ man+t+ra dha ra ya sho ma tiḥ/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dhar+m+mā swā mi pradz+nyā dh+wa dzaḥ/ chos rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ga ga na shrī bha draḥ/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rat+na shrī mā nār+tha sid+dhiḥ/ rin po che dpal ldan don grub/ mañju gho ṣa pūrba pradz+nyā ka raḥ/ 'jam dbyangs shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ de'i sku dbon/ mañju nā tha pūrba dz+nyā na bha draḥ 'jam mgon shar pa ye shes bzang po/ ma hā pa ṭu sid+dho bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīḥ/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ badz+ra dha ra shā sa na dha ra ni rā bho gaḥ/ rdo rje 'chang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ ma hā pra sā da sarba dz+nyā na maṅga la ni rā bho ga kīrti r+dhā dza shrī bha draḥ/ drin chen thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ta to ma yā nan+de shī la rat+ne na dwi phrash+naḥ/ de las bdag btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis lan gnyis bar du mnos so/ /a pi ma ho pa dh+yā ya maṅga la ni rā bho gaḥ/ yang na mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub nas/ rma ho pa dh+yā ya mañju gho ṣa bud+dha shrī bha draḥ/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ te na me pra da ta daḥ/ des bdag la stsal to/ /yang na 'jam dpal/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ tha ga na/ bhu sha na pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/

bhi ma shān+ti/ bhiṃ ga ra pā da/ shrad+dha ka ra warma/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ rkyang po chos blo/ gcung po zhang khra/ gnyal pa skyogs ston/ khun tsi gzhon nu rin chen/ gtsang rong pa shes rab gzhon nu/ slob dpon dkon mchog 'bar/ g.yag sde ba dbang phyug rin chen/ khams ston shākya rdo rje man 'dra'o// bka' babs gnyis pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal rdo rje/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ paṇa grub mar me mdzad dpal bzang po/ dpal bde ba'i zhabs/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rat+na badz+ra/ rat+na kīrti/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ bla ma ban+dha pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa dar ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man 'dra'o// bka' babs gsum pa kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad nas rim par brgyud de kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī/ kha che ga ga dha ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi na shrī/ de la go pā la'i pho brang du khams pa rdo rje dpal gyis zhus/ de nas kīrtī shrī/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa man sa lugs dang 'dra'o// bka' babs bzhi pa gnyos lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bi ma la gup+ta yan gong sa lugs ltar las/ de nas yi ge'i rnal 'byor rat+na shrī/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ ba lin+ta ā tsār+ya/ kha reg de'i dbon yin/ gi gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags/ de sras gnyos rdo rje bla ma/ gnyos dpal le/ gnyos grags pa dpal/

gnyos gzi brjid dpal/ sangs rgyas ras chen/ rgyal ba lha snang*/ rtsa ri ras chen/ dpyal kha chos rje zhes pa rnams mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin/ ston mo lung pa ye shes mkhar/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// yang na gnyos rdo rje bla ma nas/ gnyos ston grags pa dpal/ gnyos lha snang ba/ rin po che do pa/ mdog stod gser ma/ glas pa dpon rdo rje tshul khrims/ g.yas ru ba rngos ston rin chen rgyal mtshan/ spang khang pa grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po man 'dra'o// bka' babs lnga pa jo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ a nan+da gar+bha/ tha ga na/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bar 'dir jo bo chen po mar me mdzad ces rgyal dbang lnga pa sogs kyi gsan yig na byung yang sngon ma 'di ye shes zhabs pa'i dngos slob kyi jo bo rje yin dgos kyi/ 'dir 'ong don med pas yig skyon yin nam brtag rgya lcags ri gong kha pa/ rdzing bu kha pa/ span bug pa/ zhang ye shes/ gzi ba don grub/ bar thang pa yab sras/ bla ma dar ma shākya/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhas grub khyung po lhas pa/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po man 'dra'o// bka' babs drug pa rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rat+na badz+ra/ rin chen grags pa/ sa man+ta pra bha/ bha draḥ'ang byung*/ dz+nyā na shrī mi tra/ rat+na kīrti/ puṇ+ye shrī/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/

rdo rje sra brtan man 'dra'o// ༈ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi mngon dkyil sogs dang*/ de'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyi yi ge rnams kyi steng nas jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas legs par bkral ba'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jig rten dbang phyug lha bcu dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ 'am pa byang chub rdo rje/ rgya lcags ri gong pa/ rdzing bu kha pa shākya grags/ span phug pa dar ma grags/ zhang ye pa shes rab rdo rje/ gzi ba don grub
